chapters.title: Chapter 1643 - The test of the Great Sovereign
paragraphs: 7th of the week!

The scene quieted down. The battle between Dragon Shisan and Nanbei Chao ended. Although the battle developed to such an extent, nothing was concluded. If it wasn’t for the safety of Wu Ningzhu, Dragon Shisan wouldn’t have fought Nanbei Chao. On the other hand, when Nanbei Chao saw the might of the fiery stairs, he stopped attacking as though he also feared the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao. He knew very well that it was pointless for him to continue fighting. It was an impossible task to defeat Dragon Shisan, let alone killing him.

No matter how arrogant and overbearing Nanbei Chao was, it required true capability to kill someone. Although the battle had already ended, he secretly swore that the first thing he would do after advancing to the late Immortal Emperor realm was to kill the monkey and the heaven-defying Jiang Chen.

The battles had stopped, however everyone became an eyesore to Jiang Chen and his comrades, especially Big Yellow who wanted so badly to pick two people and bite them to death. Not just him, the others also felt the same way. They could only be on the defensive in the whole process. Compared to them, Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan seemed a lot better. At least, they were able to fight a thrilling battle.
To Big Yellow, he didn’t mind how strong the enemy was or how many they were. He only cared about the intoxication of killing, but today, he obviously did not get that feeling.

Currently, the faces of the four brothers—Jiang Chen, Big Yellow, Han Yan, and Tyrant—were filled with fury. If it wasn’t for the fear of disturbing Wu Ningzhu, they would have already started a frenzied massacre and wouldn’t care about the consequences anymore.

Wu Ningzhu was standing on the first step of the fiery stairs. She didn’t seem to be moving forward. The countless light emitted from the Xiao Yao Qin had completely enveloped Wu Ningzhu. Ancient musical notes were circling around her. The musical notes seemed to have come to life. They were the notes that came from the Xiao Yao Qin.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*
The one hundred fiery stairs trembled intensely. More and more musical notes emerged. The strong Fire of Sun spread around her body, but it was entirely harmless to her.
“Why isn’t Miss Wu going forward?” Lan Lingji asked, clearly puzzled.

“She is accepting the test of Empress Xiao Yao. It will test whether she is qualified to become the master of the Xiao Yao Qin. If she passed that, I’m afraid that she will face yet another test, which is the true test,” said Big Yellow.
“It doesn’t seem easy to obtain the legacy of a Great Sovereign.”

Yang Lang sighed and gained a better understanding after a moment of contemplation. If the inheritance of a Great Sovereign could be obtained so easily, anyone would be able to get it. The Qin wouldn’t have remained hidden here for tens of thousands of years and found no qualified descendant until now.

Buzzing sound could be heard from the fiery stairway. It seemed like the test would take some time. Innumerable gazes fell upon Wu Ningzhu. Those who tried to stop Wu Ningzhu desired to watch her fail. Of course, this was the only thing they could do at the moment. The power of the Great Sovereign’s inheritance was just too great. Many people had died under the Fire of Sun. None of them was willing to be the next one.

“Ah Yan, I had never thought that you have gone to the Northern Profound Domain and become the chosen one of Profound Yin Cult. We have been worrying about you, which seems unnecessary now. You must have been living a great life during this period.”

Jiang Chen looked over at Han Yan. His face revealed a rare smile. There was nothing happier than the brothers’ reunion. Plus, meeting again at this critical moment allowed them to see the huge progress in each one of them. The delight in Jiang Chen’s heart was beyond description.

“That’s right. Ah Yan, why are you bastard always better than us? Dammit, you have even gotten the fortune in the immortal vault of an ancient devil. I’m really jealous of you right now.” Big Yellow bared his teeth.
“Go and f yourself! Why don’t you talk about yourself? You have gotten fat enough!”
Han Yan sent a kick onto the dog’s butt. The atmosphere between them was just like before - warm and lively.

Later, Han Yan gave a bear hug to Tyrant. Both of them hadn’t seen each other ever since they ascended from Saint Origin World, and had been worrying about each other. Now that they finally met, the brotherhood between them was fully shown.

“Although one is a Buddha and the other is a Devil, they are still able to be so close.” Dragon Shisan couldn’t help but praise. The Buddha Sect had never gotten along well with the Devil Cult. It was definitely his first time seeing Tyrant and Han Yan behaving so brotherly to each other.
“Where did this monkey come from? How could you ever understand the brotherhood between us?” Han Yan said to Dragon Shisan.

Both of them didn’t know each other. When Jiang Chen got the wondrous rock in the ancient tomb, he had already parted company with Han Yan. So naturally, Dragon Shisan hadn’t seen Han Yan along the journey.

However, both of them had seen each other’s performance in the battle which made them show a certain respect to each other. Dragon Shisan in particular, Han Yan couldn’t help raising a thumbs up to him for being able to fight Nanbei Chao for so long.
“You two haven’t met before. Han Yan, Dragon Shisan is also a brother that has gone through life-and-death situation with me.”

Jiang Chen spoke, instantly building a connection with a stranger with the words ‘brother who had gone through life-and-death situation’. Whether it was Han Yan or Dragon Shisan, both knew Jiang Chen incomparably well. There were only a few that could be regarded as Jiang Chen’s life-and-death brother. The fact that Jiang Chen said it indicated that they had an extraordinary friendship and that it was worth for Jiang Chen to rescue the person with his own life.

“Little Chen, when we were in Saint Origin World, we didn’t think that we would have the chance to do the same things in the Immortal World - traveling unhindered across the world and fighting against tens of thousands of enemies.”
Tyrant curled the corner of his mouth. His expression became incomparably arrogant. His words had stirred the emotions of the few.
That was right. The scene just now was definitely more intense compared to Saint Origin World. Perhaps they had dreamt of this situation before but had never imagined that it would come true.
To them, fighting the world was a small matter. The most important thing was their growth, and could still be together just like before, not leaving each other behind.

This was the true brotherhood, which transcended all kinds of friendship in the Heavens and Earth. They cherished each other very much. Ordinary people might not have such a relationship in their lifetime. In such a cruel world, they couldn’t fight alone. That relationship would be their deepest belief and reliance.
*Hua La...*

Just at this moment, something happened on the fiery stairs once again. The musical notes that were surrounding Wu Ningzhu broke and returned to the Xiao Yao Qin. Wu Ningzhu began raising her foot, heading for the second step of the stairs.

“Look, the musical notes are shattered. Sister Ning is still moving forward. She has passed the test and is recognized by the Xiao Yao Qin.” Han Yan spoke with delight. The others too showed a look of delight.

“Don’t get excited too early. She is still being tested. She needs to walk the stairway one by one until she reached the top and gets the Xiao Yao Qin. Only then can it be considered a success. If I’m not mistaken, it won’t be an easy task to reach the top of the fiery stairs,” Big Yellow spoke. His eyes were full of sharpness. It seemed as if he had a certain knowledge about Empress Xiao Yao.
Sure enough, when Wu Ningzhu reached the fifth step of the stairs, her body began to shake, showing signs of difficulty.
Upon seeing this, the others began to worry. There were 95 more steps to go. They eagerly wondered what’s the next test she would encounter.

“Look, that woman seems to be having difficulty in moving forward at the fifth step of the stairs. It seems like Empress Xiao Yao is going to give her another test. There are 95 more steps and I think she won’t make it.”

“That’s right. Her cultivation base is too weak, she’s merely a half-step Immortal Emperor. It will be extremely hard for her to reach the top. As long as she fails, all her efforts will be in vain. Haha! It seems like we still have hope.”
“How can such a delicate woman reach the top of the fiery stairs? The difficulty will only get harder.”

The geniuses on the scene were displaying malicious eyes. They could clearly see that it was getting harder for Wu Ningzhu to walk and this was only the fifth step of the stairs. They didn’t think that she could persist in the remaining steps.

The scene was plunged into silence once more, except for the buzzing sound that came from the fiery stairs. All eyes were on her. They wanted to know what would happen next. One should know that a Great Sovereign’s inheritance couldn’t be gotten so easily, especially when it was the inheritance left by an ancient Sovereign like Empress Xiao Yao.
Smiles began to show on many faces. They would be most delighted to see Wu Ningzhu fail.

Under the innumerable gaze, Wu Ningzhu reached the 20th step, but at this moment, her body began to shake intensely. All of her energy was drained. Her face paled. It seemed like she might fall at any time, but her expression was full of resoluteness. Her star-like beautiful eyes were fixed on the Xiao Yao Qin above.

“What now? Miss Wu seems to be losing her strength. There are 80 steps more,” Hua Xiaoqian spoke with concern. She naturally wanted Wu Ningzhu to succeed, otherwise, all of her previous efforts would be in vain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1644 - Rebirth from the Fire
paragraphs: 8th of the week!

Hua Xiaoqian’s concern was also what the others were most worried about right now. It wasn’t easy for them to successfully send Wu Ningzhu to the fiery stairs. Now she was facing the most difficult test, but everyone was crystal clear that she could only rely on herself. Nobody would be able to help her.
“We won’t be able to interfere in it. All we can do is to watch silently,” Big Yellow shook his head.
“I believe that Sister Ning will succeed,” said Jiang Chen in an incomparably resolute tone.

His confidence in Wu Ningzhu was logical. First, she was a person with great perseverance. Second, she was someone with strong aspiration. When she was still the saintess of Mysterious River Palace, she wore a veil since young for the sake of her mother, hoping that she could reunite with her mother again one day. So how could she possibly be a weak person?
Furthermore, she had ascended from Saint Origin World to the Immortal World. Without strong perseverance and mind, how was she able to become a true immortal?

Moreover, Jiang Chen believed in Empress Xiao Yao’s vision. As an ancient Empress, she certainly wouldn’t be casual in selecting her descendant. Since Wu Ningzhu had been chosen by the Empress and passed the first test of the Xiao Yao Qin, her chance of being recognized as the Qin’s master had become higher.

“That’s of course. How can the one chosen by Empress Xiao Yao be an incapable person? But even if she could succeed, it’s going to be a very difficult process. As the saying goes, a phoenix rises from the ashes. This is Sister Ning’s great opportunity and also her greatest trial,” said Big Yellow.

He had the same thoughts as Jiang Chen, not doubting Wu Ningzhu would get the Great Sovereign’s inheritance, but it wouldn’t be an easy process and success could only come after a series of hardships. If she was abandoned by Empress Xiao Yao, she would be bound to be mediocre for the rest of her life.
On the fiery stairs, Wu Ningzhu gritted her teeth and lifted her foot onto the 21st step.
*Hong...*

However, as soon as Wu Ningzhu stepped onto the 21st step, changes happened all of a sudden. The Fire of Sun suddenly launched an attack on Wu Ningzhu. Her body was now burning with flames. Even from afar, people could see the fire incinerating her body.
“Not good!” Han Yan cried in alarm.
Everyone became tensed as they thought that it was some sort of invisible pressure that made Wu Ningzhu’s movement somewhat slow. To their horror, the fire started to attack her on the 21st step.

“Don’t panic. This is the real test. Sister Ning is going to be reborn from the Fire of Sun, casting off her old self and taking on a new one, allowing her to possess the complete bloodline of the Golden Crow. Empress Xiao Yao was a supreme Great Sovereign of the Golden Clan. In order to obtain the Empress’s inheritance and control the Xiao Yao Qin, one has to possess the genuine bloodline of the Golden clan. We can only let her fate run its course. There’s nothing else we can do. But the refinement process is incredibly cruel. Ordinary experts won’t be able to handle it and die.”

Big Yellow spoke with great dignity. He knew the situation very well. Not only would Wu Ningzhu get the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao, but also become a descendant of the Divine Bird Golden Crow, however the process was unquestionably painful and dangerous. That was to say, it absolutely wasn’t easy to be a descendant of a Great Sovereign and the Golden Clan.

What Big Yellow said unsettled everyone once more. While being burned by the Fire of Sun, she still had 79 steps to go. This was no easy task, but no one could give her a hand. Even Jiang Chen, the one who had all very powerful means, could only watch motionlessly and pray that Wu Ningzhu could successfully integrate with the Golden Crow bloodline.

There had been a lot of sayings mentioning that phoenixes rose from ashes and butterflies emerging from cocoons. The truth was that it wasn’t as simple as it sounded. He was afraid that only the one who was experiencing it knew the pain and pressure.

Wu Ningzhu gritted her teeth and continued dragging herself forward. That’s right, she was hauling herself forcefully. With every step, the Fire of Sun would only get stronger. The essence of the flames constantly seeped through her skin, into her body, intending to refine all the insides and outsides of her body, allowing true transformation to take place in her body.

When she reached the 25th step, the Fire of Sun had already turned into a pool of flames, completely drowning her within. It became impossible to see her from outside. She had become a person of fire. Countless expression darkened. Whether it was those who hoped for Wu Ningzhu to fail or those who prayed for her success, all of them couldn’t help but show a trace of respect. They could already imagine the pain and torture that she was bearing. Despite that, she didn’t let out any sound, not even a wail. Instead, she continued ascending the stairs.
“What a powerful willpower! If it had been me, I would’ve given up, even if it’s the inheritance of a Great Sovereign.”

“The burning of the Fire of Sun inside and outside of her body. That kind of torture is unimaginable. I never thought this woman have such perseverance. I have underestimated her. However there are still 75 steps to go. At this rate, I’m afraid she is going to end up dead on the fiery stairs before reaching the top.”
“That’s right. It seems like the inheritance isn’t easy to obtain at all. Such a test isn’t bearable by a half-step Immortal Emperor.”

Many people were shocked. No one looked down on Wu Ningzhu anymore, but most of them felt that she was going to die for sure this time. The situation was far from optimistic. The Fire of Sun was overly strong and yet she still had so many steps to go.

Finally, when she reached the 30th step, she let out a wail. Her voice was hoarse, blood-curdling and agonizing. Both of her legs had been fully incinerated. That kind of pain was beyond understanding and imagination.
“Sister Ning!” Jiang Chen yelled.

Despite him being cold-blooded, he found it hard to endure watching this scene. His eyes went red. The scream of hers almost jolted his heart out. He really couldn’t watch this anymore, however he felt compelled to because he wanted to see her continue climbing the stairs.

He wished that he was the one being in the sea of fire now, letting him carry the pain that Wu Ningzhu was feeling right now. At this moment, he began to recall all the bitter-sweet moments he had had with Wu Ningzhu.

This is his woman, but he couldn’t do anything to help her and could only watch her suffer endless torment. The feeling he was having right now was beyond understanding as well. For the first time in his life, he felt pretty useless.

Big Yellow, Han Yan, Tyrant and Dragon Shisan were silent. Their eyes had also turned red. Their fists were clenched. The worries in their hearts were conceivable. Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian and the other female disciples of the two major powers averted their eyes as they couldn’t bear to watch anymore.
On the stairs, Wu Ningzhu continued to move upwards. After the miserable scream, she quieted down.

On the 35th step, half of her lower body had been incinerated, as though those parts had vanished completely from the Heavens and Earth. The Fire of Sun became fiercer and fiercer as if it was going to incinerate the entire world. Her consciousness became slightly blurred, but her determination had yet to disappear. She continued to move upwards!
“I can do it! I can! This kind of pain is nothing to me!”

Her determination churned inside of her. She wanted to become stronger. She didn’t want to be a liability to Jiang Chen. Perhaps she really didn’t want to become a stronger woman. Her greatest desire was to be able to accompany Jiang Chen and walk along with him. As such, she had to be stronger. She wanted to be useful to Jiang Chen.
The corners of Jiang Chen’s eyes moistened. He felt that his heart was beating uncontrollably fast, and that the scene was suffocating him.
“Sister Ning!”

Jiang Chen shouted Wu Ningzhu’s name in a hoarse voice, as though something was stuck in his throat. He could feel Wu Ningzhu’s determination, the determination that not even the fire could incinerate. Even if all her flesh were burned away, her determination would still remain.
When a person die, the stubbornness would cling to one’s sentiments! And in the fiery Samsara, the thing that couldn’t be burnt away was one’s sentiments!

Jiang Chen suddenly understood why Venerable Xiao Wangqing had become what he was. Jiang Chen could never cut his sentiments. In fact, there were some sentiments that he could never cut because not even Xiao Wangqing could do it. That was why Xiao Wangqing had to search his sentiments.

Fiery waves rolled. The figure in the pool of flames was still moving up the stairs. The whole scene had become strangely quiet. Most of them didn’t even dare to breathe, afraid that it would disturb the lady’s persistence to climb.
Wu Ningzhu’s stubbornness had been turned into something tangible, and it drifted across the crowd.

Lan Lingji held Dragon Shisan’s hand tightly. This was her first time holding a man’s hand and she was the one who took the initiative. She was touched by the love between Jiang Chen and Wu Ningzhu. Looking at the serious-looking Dragon Shisan, she wondered if Dragon Shisan would also shed tears if she was the one in the sea of fire.
If a woman was passionately loved by her man in her life, she wouldn’t mind dying for him.
The upper body of Wu Ningzhu began incinerating. At this rate, she could only reach the 40th step at best and at that time, nothing would be left off of her.

On the fiery stairs, Wu Ningzhu gritted her teeth and lifted her foot onto the 21st step.
*Hong...*
However, as soon as Wu Ningzhu stepped onto the 21st step, changes happened all of a sudden.
The Fire of Sun suddenly launched an attack on Wu Ningzhu.
Her body was now burning with flames.
Even from afar, people could see the fire incinerating her body.
“Not good!” Han Yan cried in alarm.
Everyone became tensed as they thought that it was some sort of invisible pressure that made Wu Ningzhu’s movement somewhat slow.
To their horror, the fire started to attack her on the 21st step.
“Don’t panic.
This is the real test.
Sister Ning is going to be reborn from the Fire of Sun, casting off her old self and taking on a new one, allowing her to possess the complete bloodline of the Golden Crow.
Empress Xiao Yao was a supreme Great Sovereign of the Golden Clan.
In order to obtain the Empress’s inheritance and control the Xiao Yao Qin, one has to possess the genuine bloodline of the Golden clan.
We can only let her fate run its course.
There’s nothing else we can do.
But the refinement process is incredibly cruel.
Ordinary experts won’t be able to handle it and die.”
Big Yellow spoke with great dignity.
He knew the situation very well.
Not only would Wu Ningzhu get the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao, but also become a descendant of the Divine Bird Golden Crow, however the process was unquestionably painful and dangerous.
That was to say, it absolutely wasn’t easy to be a descendant of a Great Sovereign and the Golden Clan.
What Big Yellow said unsettled everyone once more.
While being burned by the Fire of Sun, she still had 79 steps to go.
This was no easy task, but no one could give her a hand.
Even Jiang Chen, the one who had all very powerful means, could only watch motionlessly and pray that Wu Ningzhu could successfully integrate with the Golden Crow bloodline.
There had been a lot of sayings mentioning that phoenixes rose from ashes and butterflies emerging from cocoons.
The truth was that it wasn’t as simple as it sounded.
He was afraid that only the one who was experiencing it knew the pain and pressure.
Wu Ningzhu gritted her teeth and continued dragging herself forward.
That’s right, she was hauling herself forcefully.
With every step, the Fire of Sun would only get stronger.
The essence of the flames constantly seeped through her skin, into her body, intending to refine all the insides and outsides of her body, allowing true transformation to take place in her body.
When she reached the 25th step, the Fire of Sun had already turned into a pool of flames, completely drowning her within.
It became impossible to see her from outside.
She had become a person of fire.
Countless expression darkened.
Whether it was those who hoped for Wu Ningzhu to fail or those who prayed for her success, all of them couldn’t help but show a trace of respect.
They could already imagine the pain and torture that she was bearing.
Despite that, she didn’t let out any sound, not even a wail.
Instead, she continued ascending the stairs.
“What a powerful willpower!
If it had been me, I would’ve given up, even if it’s the inheritance of a Great Sovereign.”
“The burning of the Fire of Sun inside and outside of her body.
That kind of torture is unimaginable.
I never thought this woman have such perseverance.
I have underestimated her.
However there are still 75 steps to go.
At this rate, I’m afraid she is going to end up dead on the fiery stairs before reaching the top.”
“That’s right.
It seems like the inheritance isn’t easy to obtain at all.
Such a test isn’t bearable by a half-step Immortal Emperor.”
Many people were shocked.
No one looked down on Wu Ningzhu anymore, but most of them felt that she was going to die for sure this time.
The situation was far from optimistic.
The Fire of Sun was overly strong and yet she still had so many steps to go.
Finally, when she reached the 30th step, she let out a wail.
Her voice was hoarse, blood-curdling and agonizing.
Both of her legs had been fully incinerated.
That kind of pain was beyond understanding and imagination.
“Sister Ning!” Jiang Chen yelled.
Despite him being cold-blooded, he found it hard to endure watching this scene.
His eyes went red.
The scream of hers almost jolted his heart out.
He really couldn’t watch this anymore, however he felt compelled to because he wanted to see her continue climbing the stairs.
He wished that he was the one being in the sea of fire now, letting him carry the pain that Wu Ningzhu was feeling right now.
At this moment, he began to recall all the bitter-sweet moments he had had with Wu Ningzhu.
This is his woman, but he couldn’t do anything to help her and could only watch her suffer endless torment.
The feeling he was having right now was beyond understanding as well.
For the first time in his life, he felt pretty useless.
Big Yellow, Han Yan, Tyrant and Dragon Shisan were silent.
Their eyes had also turned red.
Their fists were clenched.
The worries in their hearts were conceivable.
Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian and the other female disciples of the two major powers averted their eyes as they couldn’t bear to watch anymore.
On the stairs, Wu Ningzhu continued to move upwards.
After the miserable scream, she quieted down.
On the 35th step, half of her lower body had been incinerated, as though those parts had vanished completely from the Heavens and Earth.
The Fire of Sun became fiercer and fiercer as if it was going to incinerate the entire world.
Her consciousness became slightly blurred, but her determination had yet to disappear.
She continued to move upwards!
“I can do it!
I can!
This kind of pain is nothing to me!”
Her determination churned inside of her.
She wanted to become stronger.
She didn’t want to be a liability to Jiang Chen.
Perhaps she really didn’t want to become a stronger woman.
Her greatest desire was to be able to accompany Jiang Chen and walk along with him.
As such, she had to be stronger.
She wanted to be useful to Jiang Chen.
The corners of Jiang Chen’s eyes moistened.
He felt that his heart was beating uncontrollably fast, and that the scene was suffocating him.
“Sister Ning!”
Jiang Chen shouted Wu Ningzhu’s name in a hoarse voice, as though something was stuck in his throat.
He could feel Wu Ningzhu’s determination, the determination that not even the fire could incinerate.
Even if all her flesh were burned away, her determination would still remain.
When a person die, the stubbornness would cling to one’s sentiments!
And in the fiery Samsara, the thing that couldn’t be burnt away was one’s sentiments!
Jiang Chen suddenly understood why Venerable Xiao Wangqing had become what he was.
Jiang Chen could never cut his sentiments.
In fact, there were some sentiments that he could never cut because not even Xiao Wangqing could do it.
That was why Xiao Wangqing had to search his sentiments.
Fiery waves rolled.
The figure in the pool of flames was still moving up the stairs.
The whole scene had become strangely quiet.
Most of them didn’t even dare to breathe, afraid that it would disturb the lady’s persistence to climb.
Wu Ningzhu’s stubbornness had been turned into something tangible, and it drifted across the crowd.
Lan Lingji held Dragon Shisan’s hand tightly.
This was her first time holding a man’s hand and she was the one who took the initiative.
She was touched by the love between Jiang Chen and Wu Ningzhu.
Looking at the serious-looking Dragon Shisan, she wondered if Dragon Shisan would also shed tears if she was the one in the sea of fire.
If a woman was passionately loved by her man in her life, she wouldn’t mind dying for him.
The upper body of Wu Ningzhu began incinerating.
At this rate, she could only reach the 40th step at best and at that time, nothing would be left off of her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1645 - Golden Crow Bloodline
paragraphs: 1st of the week!
The moving fire soon reached the 40th step. Just as everyone expected, she had disappeared, totally engulfed by the flames, but the pool of life was still there.
They couldn’t see Wu Ningzhu’s figure on the stairs, as though she wasn’t there.
“Sister Ning!”
Jiang Chen shouted. Although this was within his expectation, he found it hard to accept the fact that Wu Ningzhu had vanished from his sight. He was completely caught off guard.
“Is she dead? It’s a pity. She failed eventually.”

“Ai! I knew it. The inheritance can’t be so easily obtained. Although the woman was impressive, she isn’t strong enough. She has already been burned to nothingness at the 40th step. She couldn’t move any further.”

“It’s really a pity. Although she’s dead, she’s respected by people. But since the descendant is dead, I’m afraid Empress Xiao Yao will select another one. I wonder if we will have the chance. But even if we have the chance, I don’t think I have the courage to step onto the fiery stairs, it’s too horrifying. I just can’t joke around with my life.

Countless people felt sorry for her. There were also plenty people who were taking pleasure in her misfortune, especially those from major powers that had grudges with Jiang Chen, each of their face was filled with joy. This was no doubt the outcome they had wanted to see.
“Jiang Chen, I suppose it isn’t pleasant at all to watch the one you love being burned to nothingness, not even her ashes was left.” Nanbei Chao spoke in a sneering tone.
*Hong...*
As soon as his words fell, a strong killing intent burst out from Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan. They were going to lunged at Nanbei Chao.

“Don’t attack yet. Sister Ning isn’t dead yet. If she’s really dead, the pool of fire will vanish, the Xiao Yao Qin will disappear as well, and everything would have quieted down. Do you all really think that the Xiao Yao Qin will look for another descendant immediately after Wu Ningzhu dies? She will be reborn from the fire. As long as the flames are still there, she will never vanish. Her body will be reconstructed once more soon. When that time comes, she will have the complete bloodline of the Golden Crow in her body.”
Big Yellow gestured the two to stop. Others might not know the situation of Wu Ningzhu, but he knew it very clearly.

Upon hearing this, Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan regained their senses, and hastily looked at the fiery stairs and saw that the pool of flames was still burning as intensely as before. As long as the fire still existed, Wu Ningzhu’s will was still within the fire. This was the most critical stage in the rebirth.
Big Yellow’s words stirred up a trace of hope in them. Each pair of eyes stared unblinkingly at the sea of fire.

“Rising from the ashes like a phoenix? How ridiculous! Do you think everyone can be a phoenix? A chicken will always be a chicken. Even if it can reach the branch of the tree, it’s still not a phoenix. Jiang Chen, I reckon that your woman isn’t going to live. If you are feeling pain right now, why don’t you cry aloud? I would love to see it.” Nanbei Chao continued to speak coldly.
Jiang Chen’s eyes were blazing with fury. If it wasn’t for the safety of Wu Ningzhu, he would have rushed forward despite knowing that he was no match for him.
“Nanbei Chao, hasn’t anyone told you that you are abominable.” Jiang Chen spoke coldly. He secretly swore that he was going to get rid of Nanbei Chao sooner or later, for good.
“Humph!”

Nanbei Chao harrumphed coldly. His eyes gazing at the fire stairs. He too wanted to see if Wu Ningzhu could be reborn from the fire. It was most comfortable for him to see Jiang Chen suffer before him.

Five minutes had passed. There wasn’t a single motion from the fiery stairs. Jiang Chen and his comrades were burning with anxiety. If it wasn’t because the fire hadn’t disappeared, they would have lost their hope.
“Big Yellow, do you think Sister Ning can be reborn?” Han Yan asked with concern.

“It is either she rises from the ashes like a phoenix or plunge into an irrecoverable state. The pool of fire has yet to vanish and the Xiao Yao Qin is still suspended up there. So there’s still a high chance. Now, it all depends on Sister Ning’s willpower and luck. There’s nothing we can do. It’s either she survive or die.”

Every word of Big Yellow stung their hearts, but they understood it very well. What Big Yellow said was right. There could only be two possible outcomes. It was either she live or die. Nobody could interfere or offer any help.
“Amitabha, I believe that Sister Ning will be able to get through this trial.” Tyrant put his palms together, as though praying for Wu Ningzhu.
“Look, a shadow has emerged within the sea of fire.”
Yang Bufan suddenly exclaimed. Countless of people were alarmed. In the rolling flames, there was indeed a shadow flickering inside. It was the shadow of a woman, slowly solidifying.
“It’s Sister Ning. It’s the shadow of Sister Ning. Sister Ning is still alive. Haha!” Han Yan laughed excitedly.
Finally, smiles emerged on their faces. This was the outcome that they anticipated the most. The phoenix had successfully risen from the ashes.

“My goodness! She isn’t dead yet. Look, quickly! Her figure is constantly forming. I can sense that a very strong ancient bloodline is also forming within her. She is about to be reborn from the fire!”
“She has succeeded. How miraculous! She was completely disintegrated by the flames a moment ago, but now her body is reconstructing now. Could this be the rebirth from the fire in the legends?”
“What a powerful woman! She has made it. Not only will she get the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao, but also the bloodline of Golden Crow.”

“I know now. The rumor says that Empress Xiao Yao is a peerless ancient Sovereign of the Golden Clan. As the Golden Clan has been gone for a long time, the bloodline of Golden Crow could no longer be found. If this woman succeeds, she will be the last descendant of the Golden Clan with a complete bloodline.”
Everyone was shocked by her rebirth. Such a process required incredible perseverance, willpower, and luck.
Without a doubt, Wu Ningzhu possessed all of these traits.

In the sea of fire, her figure was gradually forming. In just a few minutes’ of time, her body was completely formed. The reborn Wu Ningzhu seemed a lot different from before. Previously she wore black clothes, now it was replaced by gold-red tight armor. There was a vague pair of wings fluttering behind her back. Her eyes sparkled. She looked amazingly beautiful.
“So beautiful.”

Lan Lingji and Hua Xiaoqian spoke at the same time. Both of them were considered unparalleled beauties of the generation, but they couldn’t deny Wu Ningzhu’s beauty, which was another kind of beauty that incorporated a trace of wildness.

“Haha! Sure enough, Sister Ning has inherited the bloodline of the Golden Crow. The Golden Crow is also the Divine Bird of the Sun with an extremely noble bloodline. Given Sister Ning’s looks, if the Golden Clan still exists, she definitely will be regarded as a saintess.” Big Yellow laughed aloud. The transformation in Wu Ningzhu was delighting.
“Look, Sister Ning’s qi is changing. Her cultivation base seems to be climbing!” Tyrant spoke hastily.
Currently, her qi was rising incessantly, about to break through to the Immortal Emperor realm.

“She has inherited the bloodline of the Golden Crow. Her cultivation base will naturally be boosted as well. The rebirth has brought her tremendous benefits. I estimate that her cultivation base will at least reach the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm,” said Big Yellow with a smile.
Note:

chapters.title: Chapter 1646 - The Fire of Sun
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

The bloodline of the ancient Golden Crow, the Divine Bird of the Sun was unimaginably powerful. Putting aside how much it could aid in her future cultivation after acquiring it, the bloodline itself was enough to improve her cultivation base by leaps and bounds.
“The inheritance of the Great Sovereign is enviable.” Yang Lang showed a look of envy.

“This is the blessing brought by the bloodline. Sister Ning hasn’t even gotten the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao yet. If she is able to master the divine musical notes of Empress Xiao Yao, she will be invincible,” Big Yellow said with a smile.
He was crystal clear about Empress Xiao Yao and was incomparably happy that the Empress had succeeded in finding her descendant who turned out to be his ally. There was nothing better than this.
“Amazing!”
Mo Wuqing too, displayed an admiring look. Who wouldn’t admire someone with such heaven-defying luck and talent? It would surely be wonderful if he was the one in the scene.
*Hong...*

A powerful force suddenly burst out from Wu Ningzhu’s body. Her cultivation base had broken through to the early Immortal Emperor realm. After the rebirth, the Fire of Sun surrounding her became intensely strong, but this time, it didn’t seem to have any effect on her. Instead, because she had inherited the Golden Crow’s bloodline, the fire seemed to behave intimately towards her.

It could be seen that the current relationship between Wu Ningzhu and the Fire of Sun was akin to the relationship between Jiang Chen and the True Dragon Fire. The fire had completely integrated with her and was under her complete control.
“Dammit! She has actually succeeded! And her cultivation base is improving by leaps and bounds.”
Nanbei Chao’s facial expression darkened dramatically. The outcome was what he least anticipated.

“Nanbei Chao, I wanted very badly to know how you are feeling right now. I know that you aren’t feeling very well at all. So why don’t you say it out and amuse us? Hahaha...” Dragon Shisan sneered. He would never let go of this chance.
“Humph! The outcome is still not concluded yet. So what if she has acquired the inheritance? I still won’t put her in my eyes.” Nanbei Chao snorted coldly and arrogantly.
“Nanbei Chao, if I were you, I’d just run away now. Otherwise, when Sister Ning grows to an extent where she can kill you on the spot, you won’t have the chance anymore,” said Han Yan in a smile.
He had heard from Jiang Chen about the existence of Nanbei Chao’s true self in the Immortal World. So he wasn’t really surprised by Nanbei Chao’s presence.
*Hong...*

While they were speaking, Wu Ningzhu’s cultivation base advanced once more, breaking through to the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, finally stopping when the powerful qi reached the peak. Some earth-shattering changes had taken place inside of her. It wasn’t an exaggeration to describe it as casting off her old self and taking on a new one.
“What a pretty angel of the Golden Crow! Her presence gave out the aura that’s beyond our reach.”
“She’s truly an angel. She also has the bearing of a powerful female Sovereign.”

Innumerable people were exclaiming with astonishment. They had never seen such a beautiful lady before. Not only was she beautiful, but also had a high and mighty demeanour that belonged to a Great Sovereign, inviolable.

On the 40th step, she turned around, glanced at the Xiao Yao Qin suspending in the air above and continued moving upwards. Her speed was fast. Very quickly, she reached the 90th step where her movement seemed restricted again.

“That’s the will of the Empress. The last ten steps is where Empress Xiao Yao will instill her will into Sister Ning. It won’t be as difficult as being reborn from the fire. Since Sister Ning has passed that stage, she will no longer face any life-threatening danger. As long as she carries the will of the Empress, she will be able to wield the Xiao Yao Qin. At the same time, she can also enter the ancient palace and acquire the true inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao,” explained Big Yellow.
He seemed to have all the knowledge in the world. What’s left now was the will of Empress Xiao Yao. As long as she passed this stage, it will be considered a true success.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

The pressure in the last ten steps was incredibly immense. It was no longer the pressure of flames, but the invisible might of the Great Sovereign. All of the pressure came from the Xiao Yao Qin. It was trying to instill the supreme will of the Empress to its future master.
“It’s really the right decision to bring Sister Ning along. Otherwise, she’s going to miss this extraordinary encounter forever.”

Jiang Chen sighed with relief. He began to feel grateful to his master, Tianji Zi. If Tianji Zi hadn’t imparted the Great Divination Art to him, he wouldn’t have known how to divine the future. Without the ability to divine, he wouldn’t have brought Wu Ningzhu here. If Wu Ningzhu wasn’t present, the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao wouldn’t have emerged.
The Buddha Sect always talked about Karma. There’s always a result for every action. Today’s result was because of Jiang Chen.

What happened next happened according to Big Yellow’s expectation. Although the pressure in the last ten steps was great, it didn’t seem to stop Wu Ningzhu’s footsteps. In roughly ten minutes, she successfully arrived on the peak, in front of the Xiao Yao Qin. The Fire of Sun blazed from her eyes. The current Wu Ningzhu had fully inherited the will of the Great Sovereign. She stood there like a peerless female goddess, high and mighty and formidable.
“She has succeeded. She has succeeded in inheriting the will, obtaining the inheritance of the Xiao Yao Qin. Truly awesome!”
“Such luck is truly enviable.”

“I think we’d better leave now. We have tried to stop her before this. A while later, she’s going to acquire the Xiao Yao Qin. No one can tell how terrifying she will become. If she’s going to kill us later, our death will be certain.”
“There’s no need to be afraid. Even if she gets the Xiao Yao Qin, so what? She’s merely an intermediate Immortal Emperor. She won’t be able to display the power of the Great Sovereign Weapon.”

While admiring her performance, they also felt fear. Those who tried to attack Wu Ningzhu earlier were beginning to worry. She would absolutely get stronger. Only God knew how powerful the descendant of a Great Sovereign would become. As such, plenty of them had begun to slip away.

Of course, most of them still stayed on the scene. They wanted to see for themselves what the birth of a descendant of a Great Sovereign was like. Furthermore, those late Immortal Emperors weren’t afraid of her. After all, her cultivation base had yet to reach their level.

On top of the stairs, Wu Ningzhu stuck out her hands to gently touch the ancient qin. The Xiao Yao Qin let out a buzzing sound, seeming to express its affection towards her. The current Xiao Yao Qin had fully recognized Wu Ningzhu as its master, allowing her to touch it freely.

Wu Ningzhu’s eyes revealed a hint of surprise. She was proficient in music since young. She once had a qin as her weapon. Obtaining a Sovereign weapon in the form of the qin, nothing could make her happier.
Then, both of her hands formed seals, sucking out the pool of flames which was only the size of a fist from the Xiao Yao Qin. It was small but dense.
“Little Chen, this is the Fire of Sun.”

Wu Ningzhu whispered to Jiang Chen. She waved and the fire rushed towards Jiang Chen in a ray of golden light. His eyes twitched. Hastily, he took out his hand to grasp the fire. He had already possessed three types of supreme flames. If he could have this flame as well, the benefits would be beyond imagination.

sentences.text: Extra dose of the week!
The bloodline of the ancient Golden Crow, the Divine Bird of the Sun was unimaginably powerful.
Putting aside how much it could aid in her future cultivation after acquiring it, the bloodline itself was enough to improve her cultivation base by leaps and bounds.
“The inheritance of the Great Sovereign is enviable.” Yang Lang showed a look of envy.
“This is the blessing brought by the bloodline.
Sister Ning hasn’t even gotten the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao yet.
If she is able to master the divine musical notes of Empress Xiao Yao, she will be invincible,” Big Yellow said with a smile.
He was crystal clear about Empress Xiao Yao and was incomparably happy that the Empress had succeeded in finding her descendant who turned out to be his ally.
There was nothing better than this.
“Amazing!”
Mo Wuqing too, displayed an admiring look.
Who wouldn’t admire someone with such heaven-defying luck and talent?
It would surely be wonderful if he was the one in the scene.
*Hong...*
A powerful force suddenly burst out from Wu Ningzhu’s body.
Her cultivation base had broken through to the early Immortal Emperor realm.
After the rebirth, the Fire of Sun surrounding her became intensely strong, but this time, it didn’t seem to have any effect on her.
Instead, because she had inherited the Golden Crow’s bloodline, the fire seemed to behave intimately towards her.
It could be seen that the current relationship between Wu Ningzhu and the Fire of Sun was akin to the relationship between Jiang Chen and the True Dragon Fire.
The fire had completely integrated with her and was under her complete control.
“Dammit!
She has actually succeeded!
And her cultivation base is improving by leaps and bounds.”
Nanbei Chao’s facial expression darkened dramatically.
The outcome was what he least anticipated.
“Nanbei Chao, I wanted very badly to know how you are feeling right now.
I know that you aren’t feeling very well at all.
So why don’t you say it out and amuse us?
Hahaha...” Dragon Shisan sneered.
He would never let go of this chance.
“Humph!
The outcome is still not concluded yet.
So what if she has acquired the inheritance?
I still won’t put her in my eyes.” Nanbei Chao snorted coldly and arrogantly.
“Nanbei Chao, if I were you, I’d just run away now.
Otherwise, when Sister Ning grows to an extent where she can kill you on the spot, you won’t have the chance anymore,” said Han Yan in a smile.
He had heard from Jiang Chen about the existence of Nanbei Chao’s true self in the Immortal World.
So he wasn’t really surprised by Nanbei Chao’s presence.
*Hong...*
While they were speaking, Wu Ningzhu’s cultivation base advanced once more, breaking through to the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm, finally stopping when the powerful qi reached the peak.
Some earth-shattering changes had taken place inside of her.
It wasn’t an exaggeration to describe it as casting off her old self and taking on a new one.
“What a pretty angel of the Golden Crow!
Her presence gave out the aura that’s beyond our reach.”
“She’s truly an angel.
She also has the bearing of a powerful female Sovereign.”
Innumerable people were exclaiming with astonishment.
They had never seen such a beautiful lady before.
Not only was she beautiful, but also had a high and mighty demeanour that belonged to a Great Sovereign, inviolable.
On the 40th step, she turned around, glanced at the Xiao Yao Qin suspending in the air above and continued moving upwards.
Her speed was fast.
Very quickly, she reached the 90th step where her movement seemed restricted again.
“That’s the will of the Empress.
The last ten steps is where Empress Xiao Yao will instill her will into Sister Ning.
It won’t be as difficult as being reborn from the fire.
Since Sister Ning has passed that stage, she will no longer face any life-threatening danger.
As long as she carries the will of the Empress, she will be able to wield the Xiao Yao Qin.
At the same time, she can also enter the ancient palace and acquire the true inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao,” explained Big Yellow.
He seemed to have all the knowledge in the world.
What’s left now was the will of Empress Xiao Yao.
As long as she passed this stage, it will be considered a true success.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*
The pressure in the last ten steps was incredibly immense.
It was no longer the pressure of flames, but the invisible might of the Great Sovereign.
All of the pressure came from the Xiao Yao Qin.
It was trying to instill the supreme will of the Empress to its future master.
“It’s really the right decision to bring Sister Ning along.
Otherwise, she’s going to miss this extraordinary encounter forever.”
Jiang Chen sighed with relief.
He began to feel grateful to his master, Tianji Zi.
If Tianji Zi hadn’t imparted the Great Divination Art to him, he wouldn’t have known how to divine the future.
Without the ability to divine, he wouldn’t have brought Wu Ningzhu here.
If Wu Ningzhu wasn’t present, the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao wouldn’t have emerged.
The Buddha Sect always talked about Karma.
There’s always a result for every action.
Today’s result was because of Jiang Chen.
What happened next happened according to Big Yellow’s expectation.
Although the pressure in the last ten steps was great, it didn’t seem to stop Wu Ningzhu’s footsteps.
In roughly ten minutes, she successfully arrived on the peak, in front of the Xiao Yao Qin.
The Fire of Sun blazed from her eyes.
The current Wu Ningzhu had fully inherited the will of the Great Sovereign.
She stood there like a peerless female goddess, high and mighty and formidable.
“She has succeeded.
She has succeeded in inheriting the will, obtaining the inheritance of the Xiao Yao Qin.
Truly awesome!”
“Such luck is truly enviable.”
“I think we’d better leave now.
We have tried to stop her before this.
A while later, she’s going to acquire the Xiao Yao Qin.
No one can tell how terrifying she will become.
If she’s going to kill us later, our death will be certain.”
“There’s no need to be afraid.
Even if she gets the Xiao Yao Qin, so what?
She’s merely an intermediate Immortal Emperor.
She won’t be able to display the power of the Great Sovereign Weapon.”
While admiring her performance, they also felt fear.
Those who tried to attack Wu Ningzhu earlier were beginning to worry.
She would absolutely get stronger.
Only God knew how powerful the descendant of a Great Sovereign would become.
As such, plenty of them had begun to slip away.
Of course, most of them still stayed on the scene.
They wanted to see for themselves what the birth of a descendant of a Great Sovereign was like.
Furthermore, those late Immortal Emperors weren’t afraid of her.
After all, her cultivation base had yet to reach their level.
On top of the stairs, Wu Ningzhu stuck out her hands to gently touch the ancient qin.
The Xiao Yao Qin let out a buzzing sound, seeming to express its affection towards her.
The current Xiao Yao Qin had fully recognized Wu Ningzhu as its master, allowing her to touch it freely.
Wu Ningzhu’s eyes revealed a hint of surprise.
She was proficient in music since young.
She once had a qin as her weapon.
Obtaining a Sovereign weapon in the form of the qin, nothing could make her happier.
Then, both of her hands formed seals, sucking out the pool of flames which was only the size of a fist from the Xiao Yao Qin.
It was small but dense.
“Little Chen, this is the Fire of Sun.”
Wu Ningzhu whispered to Jiang Chen.
She waved and the fire rushed towards Jiang Chen in a ray of golden light.
His eyes twitched.
Hastily, he took out his hand to grasp the fire.
He had already possessed three types of supreme flames.
If he could have this flame as well, the benefits would be beyond imagination.

chapters.title: Chapter 1647 - The fading ancient palace
paragraphs: 2nd of the week!
The Fire of Sun fell into Jiang Chen’s hands, and immediately, he could sense the scorching heat and immense energy from it.

“Little Chen, this fire is extracted from the Xiao Yao Qin, incomparably precious. Take this opportunity to refine it now. It shouldn’t have a problem pushing your cultivation base one more level. With four types of flames together, your combat strength will surely rise to a very terrifying level.”

Big Yellow hastily advised. One should know that not everyone could acquire the Fire of Sun. If it wasn’t because of Wu Ningzhu, even if the Xiao Yao Qin appeared today, it was highly unlikely for Jiang Chen to obtain the Fire of Sun. Only the one with the Golden Crow bloodline and will of Empress Xiao Yao could extract the Fire of Sun from the Xiao Yao Qin.

Wu Ningzhu knew the importance of this fire to Jiang Chen. Currently, Jiang Chen already had three types of flames, namely: True Dragon Fire, True Thunderfire and Qilin Saint Fire. If he could incorporate the Golden Crow’s Fire of Sun into his list of fire, the enhancement would be beyond imagination.

At that time, he would possess four types of flames. Each flame was an unparalleled treasure that people would risk their lives for, especially to those alchemists. Most of them couldn’t even acquire any one of these flames in their lifetime. Jiang Chen, on the other hand, had obtained four of them. Such luck was absolutely heaven-defying.

If it was someone else who obtained these four types of supreme flames, he wouldn’t be able to refine it. It wasn’t an easy task to refine a supreme flame, let alone four of them. Across the Heavens and Earth, it was afraid that only the dragon transformation skill could perform such a feat.
“Alright.”

Jiang Chen nodded, and swallowed the Fire of Sun in one gulp. There was nothing more important than improving his cultivation base now. Today’s battle made him understand the gap between his strength and the others. There were too many geniuses in the Immortal World, and many of them were endowed with monstrous talent, especially Nanbei Cao, the fated enemy he would have a life-or-death battle with someday, he’s still not a match for Nanbei Chao presently. As such, improvement was the crucial element in his path. Only then could he narrow the gap between him and Nanbei Chao.

The way he refined the Fire of Sun made everyone open their mouths wide. Those who understood him, Han Yan, Big Yellow, Tyrant, Yang Bufan and Dragon Shisan, didn’t seem surprised. After all, Jiang Chen had been labelled as abnormal in their eyes. Even if there was something unbelievable happening to him, they would view it as something common.

Yang Lang, Mo Wuqing, Lan Lingji and the rest, however, found it hard to accept. They were geniuses and naturally knew what the fire was. It was the fire of the Heavens and Earth, the great Fire of Sun. If they were the one who got the fire, they could only refine it bit by bit, and absorb it shred by shred, slowly integrating themselves with the flame, and the process would at least take a month to complete. Plus, they must be someone who cultivated the fire attributes.
They didn’t dare to imagine themselves refining the Fire of Sun the way Jiang Chen swallowed it like swallowing dates, let alone actually doing it.
*Hong...*

The instant the Fire of Sun entered his mouth, powerful energy of flame was spurted out from his body. Owing to Jiang Chen’s incredible physique, he was able to bear this kind of powerful impact, even inside his body. The dragon transformation skill was circulating rapidly. The essence of the Fire of Sun began to be absorbed by him and the number of dragon marks in his Qi Sea was rising.

At first, the Fire of Sun clashed violently with the other three types of fire, but the situation quickly recovered under the adjustment of the dragon transformation skill. Not only they did stop clashing around, they began to merged together at a rapid speed.

In his Qi Sea, the number of dragon marks was condensing unceasingly. The number of dragon marks in his body has reached 1 240 000, leaving him only 10 000 more to hit the mark of the half-step Immortal Emperor realm. The blessing of the Fire of Sun was enough to condense another 50 000 dragon marks in his body within a short period of time, allowing him to advance a realm higher, pushing his cultivation base to the peak of the half-step Immortal Emperor realm.
*Bang!*
Very soon, an incredible energy surged out from Jiang Chen’s body and his qi began to rise continuously. An immense amount of Immortal Meta Stones were being refined by him.
“What?”

Yang Lang and Mo Wuqing were rendered speechless, rolling their eyes. They finally witnessed a real freak. The fact that he could engulf the Fire of Sun in a single gulp was already shocking enough. Not long after that, he advanced to the half-step Immortal Emperor realm. It was just too fast and unbelievable.
“How could there be such an abnormal expert in this world?”

Hua Qiaoqian too, was rendered speechless. They hadn’t paid much attention to Jiang Chen, though they had realized his horrifying and monstrous abilities. The scene of Jiang Chen’s advancement truly made them feel as if they had lived in vain.
After reaching the half-step Immortal Emperor realm, his qi didn’t show any signs of stopping, heading persistently towards the pinnacle of the half-step Immortal Emperor realm.
“Humph! Even though he has advanced another realm, he’s still no match for me. It’s only a matter of time before I kill him.”

Nanbei Chao harrumphed coldly. Seeing Wu Ningzhu successfully obtaining the Great Sovereign’s inheritance and Jiang Chen successfully advancing another realm after obtaining the Fire of Sun, unpleasantness was churning inside of him.
“Two of your clones had died in my hands. That means I can kill you as well. What’s there to be proud of?”
Jiang Chen showed no leniency towards Nanbei Chao. He would never lower his pride in front of him.
In the sky above, Wu Ningzhu held the Xiao Yao Qin in her hands and the doors of the ancient palace flung open on its own. She then walked into it.
*Hong Long...*
The sky trembled once more. The fiery stairs had vanished. The ancient palace seemed to be retreating back into the opening in the void, fading.
The situation made Jiang Chen and Big Yellow panic, because Wu Ningzhu was still in the palace.
“What’s going on? Could it be that the ancient palace is going back to its slumber?” asked Jiang Chen while he was refining the Fire of Sun.

“Little Chen, don’t worry about me. I will inherit the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao here. So I won’t be able to leave here for a period of time. You have to be careful. The fire that I gave you will display even greater effects when the doors of the Golden Clan are opened.”

The voice of Wu Ningzhu was heard in Jiang Chen’s head. Then, the ancient palace disappeared completely. The whole scene became silent once more, just like ten thousand years ago, as though nothing had ever taken place.

chapters.title: Chapter 1648 - Beating Up Nanbei Chao
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
“It disappeared. The ancient palace and the Xiao Yao Qin have vanished. Wu Ningzhu too has disappeared. What’s going on?”

“Don’t you understand? Empress Xiao Yao has already found her descendant. Wu Ningzhu is going to inherit the legacy of Empress Xiao Yao in the palace and won’t be getting out for a period of time. However, it’s imaginable that when she comes out of it, another stunning monstrous genius will emerge in the Immortal World.”
“That’s true. Not only has she gotten the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao, but also the bloodline of the Golden Crow. A figure like her is bound to be extraordinary.”

The simultaneous disappearance of the ancient palace, the Xiao Yao Qin and the girl set off a wave of commotion. After all, none of them had expected this. They all thought that Wu Ningzhu would display her divine power after acquiring the Xiao Yao Qin.

Jiang Chen’s eyes looked unblinkingly at where Wu Ningzhu had vanished. Although he knew that Wu Ningzhu was no longer in any danger, and was going to acquire something great, he felt somewhat upset watching Wu Ningzhu leave him. He had no idea how long she would be away, perhaps a year, or half a year or more, or perhaps just like Yan Chenyu who hadn’t been at his side since his ascension.
“Little Chen, don’t worry about it, Sister Ning will be fine.” Han Yan patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder comfortingly. He could feel that Jiang Chen’s feeling was pretty messed up now.

“It won’t be easy to refine the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao. The divine musical note alone will require a long time to refine. We ought to feel happy for Sister Ning. After all, she has obtained her own fortune. Her future achievements is surely going to be immeasurable. It isn’t impossible for her to reach the same height as Empress Xiao Yao when the time comes,” said Big Yellow.
Apart from the element of comfort, there were also facts. A huge transformation had taken place in Wu Ningzhu. The height she would attain in the future was beyond anyone’s imagination.
“I know, you all don’t have to comfort me. I, Jiang Chen, am not that fragile.”
Jiang Chen smiled. Although he felt slightly disappointed about the disappearance of Wu Ningzhu, it hadn’t reached the extent where he needed comforting, as he understood Wu Ningzhu very well.

Presently, his body had condensed 50 000 dragon marks, reaching a total of 1 290 000 - the peak of half-step Immortal Emperor realm. Leaving him only a step away to reach the next realm. Jiang Chen’s current combat strength was incomparable back then. To put it bluntly, he had the strength to even kill late Immortal Emperor geniuses.
“Little Chen, your present strength has become a lot scarier than before.” Tyrant said with a smile.

“That’s right. The absorption and integration of the Fire of Sun have not only improved my cultivation base, but also tremendously enhanced my combat strength. I also intend to create a technique with these four supreme flames,” said Jiang Chen.

Being a grandmaster in his previous life, he knew that it was incredibly difficult to create a technique, however he was confident in it. With the dragon transformation skill as his foundation and the four flames, if he could create an earth-shattering battle technique, its power would surely be incomparably terrifying, and could incinerate all things in the Heavens and Earth.

Speaking of flames, no one would dare to proclaim themselves the greatest even if Jiang Chen proclaimed himself as second, because not even the unparalleled Fire Venerable could possess True Dragon Fire, True Thunderfire, Qilin Saint Fire and Fire of Sun at the same time. Each of these fires was a heaven-defying existence. The force that could explode from these four flames together was inconceivable.

However, creating an immortal technique couldn’t be done overnight. It required luck and coincidence. Jiang Chen wasn’t in a hurry anyway as he had already acquired the mighty flame. He could take his time to comprehend it, and then, he would surely create an earth-shocking immortal technique with the guidance of the dragon transformation skill.
“The Great Sovereign’s inheritance has disappeared. Let’s leave this place.”
“There are still a dozen days left before the expedition ends. I’d better find my fortune elsewhere, otherwise, my trip here will be in vain.”

“Even the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao has emerged. I wonder if the secret of the Golden Clan will be unearthed in the end. I heard that this clan is incredibly terrifying. So the benefits from it would certainly be massive.”

The crowd began to disperse. It was pointless for them to continue staying on the scene. Most of them were in a rush as they had yet to obtain any benefits since entering Golden Horizon. They didn’t want to continue wasting time.

As for those from major powers that were hostile to Jiang Chen, although they still wanted to kill Jiang Chen very much, they had no choice but to leave the scene after observing the encampment of Jiang Chen again. They were people who knew their own limits. If they charged at him right now, not only could they not kill Jiang Chen, they would also be burned to death instead, costing them their lives.
Previously, they had hope in eliminating Jiang Chen because there was help from a few hundred people. Now that most of them had left. They stood no chance before Jiang Chen.

“Humph! I will let him live a few more days. After I find an inheritance of an ancient Sovereign and advance to the half-step Immortal Venerable, I will kill him and shred him to pieces, so that no trouble would be left behind.” A late Immortal Emperor of Yellow Spring Sect harrumphed coldly before he flew away out of sight.

More than half of the time was still left in the expedition. They couldn’t be emotionally affected by the inheritance of a Great Sovereign. Besides, the incident had drawn a huge number of geniuses. The sight of Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan, Nanbei Chao, Zhang Yulang and other peerless geniuses gave them tremendous pressure. They were their eye-opener, making them understand the gap between themselves and these rare geniuses. Therefore, they had to look for their own fortunes quickly, otherwise they wouldn’t be able to shine in this generation and would be drowned amongst the massive geniuses as a nobody.

“Jiang Chen, today I will spare your life. The next time we meet again, I will surely kill you. Not just you, but all of you.” Nanbei Chao looked down from above, leaving a line of arrogant and ruthless words, before turning and leaving.
“Why does it have to be next time? You can’t just leave today.”
Jiang Chen’s qi fluctuated, instantly, he turned into his dragon form and yelled. “Brothers, let’s do it together. Let’s beat him up even if we can’t kill him.”

Everything that happened today was because of Nanbei Chao. It would be too kind of them if they let him go just like this. Although Jiang Chen was still not powerful enough to defeat Nanbei Chao, he had the strength to fight this opponent. And with help of so many brothers, he would certainly teach Nanbei Chao some lessons and bash his high and mighty head.
“Hit him!” Big Yellow laughed heartily. He was the first to act.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*

All of them—Big Yellow, Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan, Tyrant, Han Yan, Yang Lang, Lan Lingji, Mo Wuqing— rushed out and surrounded Nanbei Chao in an instant. There was naturally nothing more to say about Mo Wuqing as he wanted to hit Nanbei Chao more than anyone. Back on the Broken Edge Cliff, if it wasn’t because of his fast reaction, he would have died in Nanbei Chao’s hands. He was naturally no match for Nanbei Chao in a one-versus-one fight, but now that everyone was joining forces, he wouldn’t hesitate anymore. It was time for him to seek revenge from this bastard now.

All the attackers were geniuses of the geniuses. Each of them unleashed their qi and killing intent. Big Yellow had sealed the void around, seemingly determined to trap Nanbei Chao here until he was killed.

Nanbei Chao’s facial expression finally changed a little upon seeing such an encampment. If these people fought him one by one, he wouldn’t be afraid, but now they had all joined together to fight him. One Dragon Shisan was already enough to trouble him.
“Dragon Shisan, Jiang Chen, don’t you feel shameless for fighting me with so many of you?” Nanbei Chao spoke coldly.

“Shameless? Why are you talking about face when you yourself is a shameless bastard? If you kneel down and kowtow and call me Master Monkey, I will spare your life, what do you say?” Dragon Shisan was carrying the iron staff on his shoulders as he spoke in a strange tone.
*Hong...*

An extremely strong fury burst out of Nanbei Chao’s body. He had never felt such rage. He was a high and mighty figure with the bloodline of a Monarch. He was always the one who asked people to kneel before him, not the other way around. Dragon Shisan was the first to speak those words. And this alone gave him all the reason to kill Dragon Shisan.
“Humph! A bunch of insects. You think you can defeat me now that you have joined forces? How ridiculous!” Nanbei Chao snorted coldly, emanating dense Monarch qi.
“Cut your crap. Beat him.”
Jiang Chen’s qi was incredible. He had launched out the Qilin Divine Arm and True Dragon Palm, reaching Nanbei Chao in the blink of an eye and smashed at him.
*Roar...*

At the same time, Big Yellow let out a world-shaking roar. His body became incomparably sturdy. There was a mystical character flickering continuously on his glabella until it became an ancient pattern while he was lunging forward violently.

Han Yan and Tyrant also struck. One with the body of a Combat Devil, the other with the Body of Dao Light Buddha. No one would dare to show any neglect in front of Nanbei Chao. All of them launched out their most powerful attack.

“It disappeared.
The ancient palace and the Xiao Yao Qin have vanished.
Wu Ningzhu too has disappeared.
What’s going on?”
“Don’t you understand?
Empress Xiao Yao has already found her descendant.
Wu Ningzhu is going to inherit the legacy of Empress Xiao Yao in the palace and won’t be getting out for a period of time.
However, it’s imaginable that when she comes out of it, another stunning monstrous genius will emerge in the Immortal World.”
“That’s true.
Not only has she gotten the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao, but also the bloodline of the Golden Crow.
A figure like her is bound to be extraordinary.”
The simultaneous disappearance of the ancient palace, the Xiao Yao Qin and the girl set off a wave of commotion.
After all, none of them had expected this.
They all thought that Wu Ningzhu would display her divine power after acquiring the Xiao Yao Qin.

He had no idea how long she would be away, perhaps a year, or half a year or more, or perhaps just like Yan Chenyu who hadn’t been at his side since his ascension.
“Little Chen, don’t worry about it, Sister Ning will be fine.” Han Yan patted Jiang Chen’s shoulder comfortingly.
He could feel that Jiang Chen’s feeling was pretty messed up now.
“It won’t be easy to refine the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao.
The divine musical note alone will require a long time to refine.
We ought to feel happy for Sister Ning.
After all, she has obtained her own fortune.
Her future achievements is surely going to be immeasurable.
It isn’t impossible for her to reach the same height as Empress Xiao Yao when the time comes,” said Big Yellow.
Apart from the element of comfort, there were also facts.
A huge transformation had taken place in Wu Ningzhu.
The height she would attain in the future was beyond anyone’s imagination.
“I know, you all don’t have to comfort me.
I, Jiang Chen, am not that fragile.”
Jiang Chen smiled.
Although he felt slightly disappointed about the disappearance of Wu Ningzhu, it hadn’t reached the extent where he needed comforting, as he understood Wu Ningzhu very well.
Presently, his body had condensed 50 000 dragon marks, reaching a total of 1 290 000 - the peak of half-step Immortal Emperor realm.
Leaving him only a step away to reach the next realm.
Jiang Chen’s current combat strength was incomparable back then.
To put it bluntly, he had the strength to even kill late Immortal Emperor geniuses.

The absorption and integration of the Fire of Sun have not only improved my cultivation base, but also tremendously enhanced my combat strength.
I also intend to create a technique with these four supreme flames,” said Jiang Chen.
Being a grandmaster in his previous life, he knew that it was incredibly difficult to create a technique, however he was confident in it.

With the dragon transformation skill as his foundation and the four flames, if he could create an earth-shattering battle technique, its power would surely be incomparably terrifying, and could incinerate all things in the Heavens and Earth.

Speaking of flames, no one would dare to proclaim themselves the greatest even if Jiang Chen proclaimed himself as second, because not even the unparalleled Fire Venerable could possess True Dragon Fire, True Thunderfire, Qilin Saint Fire and Fire of Sun at the same time.
Each of these fires was a heaven-defying existence.
The force that could explode from these four flames together was inconceivable.
However, creating an immortal technique couldn’t be done overnight.
It required luck and coincidence.
Jiang Chen wasn’t in a hurry anyway as he had already acquired the mighty flame.
He could take his time to comprehend it, and then, he would surely create an earth-shocking immortal technique with the guidance of the dragon transformation skill.
“The Great Sovereign’s inheritance has disappeared.
Let’s leave this place.”
“There are still a dozen days left before the expedition ends.
I’d better find my fortune elsewhere, otherwise, my trip here will be in vain.”
“Even the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao has emerged.
I wonder if the secret of the Golden Clan will be unearthed in the end.
I heard that this clan is incredibly terrifying.
So the benefits from it would certainly be massive.”
The crowd began to disperse.
It was pointless for them to continue staying on the scene.
Most of them were in a rush as they had yet to obtain any benefits since entering Golden Horizon.
They didn’t want to continue wasting time.

As for those from major powers that were hostile to Jiang Chen, although they still wanted to kill Jiang Chen very much, they had no choice but to leave the scene after observing the encampment of Jiang Chen again.
They were people who knew their own limits.
If they charged at him right now, not only could they not kill Jiang Chen, they would also be burned to death instead, costing them their lives.
Previously, they had hope in eliminating Jiang Chen because there was help from a few hundred people.
Now that most of them had left.
They stood no chance before Jiang Chen.
“Humph!
I will let him live a few more days.

After I find an inheritance of an ancient Sovereign and advance to the half-step Immortal Venerable, I will kill him and shred him to pieces, so that no trouble would be left behind.” A late Immortal Emperor of Yellow Spring Sect harrumphed coldly before he flew away out of sight.
More than half of the time was still left in the expedition.
They couldn’t be emotionally affected by the inheritance of a Great Sovereign.
Besides, the incident had drawn a huge number of geniuses.
The sight of Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan, Nanbei Chao, Zhang Yulang and other peerless geniuses gave them tremendous pressure.
They were their eye-opener, making them understand the gap between themselves and these rare geniuses.
Therefore, they had to look for their own fortunes quickly, otherwise they wouldn’t be able to shine in this generation and would be drowned amongst the massive geniuses as a nobody.
“Jiang Chen, today I will spare your life.
The next time we meet again, I will surely kill you.
Not just you, but all of you.” Nanbei Chao looked down from above, leaving a line of arrogant and ruthless words, before turning and leaving.
“Why does it have to be next time?
You can’t just leave today.”
Jiang Chen’s qi fluctuated, instantly, he turned into his dragon form and yelled.
“Brothers, let’s do it together.
Let’s beat him up even if we can’t kill him.”
Everything that happened today was because of Nanbei Chao.
It would be too kind of them if they let him go just like this.
Although Jiang Chen was still not powerful enough to defeat Nanbei Chao, he had the strength to fight this opponent.
And with help of so many brothers, he would certainly teach Nanbei Chao some lessons and bash his high and mighty head.
“Hit him!” Big Yellow laughed heartily.
He was the first to act.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*
All of them—Big Yellow, Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan, Tyrant, Han Yan, Yang Lang, Lan Lingji, Mo Wuqing— rushed out and surrounded Nanbei Chao in an instant.
There was naturally nothing more to say about Mo Wuqing as he wanted to hit Nanbei Chao more than anyone.
Back on the Broken Edge Cliff, if it wasn’t because of his fast reaction, he would have died in Nanbei Chao’s hands.
He was naturally no match for Nanbei Chao in a one-versus-one fight, but now that everyone was joining forces, he wouldn’t hesitate anymore.
It was time for him to seek revenge from this bastard now.
All the attackers were geniuses of the geniuses.

Dragon Shisan was the first to speak those words.

How ridiculous!” Nanbei Chao snorted coldly, emanating dense Monarch qi.
