chapters.title: Chapter 1657 - Instant Kill
paragraphs: 8th of the week!
“Haha...”

Upon hearing Jiang Chen’s words, Nanbei Jing burst into laughter, as though he had heard something extremely funny. He understood what Jiang Chen meant. Jiang Chen was going to kill him, but unfortunately, how could he be killed so easily? If he died under a half-step Immortal Emperor’s hands, he would have no face left.

But in the next moment, the smile on his face froze once more. He could feel an incredibly dangerous qi coming from behind. This time, it felt as if his heart had stopped beating. He didn’t even know who the attacker was. Immediately, he dodged.
*Bang!* *Ah!*

Despite his fast reaction, he still couldn’t avoid it entirely. The attacker was no stranger, he’s Big Yellow who had channeled the energy of his body onto his skull and was smashed aggressively at Nanbei Jing. His attack speed was as quick as lightning.

Furthermore, the current Big Yellow was already a late Immortal Emperor. Nanbei Jing was totally not his match. Even if they fought one on one, Nanbei Jing still wouldn’t be able to resist Big Yellow, let alone when it was a sneak attack coming from Nanbei Jing’s back. Along with a wail, half of Nanbei Jing’s body was smashed to pieces. Only the other half managed to escape from the attack. The scene was tragic to look at.
“Playing sneak attack in front of Master Dog? I don’t think you know how to write the word ‘death’.” Big Yellow yelled disapprovingly.

One had to say that this was a real tragedy. Although Nanbei Jing was proficient in sneak attacks, he had chosen the wrong target. Sneak attacks were simply useless in front of someone who cultivated the Great Soul Derivation Technique, Great Divination Art and Great Void Technique, because any slight fluctuation could be accurately sensed by the target.

What was even more unfortunate was that he had ignored the huge yellow dog—the master of sneak attack—behind him. Facts had already proven that any opponent who underestimated Big Yellow would end up in a very miserable situation. Nanbei Jing was just one of the many examples.
“Ah! You damned dog!”

Nanbei Jing let out a blood-curdling scream. At this time, a few geniuses from Nanbei Family emerged, hastily coming to Nanbei Jing’s aid. There was a late Immortal Emperor and one early Immortal Emperor amongst them while the rest were intermediate Immortal Emperors. It only showed how strong the forces of Nanbei Family was. As for the reincarnation of the Great Sovereign, Young Master Chao, he hadn’t shown up ever since that incident. No one knew where he had gone to.

The movement here had immediately alarmed numerous people, attracting countless of gazes, but they weren’t taken aback. All of them knew about the grudges between Jiang Chen and Nanbei Family. It was only logical to see a fight break out between them. It was just that the condition of Nanbei Jing was somewhat tragic.
“Terrifying. That dog is even scarier compared to last time. And that Jiang Chen, I wonder what technique he has cultivated that allowed him to dodge the sneak attack of Nanbei Jing so easily.”

“Ai! It seems like as long as Jiang Chen is here, there won’t be peace. He’s a troublemaker and has already offended too many people and major powers. He is always accompanied by killings and battles wherever he goes. Despite it all, I’m still quite impressed by him. If it was anyone else who offended so many geniuses, he would have died long ago. Jiang Chen, on the other hand, is still alive until today, and many geniuses have already died under his hands.”

“This is a man with great fortune. Despite the countless number of geniuses that wanted to kill him, he is still very much alive and has grown to the point where it has become very difficult to kill him.”

“We’ll see. There will be even more intense battles when the doors of the Golden Clan are opened. Too many people wanted Jiang Chen dead. Quite a few half-step Immortal Venerables have been born at this point. I wonder if Jiang Chen can still survive this time.”

Discussions resounded in the air. Jiang Chen was already a well-known figure. He set off storms anywhere he went. Just like now, a battle had started with the geniuses of Nanbei Family the moment he arrived here.
“Jiang Chen, you are courting death!”

The late Immortal Emperor of Nanbei Family spoke through gritted teeth. He’s called Nanbei Zhong, a powerful figure like Nanbei Jing. It was imaginable how infuriated he was right now after seeing Nanbei Jing’s current condition. The other geniuses of Nanbei Family were also staring maliciously at Jiang Chen and Big Yellow with unconcealed killing intent.

“You will know who will die soon. Since you all have come, then I will eliminate all of you together. Your family has already made me an enemy. It’s only a matter of time before your family is annihilated.”
Jiang Chen spoke plainly. Across the entire Immortal World, it was afraid that there was only Jiang Chen who would dare to make such a wild declaration of annihilating an ancient family.
“Big Yellow, kill them all!”
Jiang Chen shouted. One man and one dog lunged at the geniuses of Nanbei Family in two rays of light. No mercy should be shown when it comes to killing the people of Nanbei Family.

Big Yellow laughed heartily. Such killing was his favourite. Now that he had advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm, he was virtually invincible in the Golden Horizon. It was impossible for those half-step Immortal Venerables to kill him. So naturally, these geniuses from Nanbei Family were no threat to him.
*Keng!*

Jiang Chen summoned his Heavenly Saint Sword. With the Great Void Technique, he could appear anywhere in an instant. Compared to Nanbei Jing, the gap of power was just too great. The Great Void Technique was even more terrifying compared to the Nine Phantom Wolves.
*Puff!*

Along with a wail, one of the intermediate Immortal Emperor geniuses was slashed in half by Jiang Chen, dying on the spot even before he could put up any resistance. The two of them were at two totally different levels.

On the other side, Big Yellow rushed forward. Nanbei Zhong was left with no option other than to face the dog head-on. After all, Big Yellow’s a late Immortal Emperor. The others would only die if they went for the attack.
As a matter of fact, Jiang Chen was a disaster to all of them.
“Argh...” “Argh...” “Argh...”

The shrieks were incessant. In merely a few blinks, all the geniuses of Nanbei Family died a tragic death under Jiang Chen’s sword. All of them were severed in half. Now, the only one left was the half-bodied Nanbei Jing, watching Jiang Chen in front of him in horror, as though he was looking at the god of death.

Both of Nanbei Zhong’s eyes went red, however he was no match for Big Yellow, let alone Jiang Chen. All the geniuses of Nanbei Family were killed in an instant. This had made it hard for Nanbei Jing to accept it. He finally understood that Jiang Chen had already grown to a very terrifying extent that anyone who confronted him would die without a doubt.

chapters.title: Chapter 1658 - Become the Atmosphere
paragraphs: 1st of the week!
“Jiang-Jiang Chen, what are you doing?”

The half-bodied Nanbei Jing looked in horror at the approaching Jiang Chen. His voice began to quaver. The fear inside of him had reached its peak after seeing Jiang Chen’s ruthlessness. As a first-class genius of Nanbei Family, he had never thought that he would die one day. He had never seen someone as horrifying as Jiang Chen.
“What am I doing? That’s a very idiotic question.”

Jiang Chen shook his head. Without conversing any further, he lifted the long sword and beheaded Nanbei Jing. Then, Nanbei Jing’s identity brocade pouch fell automatically into Jiang Chen’s hand. Jiang Chen had collected quite a lot of brocade pouches, but he had yet to check the items in them. This was because he knew that all the geniuses that found a treasure would immediately consume and refine it to improve their cultivation base and combat strenght. No one would keep those benefits in their belongings. He was afraid that there weren’t any valuable treasures in those pouches that’s why it didn’t really attract his interest.
After killing Nanbei Jing, Jiang Chen lunged at Nanbei Zhong with his sword. He absolutely wouldn’t let any geniuses of Nanbei Family go .

“This Jiang Chen is truly a monstrous genius. His progress is a little too fast. Although his cultivation base is still the same as ten days ago, why do I feel that he’s a lot more powerful now? Could this be an illusion?”

“This is no illusion. Such a figure is making progress all the time. He simply can’t be judge using common sense. It’s a real tragedy to the Nanbei family. So many of their geniuses had died, including Nanbei Jing. This is going to be a huge loss to them. Now, it seems like Nanbei Zhong won’t be able to escape his fate as well. He isn’t a match for the dog at all. Adding the fact that he’s being targeted by Jiang Chen as well, his life is definitely in danger.”

“That’s terrifying! A massacre has already broken out before the doors of the Golden Clan opened. We should stay away from Jiang Chen and his comrades from now on. This man is too unruly. Killing a late Immortal Emperor is as easy as cutting melon to him. I wouldn’t have believed this without witnessing this with my own eyes.”

Everyone was shocked. Despite knowing the brutality of Jiang Chen, they were still startled by what they saw. Many people secretly warned themselves that they must not become enemies of such a god of slaughter, or else they wouldn’t have a good end. Despite being one of the two ancient big families in Eastern Profound Domain and having a Sovereign’s reincarnation in the family, its geniuses still met a tragic death. Even the Sovereign’s reincarnation was beaten until he ran with his tail between his legs ten days ago.
“Go!”

Nanbei Zhong yelled all of a sudden, immediately rushing towards one direction in a ray of light. A wise man doesn’t fight when the odds are against him. He wasn’t a fool. Knowing that he stood no chance in front of Big Yellow and Jiang Chen, he would only end up like Nanbei Jing if he continued to stay.
“You can’t run away from me.”

With a sway of his body, he locked on the qi and route of Nanbei Zhong. A sword light that looked like a heavenly river was slashed out from the Heavenly Saint Sword, instantly forcing Nanbei Zhong out from the interior of the void.
“How could this be possible?”

Nanbei Zhong was in shock. He couldn’t imagine how Jiang Chen was able to lock onto his position so accurately. One should know that a late Immortal Emperor had very precise control of the spatial force, which meant that their mastery of the spatial force had already reached near perfection. So it was incomparably easy for them to escape.
But now, Jiang Chen seemed to have located his position straightaway, snatching away his chance of escaping. He couldn’t help being surprised by this.

This was the mystery of the Great Void Technique. The inheritance that was left by the Void Sovereign could never be compared to ordinary secret arts. It would be very difficult to escape from the Great Void Technique.

Big Yellow laughed sinisterly then charged his indestructible head at Nanbei Zhong. He could already see that Jiang Chen had already mastered the early stage of the Great Void Technique. This was something worth celebrating.
*Bang!*

Nanbei Zhong had lost his focus. Also, Big Yellow’s attack power was just too aggressive and very fast, Nanbei Zhong was sent flying away. The dog’s head pounded on the chest of Nanbei Zhong, causing a huge dent. He was spurting blood crazily along the way.
*Swoosh!*

Jiang Chen’s speed was even faster. He moved like a shadow and caught up with the injured Nanbei Zhong in an instant. The Heavenly Saint Sword was slashed down mercilessly. While Nanbei Zhong was still in mid-air, he was slashed into halves by Jiang Chen’s sword.
Blood sprinkled from the sky. It was tragic to the extreme. Countless people were freaked out. A late Immortal Emperor supreme genius was killed just like that. That was overly shocking!
“Awesome! I’m afraid that Nanbei Family is surely going to be pissed off this time.”

“Such losses are definitely huge to any major power. Nanbei family is going to go crazy this time. I think there are still geniuses from this family around, but as long as they aren’t fools, they won’t choose to stand out at this time.”

“Jiang Chen has already become the atmosphere. And he isn’t the only one who’s fighting the battle. He’s assisted by a group of monstrous geniuses. This group of geniuses could never be underestimated.”
The geniuses of Nanbei Family including the two late Immortal Emperors were killed the moment they saw Jiang Chen.

At this time, one of the golden passageways was shaking very intensely. An incomparably strong qi rushed out from inside. A youth appeared in the sky like a peerless war god. Everyone could feel an incomparably strong pressure from the qi unleashed from his body. That was the qi of a half-step Immortal Venerable. This realm alone had surpassed everyone on the scene.

The incomer wasn’t a stranger, he was precisely Zhang Yulang, a supreme genius from the Immortal Court of Ethereal Immortal Domain. He has successfully advanced to the half-step Immortal Venerable. In between his brows was full of endless arrogance. His eyes were full of contempt, looking high and mighty as if he disdained all kinds of sentient beings.
After registering Jiang Chen, Big Yellow and those severed corpses, fury blazed in his eyes.
“Jiang Chen, it seems like you are enjoying too much.”

Zhang Yulang spoke. He was close to Nanbei Chao. So his relationship with Nanbei Family was quite good. A grudge had already stirred in him back when the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao emerged. Now that he had succeeded in advancing to the half-step Immortal Venerable realm, he would never put Jiang Chen in his eyes. Killing intent rose inside of him immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 1659 - The Great Void Technique displaying its migh
paragraphs: The Great Void Technique displaying its might
Extra dose of the week!

“Too much? Not at all. Zhang Yulang, I advise you not to mess with me. Otherwise, you will face the same fate as them. The people of Immortal Court are nothing special in front of me. My enemies will only face one outcome in the end, death. Since Nanbei Family has made me their enemy, I will annihilate this huge ancient family soon. If the Immortal Court has the same intention as Nanbei Family, then you all will only face the same fate.”

Jiang Chen totally ignored the incredible killing intent radiating from Zhang Yulang’s body. His tone was arrogant to the extreme. It didn’t concern him even if the opponent was a half-step Immortal Venerable standing in front of him. Such overbearing and earth-shattering qi seemed to have transcended Nanbei Chao’s as well.
Any casual movement of his emitted strong qi of superiority, as if he was the king of the world, and the one who would eventually become the strongest in the world.
*Hua!*

His words immediately set off an uproar. It was crazy enough to declare exterminating an ancient family in public, let alone declaring on taking the place of the Immortal Court. The audacity needed to say such a remark was beyond ordinary. None of them had ever seen such audacity.

“This bastard is truly lawless. No one has ever dared to oppose and blasphemed the Immortal Court, however Jiang Chen has just stated that he will annihilate the Immortal Court as well. He really doesn’t know how to write the word ‘death’.”
“Ai! He’s overly arrogant. How dare he speak such words?! No one has ever opposed the Immortal Court. He must have gotten tired of living.”
“Wicked! He is the first who dared to speak such overbearing words, this alone is enough to impress me.”

Countless sighs were heard. Jiang Chen’s action had stirred the fear inside of them. This was an act of death. Could it be that he really wanted to oppose the Immortal Court publicly and become the number one genius?
“Jiang Chen, what you said is already enough for you to die a hundred times. Who gave you the audacity to defy the Immortal Court?”

Zhang Yulang reprimanded. Being a genius of the Court had always been the thing he was the proudest of. He was respected wherever he went, but now, a puny figure was openly provoking him and the Immortal Court, how ridiculous!

“Haha! Cut your fing crap! Kill me if you can. If you can’t, don’t keep passing gas here. Put away your nobility and don’t use the name of the Immortal Court to oppress me. Enemies will only be enemies in front of me.”
Jiang Chen laughed aloud. His unruliness had reached the point of lawlessness where he didn’t even put the Immortal Court in his eyes.
“I will kill you now then.”

Zhang Yulang was infuriated, unleashing the qi of a half-step Immortal Venerable instantly. His incredible momentum alarmed everyone. Their faces paled, eyes looking at Jiang Chen in a pitiful way. They had no idea how Jiang Chen would be able to fight Zhang Yulang.
They knew that killing a late Immortal Emperor and fighting a half-step Immortal Venerable were entirely two different concepts.
“Little Chen, can you do it?” Big Yellow looked over at Jiang Chen.
“Don’t worry. I’ll be fine.”
Jiang Chen nodded reassuringly. Light flickering in his eyes. He was going to use Zhang Yulang to test the true power of the Great Void Technique.
“Alright.”

Big Yellow was incomparably confident in Jiang Chen. Immediately, he left the battlefield. He wanted to observe how much of the Great Void Technique had been cultivated by Jiang Chen. He believed that if Jiang Chen had really mastered the Great Void Technique, Jiang Chen wouldn’t have trouble dodging Zhang Yulang’s attack.
Zhang Yulang made a step forth into the air; an incomparably dazzling giant hand sealed the void and smashed at Jiang Chen from above.
Innumerable people were startled. The attack of a half-step Immortal Venerable was surely extraordinary. It was hard to imagine if Jiang Chen could withstand such a terrifying blow.
*Hong Long...*
The giant palm blasted down. The void was completely torn and Jiang Chen was completely enshrouded within it.
“Humph! Lack of self-knowledge!”
Zhang Yulang showed a cold sneer. He knew the power of his palm strike. Even a late Immortal Emperor would be crushed to pieces, let alone a puny, little Jiang Chen.
“Lack of self-knowledge? So this is how strong the genius of the Immortal Court is.”

A voice came from another side. Everyone turned towards the source of the voice and saw Jiang Chen standing composedly there. The destructive attack of Zhang Yulang didn’t seem to cause any threat and harm to him.
“What?”
Zhang Yulang’s facial expression changed instantly. Just like Nanbei Jing, he didn’t dare to believe what just happened before his very eyes.
“Goodness! How did that guy do it? That’s super heaven-defying.”

“I clearly saw that he was grasped by Zhang Yulang’s palm. Also, the palm has basically sealed everything in the void. How did Jiang Chen escape from it? And the ferocious attack of Zhang Yulang didn’t do any damage to him in the slightest.”

“Unbelievable. Too unbelievable. I’m afraid Zhang Yulang is going to be petrified this time. Jiang Chen must have gotten some kind of heaven defying secret escaping art that allows him to even get through the interior of the void. Nothing will be able to stop him. Horrifying.”
“If he has really mastered this type of heaven-defying technique, I’m afraid that no one in the entire Golden Horizon will be able to kill him anymore.”

Everyone was shocked. None of them had seen such a heaven-defying expert before. Not only was Jiang Chen’s combat strength terrifying, he also had a heaven-defying escaping technique. Not even Zhang Yulang could deal with him. No one else in the entire Golden Horizon would be able to touch him.
“Interesting, but in front of me, that’s just a puny technique. Jiang Chen, you think that you can save your life with that puny escaping technique of yours? How ignorant!”

After a brief shock, Zhang Yulang once again unleashed killing intent out of his body. Given his abilities, he didn’t believe that he couldn’t kill one Jiang Chen. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be a genius anymore.
“The disciples of major powers always have loads of crap. If I were you, I wouldn’t even speak a crappy word,” said Jiang Chen plainly.
“Courting death!”

Zhang Yulang gritted his teeth. Overwhelming qi waves rushed out of his body like a tide. This time, he used his powerful qi to fully block all the space within a hundred miles. Even the spectators around were enveloped within it. Under such pressure, countless people were shaken. If Zhang Yulang wanted to kill them, they would be dead for sure.
It seemed like Zhang Yulang’s going all out, not giving Jiang Chen a single chance to escape. People began to speculate if Jiang Chen could escape again this time.

sentences.text: The Great Void Technique displaying its might
Extra dose of the week!
“Too much?
Not at all.
Zhang Yulang, I advise you not to mess with me.
Otherwise, you will face the same fate as them.
The people of Immortal Court are nothing special in front of me.
My enemies will only face one outcome in the end, death.
Since Nanbei Family has made me their enemy, I will annihilate this huge ancient family soon.
If the Immortal Court has the same intention as Nanbei Family, then you all will only face the same fate.”
Jiang Chen totally ignored the incredible killing intent radiating from Zhang Yulang’s body.
His tone was arrogant to the extreme.
It didn’t concern him even if the opponent was a half-step Immortal Venerable standing in front of him.
Such overbearing and earth-shattering qi seemed to have transcended Nanbei Chao’s as well.
Any casual movement of his emitted strong qi of superiority, as if he was the king of the world, and the one who would eventually become the strongest in the world.
*Hua!*
His words immediately set off an uproar.
It was crazy enough to declare exterminating an ancient family in public, let alone declaring on taking the place of the Immortal Court.
The audacity needed to say such a remark was beyond ordinary.
None of them had ever seen such audacity.
“This bastard is truly lawless.
No one has ever dared to oppose and blasphemed the Immortal Court, however Jiang Chen has just stated that he will annihilate the Immortal Court as well.
He really doesn’t know how to write the word ‘death’.”
“Ai!
He’s overly arrogant.
How dare he speak such words?!
No one has ever opposed the Immortal Court.
He must have gotten tired of living.”
“Wicked!
He is the first who dared to speak such overbearing words, this alone is enough to impress me.”
Countless sighs were heard.
Jiang Chen’s action had stirred the fear inside of them.
This was an act of death.
Could it be that he really wanted to oppose the Immortal Court publicly and become the number one genius?
“Jiang Chen, what you said is already enough for you to die a hundred times.
Who gave you the audacity to defy the Immortal Court?”
Zhang Yulang reprimanded.
Being a genius of the Court had always been the thing he was the proudest of.
He was respected wherever he went, but now, a puny figure was openly provoking him and the Immortal Court, how ridiculous!
“Haha!
Cut your fing crap!
Kill me if you can.
If you can’t, don’t keep passing gas here.
Put away your nobility and don’t use the name of the Immortal Court to oppress me.
Enemies will only be enemies in front of me.”
Jiang Chen laughed aloud.
His unruliness had reached the point of lawlessness where he didn’t even put the Immortal Court in his eyes.
“I will kill you now then.”
Zhang Yulang was infuriated, unleashing the qi of a half-step Immortal Venerable instantly.
His incredible momentum alarmed everyone.
Their faces paled, eyes looking at Jiang Chen in a pitiful way.
They had no idea how Jiang Chen would be able to fight Zhang Yulang.
They knew that killing a late Immortal Emperor and fighting a half-step Immortal Venerable were entirely two different concepts.
“Little Chen, can you do it?” Big Yellow looked over at Jiang Chen.
“Don’t worry.
I’ll be fine.”
Jiang Chen nodded reassuringly.
Light flickering in his eyes.
He was going to use Zhang Yulang to test the true power of the Great Void Technique.
“Alright.”
Big Yellow was incomparably confident in Jiang Chen.
Immediately, he left the battlefield.
He wanted to observe how much of the Great Void Technique had been cultivated by Jiang Chen.
He believed that if Jiang Chen had really mastered the Great Void Technique, Jiang Chen wouldn’t have trouble dodging Zhang Yulang’s attack.
Zhang Yulang made a step forth into the air; an incomparably dazzling giant hand sealed the void and smashed at Jiang Chen from above.
Innumerable people were startled.
The attack of a half-step Immortal Venerable was surely extraordinary.
It was hard to imagine if Jiang Chen could withstand such a terrifying blow.
*Hong Long...*
The giant palm blasted down.
The void was completely torn and Jiang Chen was completely enshrouded within it.
“Humph!
Lack of self-knowledge!”
Zhang Yulang showed a cold sneer.
He knew the power of his palm strike.
Even a late Immortal Emperor would be crushed to pieces, let alone a puny, little Jiang Chen.
“Lack of self-knowledge?
So this is how strong the genius of the Immortal Court is.”
A voice came from another side.
Everyone turned towards the source of the voice and saw Jiang Chen standing composedly there.
The destructive attack of Zhang Yulang didn’t seem to cause any threat and harm to him.
“What?”
Zhang Yulang’s facial expression changed instantly.
Just like Nanbei Jing, he didn’t dare to believe what just happened before his very eyes.
“Goodness!
How did that guy do it?
That’s super heaven-defying.”
“I clearly saw that he was grasped by Zhang Yulang’s palm.
Also, the palm has basically sealed everything in the void.
How did Jiang Chen escape from it?
And the ferocious attack of Zhang Yulang didn’t do any damage to him in the slightest.”
“Unbelievable.
Too unbelievable.
I’m afraid Zhang Yulang is going to be petrified this time.
Jiang Chen must have gotten some kind of heaven defying secret escaping art that allows him to even get through the interior of the void.
Nothing will be able to stop him.
Horrifying.”
“If he has really mastered this type of heaven-defying technique, I’m afraid that no one in the entire Golden Horizon will be able to kill him anymore.”
Everyone was shocked.
None of them had seen such a heaven-defying expert before.
Not only was Jiang Chen’s combat strength terrifying, he also had a heaven-defying escaping technique.
Not even Zhang Yulang could deal with him.
No one else in the entire Golden Horizon would be able to touch him.
“Interesting, but in front of me, that’s just a puny technique.
Jiang Chen, you think that you can save your life with that puny escaping technique of yours?
How ignorant!”
After a brief shock, Zhang Yulang once again unleashed killing intent out of his body.
Given his abilities, he didn’t believe that he couldn’t kill one Jiang Chen.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t be a genius anymore.
“The disciples of major powers always have loads of crap.
If I were you, I wouldn’t even speak a crappy word,” said Jiang Chen plainly.
“Courting death!”
Zhang Yulang gritted his teeth.
Overwhelming qi waves rushed out of his body like a tide.
This time, he used his powerful qi to fully block all the space within a hundred miles.
Even the spectators around were enveloped within it.
Under such pressure, countless people were shaken.
If Zhang Yulang wanted to kill them, they would be dead for sure.
It seemed like Zhang Yulang’s going all out, not giving Jiang Chen a single chance to escape.
People began to speculate if Jiang Chen could escape again this time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1660 - Walking at the Crevice of the Void
paragraphs: 2nd of the week!

In the face of Zhang Yulang’s powerful attack, Jiang Chen’s expression began to become somewhat grim. In terms of cultivation base, he was absolutely no match for Zhang Yulang. There was still a huge gap between them. The greatest reliance Jiang Chen had in fighting Zhang Yulang was the Great Void Technique.

Currently, Zhang Yulang had gone berserk. The entire void was virtually sealed by him, making Jiang Chen take the battle seriously. However, Jiang Chen still didn’t fear him. He absolutely believed that the Great Void Technique would be able to deal with the opponent.

The attack contained a vast amount of energy. Although it wasn’t the most powerful attack of Zhang Yulang, the destruction it could cause was earth-shattering. It was a powerful attack from a half-step Immortal Venerable. And although he was merely a half-step Immortal Venerable, he was afraid that not even an early Immortal Venerable was a match for him.
That’s why Zhang Yulang went frenzied. If he couldn’t kill Jiang Chen, given his cultivation base, it would surely be a huge disgrace.
“Jiang Chen, I would like to see how you can avoid this.”
Zhang Yulang’s voice reverberated across the sky. He was determined to kill Jiang Chen to establish his prestige.

At this time, Jiang Chen shut his eyes completely. Then, he cast out the Great Soul Derivation Technique and Great Void Technique simultaneously, and realized that all the spaces around him had been firmly locked by Zhang Yulang. There was no exit.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

However the Great Void Technique was no ordinary skill. The spatial force outside Jiang Chen’s body began to ripple, erupting a buzzing sound. He could feel an immense and mountainous energy around pressing hard against him.
“Great Void Technique. Invisible Escape.”

Jiang Chen said in an undertone. With a sway of his body, he disappeared once more, through the void sealed by Zhang Yulang, and into the crevice of space. This was a very dangerous act. Not even a mighty Venerable would dare to step into the gap between the spaces easily. Once he entered the turbulent air current, he would be forever trapped in there.

But Jiang Chen who cultivated the Great Void Technique didn’t hesitate to perform such an act. He had very strong senses of the spatial crevice, turbulent air current and spatial law, so he was able to accurately maintain stability in the spatial crevice, and eventually found the exit out of it.
*Hong Long...*

A huge area of void was destroyed. Even the golden barrier began to let out a buzzing sound, seemingly about to break at any moment. This was absolute destruction. Any living thing would die tragically within it. At this moment, everyone was holding their breath. Their widened eyes stared ahead. Most of them thought that Jiang Chen was certainly dead.

“I’m afraid he’s going to die for sure. Zhang Yulang has already locked everything around him. No matter how heaven-defying his techniques are, they’re useless in front of Zhang Yulang’s power. This is a destructive strike that can kill all living creatures. I wonder if Jiang Chen can walk out of this alive.”
“I don’t think he can. If he can really survive such an attack, then he will be overly heaven-defying!”

“Ai! What a pity! A peerless, monstrous genius has fallen just like that. It’s all because Jiang Chen was too arrogant. He didn’t even put a figure like Zhang Yulang in his eyes, and spoke wildly against the Immortal Court. He indeed lacks self-knowledge.”

Many of them began to sigh, feeling that Jiang Chen was bound to die. There was almost no possibility of survival in such a situation. Jiang Chen was only a half-step Immortal Emperor. If he could still survive under such a situation, then he would be truly heaven-defying.

But after sending out the attack, Zhang Yulang frowned once more. Others might not notice, but he could clearly feel that his attack didn’t kill Jiang Chen. This was what his intuition was telling him, which was often accurate given his cultivation base.
Just as everyone thought that Jiang Chen was dead, a hand was seen tearing a part of the void apart. A silhouette leisurely walked out of it. Who could it be if he wasn’t Jiang Chen?
“What?”

Countless cries of surprise were heard. All of them were dumbfounded. Each of their eyes seemed as if they had seen a ghost. This was a miracle. No one knew how Jiang Chen did it. As a matter of fact, even Jiang Chen himself was a little surprised by the amazing power of the Great Void Technique. He was feeling incredibly good right now. He had confirmed that the technique was indeed an absolute means of protection.

“Zhang Yulang, so this is just how strong you are. Although you are powerful, your power is far from capable of killing me. Now it seems like if I leave now, you won’t be able to catch even a hair of mine,” said Jiang Chen plainly.
After succeeding in his escape, he felt even more confident and didn’t fear Zhang Yulang anymore.
“How did you do it?” Instead of launching another strike, Zhang Yulang asked curiously.
“Humph!” Jiang Chen harrumphed coldly, and didn’t bother to answer to Zhang Yulang’s question.
Coincidentally, the scene was seen by Han Yan, Yang Bufan, Tyrant and Grandmaster Hao Ran, who had just arrived. Each of their eyes widened with astonishment.

“What’s that amazing technique of that brat? His cultivation base hadn’t advanced, but his technique is far more powerful compared to his cultivation.” Grandmaster Hao Ran’s eyes turned big and round.

“He must have gotten some sort of ancient secret art and has succeeded in cultivating it within a short period of time. Senior Brother, miracles always happen to Jiang Chen. You don’t have to be too surprised even if you see something even more heaven-defying in the future,” said Tyrant with a smile.
“That’s right. We have already gotten used to it.” Han Yan approached them and shrugged.
“Incredible.” Grandmaster Haoran raised a thumbs up.

“Zhang Yulang has already advanced to the half-step Immortal Venerable realm. Geniuses like him are very terrifying. An earth-shattering battle will break out again the moment the doors of the Golden Clan are opened,” said Yang Bufan.

Having already advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm, if he walked out of the Golden Horizon now, he would immediately become the number one genius of Great Qian Empire. Plus, Jiang Chen had already helped him remove his obstacles - King Ping and the Crown Prince. From now on, the greatest prefecture in Great Qian Empire would be King Fan Prefecture.
“Jiang Chen, don’t you get complacent. I have yet to use my full strength. If I decided to kill you, you won’t have a chance no matter how great your means is,” said Zhang Yulang coldly.
“Is that so? Then try your best and see if you can really kill me.” Jiang Chen showed a cold sneer. He would never be affected by the enemy’s threat.
“You’ll see. The moment the doors of the Golden Clan are opened, I’m going to kill you myself.”

Zhang Yulang said, then moved to one side, no longer intending to fight Jiang Chen. He didn’t want to expose all of his trump cards yet. In his opinion, it wasn’t worth to use those against Jiang Chen. More experts would appear so it wasn’t a good idea to reveal his trump cards in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1661 - The Grand Gathering
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

Zhang Yulang stopped seeking trouble for the time being. Jiang Chen was naturally as relaxed as before. After all, it wasn’t the time for a direct confrontation yet as the doors of the Golden Clan has yet to open. With a flash, Jiang Chen appeared next to Big Yellow and the others. He still kept the dragon form as it was his strongest form of combat. It was no longer necessary to remove this form because life-and-death battles could happen anytime at this place.

“King Fan, you have advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm too, great! By the way, I have already gotten rid of King Ping. You no longer have any obstacles in the Great Qian Empire,” said Jiang Chen.

He naturally felt incomparably happy seeing King Fan’s tremendous progress. Apart from King Fan, Tyrant had also become a late Immortal Emperor. Jiang Chen wasn’t quite surprised by it. Tyrant had the relic of ancient Buddha Venerable inside of him. By continuously refining it, he was advancing at every second. As such, he couldn’t be judged with ordinary eyes.
“King Ping was killed by you?”

Yang Bufan was somewhat shocked, but he didn’t feel the slightest sentiment about King Ping’s death. Although they were brothers, kinship was always cast aside in the royal family. As the Evil Lord, he had already understood it long ago that petty kindness was futile. He knew very well that it was only a matter of time before King Ping did anything to harm them if King Ping wasn’t eliminated.
“Little Chen, what kind of amazing secret technique have you practiced that allowed you to dodge Zhang Yulang’s attack so easily?” Han Yan asked curiously.

“To tell you the truth, under the guidance of Big Yellow, I have obtained the inheritance of the Void Sovereign called the Great Void Technique. This secret art is incomparably powerful. That’s why I was able to escape Zhang Yulang so easily. Even if I can’t beat him, I can just continue to entangle him. It’s virtually impossible for Zhang Yulang to kill me,” replied Jiang Chen. He had nothing to hide from these brothers as real brothers would never hide things from each other.
“What? The legendary Void Sovereign? Little Chen, you surely have great luck!”

Yang Bufan was astonished once again. As a prince of the Great Qian Empire, he had studied the legends in the Immortal World since young. The things and people he knew were naturally greater compared to ordinary people. It was only logical that he knew that Void Sovereign was as powerful as Immortal Execution King and Great Sovereign Zang Xian. He knew that the Void Sovereign had moved around the entire Immortal World unhindered and was known as one of the most powerful Immortal Sovereigns in the world. The secret art left by this Sovereign had to be extraordinary. The fact that Jiang Chen could acquire the Great Void Technique indicated his extraordinary luck.
*Hong Long...*

As soon as Yang Bufan’s words faded, one of the golden passageways trembled once more. A powerful figure emerged from it. The movement it created was even greater than Zhang Yulang’s. The incomer wasn’t a stranger. He was the supreme genius of Radiance Immortal Domain, Xia Xiaotian.

He seemed to be only fifteen or sixteen years old, but the qi exuding from him was overbearing. Currently, his cultivation base was at the same level as Zhang Yulang, he had already become a formidable half-step Immortal Venerable.

“Awesome! That’s the monstrous figure of Radiance Immortal Domain. I heard that his real age hasn’t even reached twenty yet. Truly imaginable. Did he start cultivating when he was still in his mother’s womb?”
“He can’t be measured using common sense. Compared to him, we aren’t geniuses at all.”

“This is surely going to be a grand gathering. I heard that many monstrous geniuses have advanced to the half-step Immortal Venerable realm recently, so Zhang Yulang and Xia Xiaotian won’t be the only half-step Immortal Venerables. It seems like some intense battles are about to break out soon.”

The emergence of Xia Xiaotian had immediately caused an uproar in the crowd. No one wasn’t shocked by this. Anyone would feel ashamed of their own inferiority if compared to such geniuses. Some even felt that their existence had disgraced the word “genius”.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*

Experts continued to appear from the eighteen golden passageways. Countless geniuses from different major powers had gathered together. Most of their cultivation base had advanced. As the emergence of immortal vaults in this expedition was especially greater compared to the previous expeditions, many had gotten unusual benefits. Late Immortal Emperors were being produced one after another.
Once these geniuses walked out from the Golden Horizon, they would definitely startle the cultivators in their own domain.

Yang Lang, Shan Cong, Xuan Zhong, Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian, Mo Quqing, and more of them had arrived. When the saw Jiang Chen and Yang Bufan, they immediately greeted them as they had been together in the previous fight. Now that the most crucial moment was about to arrive, they naturally had to stick together. In the face of such a situation, nothing was more important than cooperation. Not just them, many other geniuses and major powers were also joining forces as no one was certain what would happen next.
“What happened to Brother Shisan?”

When Lan Lingji looked around and couldn’t see Dragon Shisan, she asked. The shadow of Dragon Shisan had been in her heart all this while. Although she was the lofty saintess of Exquisite Paradise, she was, after all, still a girl. She normally wouldn’t put any man in her eyes, but once a man touched her heart, everything changed.

“I don’t know where that monkey has gone to. He should have been here first since the movement here is so great, but he’s still nowhere to be seen. My guess is that he must have gotten a tremendous treasure and is digesting it in some place,” said Big Yellow.
One had to admit that his guess was quite accurate. Ever since Dragon Shisan had acquired the Life Symbol Art, he had been sitting in front of the huge green rock, motionless.
“Don’t worry. He will come. This grand gathering will not be perfect without him.” Smiled Jiang Chen.
*Hong Long...*
Another boom was heard from one of the passageways. Needless to think, it had to be another mighty expert. Judging from the qi, it had to be another powerful half-step Immortal Venerable.
Sure enough, a youth in a robe as white as snow emerged. His body was full of infinite energy.

He was Fengyun Zi who was not any weaker compared to Xia Xiaotian or Zhang Yulang be it in terms of potential or strength. No one would dare to show the slightest bit of disrespect towards such a peerless genius.

That’s why I was able to escape Zhang Yulang so easily.
Even if I can’t beat him, I can just continue to entangle him.
It’s virtually impossible for Zhang Yulang to kill me,” replied Jiang Chen.
He had nothing to hide from these brothers as real brothers would never hide things from each other.
“What?
The legendary Void Sovereign?
Little Chen, you surely have great luck!”
Yang Bufan was astonished once again.
As a prince of the Great Qian Empire, he had studied the legends in the Immortal World since young.
The things and people he knew were naturally greater compared to ordinary people.
It was only logical that he knew that Void Sovereign was as powerful as Immortal Execution King and Great Sovereign Zang Xian.
He knew that the Void Sovereign had moved around the entire Immortal World unhindered and was known as one of the most powerful Immortal Sovereigns in the world.
The secret art left by this Sovereign had to be extraordinary.
The fact that Jiang Chen could acquire the Great Void Technique indicated his extraordinary luck.
*Hong Long...*
As soon as Yang Bufan’s words faded, one of the golden passageways trembled once more.
A powerful figure emerged from it.
The movement it created was even greater than Zhang Yulang’s.
The incomer wasn’t a stranger.
He was the supreme genius of Radiance Immortal Domain, Xia Xiaotian.
He seemed to be only fifteen or sixteen years old, but the qi exuding from him was overbearing.
Currently, his cultivation base was at the same level as Zhang Yulang, he had already become a formidable half-step Immortal Venerable.
“Awesome!
That’s the monstrous figure of Radiance Immortal Domain.
I heard that his real age hasn’t even reached twenty yet.
Truly imaginable.
Did he start cultivating when he was still in his mother’s womb?”
“He can’t be measured using common sense.
Compared to him, we aren’t geniuses at all.”
“This is surely going to be a grand gathering.
I heard that many monstrous geniuses have advanced to the half-step Immortal Venerable realm recently, so Zhang Yulang and Xia Xiaotian won’t be the only half-step Immortal Venerables.
It seems like some intense battles are about to break out soon.”
The emergence of Xia Xiaotian had immediately caused an uproar in the crowd.
No one wasn’t shocked by this.
Anyone would feel ashamed of their own inferiority if compared to such geniuses.
Some even felt that their existence had disgraced the word “genius”.
*Swoosh...* *Swoosh...* *Swoosh...*
Experts continued to appear from the eighteen golden passageways.
Countless geniuses from different major powers had gathered together.
Most of their cultivation base had advanced.
As the emergence of immortal vaults in this expedition was especially greater compared to the previous expeditions, many had gotten unusual benefits.
Late Immortal Emperors were being produced one after another.
Once these geniuses walked out from the Golden Horizon, they would definitely startle the cultivators in their own domain.
Yang Lang, Shan Cong, Xuan Zhong, Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian, Mo Quqing, and more of them had arrived.
When the saw Jiang Chen and Yang Bufan, they immediately greeted them as they had been together in the previous fight.
Now that the most crucial moment was about to arrive, they naturally had to stick together.
In the face of such a situation, nothing was more important than cooperation.
Not just them, many other geniuses and major powers were also joining forces as no one was certain what would happen next.
“What happened to Brother Shisan?”
When Lan Lingji looked around and couldn’t see Dragon Shisan, she asked.
The shadow of Dragon Shisan had been in her heart all this while.
Although she was the lofty saintess of Exquisite Paradise, she was, after all, still a girl.
She normally wouldn’t put any man in her eyes, but once a man touched her heart, everything changed.
“I don’t know where that monkey has gone to.
He should have been here first since the movement here is so great, but he’s still nowhere to be seen.
My guess is that he must have gotten a tremendous treasure and is digesting it in some place,” said Big Yellow.
One had to admit that his guess was quite accurate.
Ever since Dragon Shisan had acquired the Life Symbol Art, he had been sitting in front of the huge green rock, motionless.
“Don’t worry.
He will come.
This grand gathering will not be perfect without him.” Smiled Jiang Chen.
*Hong Long...*
Another boom was heard from one of the passageways.
Needless to think, it had to be another mighty expert.
Judging from the qi, it had to be another powerful half-step Immortal Venerable.
Sure enough, a youth in a robe as white as snow emerged.
His body was full of infinite energy.
He was Fengyun Zi who was not any weaker compared to Xia Xiaotian or Zhang Yulang be it in terms of potential or strength.
No one would dare to show the slightest bit of disrespect towards such a peerless genius.

chapters.title: Chapter 1662 - The Sparkling Brilliance
paragraphs: 3rd of the week!

“It’s Fengyun Zi of Radiance Immortal Domain, equally famous as Xia Xiaotian. I heard others say that when this person was born, innumerable thunder and lightning hovered in the sky right above his place of birth. Producing such unusual changes on the day of his birth made him an extraordinary genius.”
“Reaching the half-step Immortal Venerable at such a young age. That’s really admirable. I wonder when will I be able to get to that stage.”

“You? Save the effort. That level is totally unimaginable. It’s already considered a blessing from the God if you can reach the intermediate Immortal Emperor realm. Everyone knows how hard it is to step into the Immortal Venerable realm.”

Just like Xia Xiaotian’s, Fengyun Zi’s emergence had also caused a huge commotion. Putting other things aside, the fact that he could reach such a realm at such a young age gave him all the right to disdain the whole Immortal World.
This was the true talent of the young generation, unmatched and unparalleled.

After giving the golden barrier a glance, he simply found a spot and stood there with his eyes closed. With his eyesight, he could naturally see that the doors of the Golden Clan hadn’t truly opened yet.

After a while, a golden passageway shook, another powerful expert with a half-step Immortal Venerable cultivation base emerged from it. He wore sackcloth; he’s tall and majestic, the bulging muscles on his body seemed like miniature hills, full of explosive energy. One could tell that he was a physical type at a glance.

“It’s Ye Qingtian of Ming Luo Immortal Domain. He’s also a genius of the Immortal Court. I heard that he possesses the bloodline of the ancient giants. He has terrifying strength, able to lift thousands of meters of mountain range with his bare hands. It will surely bring you horror to make such a person your enemy.”
“That’s right. He’s a very powerful figure. No ordinary opponents will be able to fight him.”
“The expedition this time has created too many geniuses. I heard that apart from Zhang Yulang, Xia Xiaotian, Fengyun Zi and Ye Qingtian, there are two more half-step Immortal Venerables.”

“Yes. They have made the advancement not long ago. I think they are Young Master Yulong of Ethereal Immortal Domain, and Lu Sheng of Ming Luo Immortal Domain, who are also extremely powerful figures. I really have no idea what kind of competition will happen when the six of them appear at the same time.”

Incredible figures appeared one after another. Many of those who were there were terrified. They wondered if it was a lucky thing to exist in the same generation as these geniuses. To those who had no ambition, they deemed it as a great honor to be able to witness such legendary geniuses, for they knew that it was almost impossible to see these cultivators during normal days.

To ordinary experts, they could also obtain certain benefits by seeing the techniques and skills of these experts. They could obtain certain insights from the heaven-defying abilities of these geniuses.

More and more experts came. There were certainly a lot more people compared to the previous time when the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao emerged. After that, Young Master Yulong and Lu Sheng also arrived. The aura radiating from the six half-step Immortal Venerables made some cultivators who had weaker cultivation base feel slightly uncomfortable as they could feel the pressure pressing the depths of their soul.

The eighteen golden passageways weren’t closed yet, as though it would never close. Everyone was waiting patiently, although there were some who were already losing their patience and wanted to advance towards the golden barrier, however they were stopped by the others.
“Brother, I advise you not to act rashly. Many had already died back when the Xiao Yao Qin emerged,” reminded someone kindly.

The golden barrier might seem simple, but it was probably the same when the Xiao Yao Qin emerged. Anyone who went near it would be attacked by the golden barrier, and would die an untimely death. The things that were left behind by the powerful Golden Clan wouldn’t be that easy to get. However, one could try to give it a go if he thought that his life was too long.

The waiting lasted for an hour. Within this hour, no one made a move. Having the previous lessons in their head, no one was willing to be the sacrifice. As the expedition was coming to an end, and most of them had already gotten tremendous benefits, it was not worth it to lose their life at this point.

During this hour, Jiang Chen was paying attention to Big Yellow who seemed to have placed all his focus on the golden barrier. Jiang Chen couldn’t figure out what Big Yellow was seeing, but he was sure that Big Yellow must have seen something, for he had never seen the dog paying so much attention to a particular thing before.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*
Finally, the golden barrier began to tremble. The gold brilliance from it began to fade, seemingly about to disappear at any second.
“Look, quickly, the golden barrier is vanishing. The doors of the Golden Clan will be opened in no time.”
“The secrets of the legendary Golden Clan will be uncovered soon.”

“Legend says that the Golden Clan was known as the number one clan of the Immortal World during its prime. Even the Immortal Court hadn’t dared to touch them. Unfortunately, the clan became extinct in the end.”

“Rumor has it that the peerless Sovereign Weapon, Gold Feather Fan is hidden inside here. I didn’t believe it at first, but after witnessing the emergence of the Xiao Yao Qin, I’m starting to believe it.”

“The record says that the Gold Feather Fan is made from the Divine Sun Feather, powerful enough to shake the Heavens and Earth. My life will be worth it if I’m able to witness such a peerless weapon.”

Seeing the doors of the Golden Clan about to open, everyone began to get excited. There was no way they wouldn’t get excited about it. There had been too many legends about the Golden Clan and they knew that any treasure left behind by the clan other than the Gold Feather Fan was also invaluable.
The golden barrier shook more and more intensely, until it faded completely and vanished.
*Hua La...*

Innumerable golden lights spread out, hovering right above the Golden Clan, covering everything below, making it impossible for people to see anything. A giant golden door materialized before them. Behind the gateway was an atypical spatial zone, and also the inheritance of the Golden Clan.

Big Yellow withdrew his frozen gaze and his facial expression seemed extremely excited as though he had seen something. His body shook slightly. His eyes were dazzling bright. No one knew what he was thinking. Similarly, no one knew what those rays of light represented.

chapters.title: Chapter 1663 - Pledging one’s life to defend
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
“Haha! The gates of the Golden Clan are now open. Everyone, hurry up and go in!”

Someone shouted. They had already been waiting for a long time. Now that the doors were finally opened, most of them could wait no more. Immediately, more than a dozen silhouettes hurtled towards the gateway.
*Pu Chi...*

At this moment, around ten soldiers in golden armour appeared in front of the silent golden gates, each was holding an ancient battle sword. Moving at an extremely fast speed, they rushed towards the dozen of experts, killing all of them in the blink of an eye.
The scene immediately alarmed everyone and set off a commotion. Those people who were about to advance forward hastily stopped in their tracks, and looked at those golden-armored warriors in horror.
There was a dazzling light emitted from their eyes, but their facial expression and eyes were indifferent. Most notable of all, there was no vital force in their bodies.

“It’s the dead spirits. They are the warriors of Golden Clan that should have died long ago, but they have become undead, guarding this gateway, and preventing any outsiders from taking any step into their territory.”
“There is no evidence to it, and these dead spirits only have late Immortal Emperor cultivation base. It’s simply impossible for them to stop us. Those geniuses died because they were too rash.”
“The Golden Clan sure is terrifying. Even the dead spirits are so powerful. It seems like there will be many dangers and crises inside.”

Innumerable eyes fell upon the golden warriors. In their point of view, these warriors who had died tens of thousands of years ago were merely late Immortal Emperor dead spirits that wouldn’t have too much effect on them. As long as these dead spirits were eliminated, they would be able to enter the land of the Golden Clan. Also, most of them thought that killing these dead spirits was just a simple matter.

Everyone knew that these dead spirits couldn’t display powerful immortal technique, and could only rely on their combat swords to attack mechanically. Hence, there was nothing to be afraid of. Those who rushed forward were killed by the dead spirits because their cultivation base was too weak. If they were all late Immortal Emperors, the outcome would’ve been different. Furthermore, they still had six formidable Immortal Venerables on their side. Taking these dead spirits down was just easy.

Apart from that, the appearance of the golden warriors had made the Fire of Sun inside Jiang Chen bounce violently. That was a kind of feeling of warmth. Regarding the death of all these golden warriors, Jiang Chen’s soul felt shaken and a hint of sadness was aroused inside of him, making it harder for him to kill these golden warriors, even though they were already dead spirits.
“No, they aren’t dead spirits. They aren’t dead,” said Big Yellow all of a sudden.
“Big Yellow, what did you just say?” Jiang Chen was shocked.

“They aren’t dead. They are the means left by the Great Sovereign of Golden Clan. I can smell the qi of the Gold Feather Fan. Look at those golden light. They are emitted from the Divine Sun Feather. The Great Sovereign of the Golden Clan used the Gold Feather Fan to conceal the entire clan and freeze the time. Tens of thousands of years have passed, and it’s still possible that the Golden Clan will reappear in this Heaven and Earth once more.” Big Yellow spoke with astonishment.
“What did you just say? The Golden Clan will reappear in this world once more? Big Yellow, what actually is going on? What actually happened back then? Why would the Great Sovereign seal his clan?”
Jiang Chen finally couldn’t hold his questions anymore. These golden warriors clearly didn’t show any signs of vitality, but Big Yellow insisted that they weren’t dead spirits.

“This was the best way to preserve the bloodline of the Golden Clan. Too many have died in the great war back then. The clan was already close to extinction at that time, however I don’t know why the clan’s inheritance emerged at this time. If I’m not mistaken, the situation here will settle down soon. The next time it emerges again will be the time of the Golden Clan coming back to life. Little Chen, don’t ask me about what had happened that year because it isn’t the time for you to know yet, but I can tell you that there would be no Immortal World if there was no Golden Clan. They are the heroes of the Immortal World. The bloodline left by this clan won’t perish so easily. Today, do all you can to defend this place, allow no one to enter the gateway or kill any of the golden warriors.”
Big Yellow’s tone sounded incomparably emotional and resolute as though he had pledged his life to ensure the safety of the gateway.

Jiang Chen was moved. He had never seen Big Yellow behave in such a way before. What had actually happened back then? Not only were the golden warriors not dead, there’s also be the bloodline of the Golden Clan behind the gateway. The Great Sovereign of the Golden Clan had used some heaven-defying means to preserve their bloodline. If these geniuses break into it now, it would destroy the painstaking effort of the Great Sovereign tens of thousands of years ago.

Jiang Chen didn’t know what happened, but Big Yellow knew, and he would give his unconditional support to Big Yellow. Moreover, he now possessed the Fire of Sun, which was equivalent to having the bloodline of this clan.
Therefore, he was willing to stand up. He couldn’t let the efforts of the Great Sovereign go in vain. If the Golden Clan could really appear again, no one could measure how much shock it would cause.

But currently, Jiang Chen didn’t want to think about all these as Big Yellow had already rushed towards the gateway. The dog’s body enlarged by twofold, standing in front of the gateway as though he was going to hold out tens of thousands of men with his sole strength.
Without hesitation, Jiang Chen blurted, “I pledge my life to defend the Golden Clan.”

After that, he came to Big Yellow’s side in a ray of light. Han Yan and the rest were startled, though they had heard the conversation between Jiang Chen and Big Yellow. Han Yan and Tyrant exchanged a glance, and also rushed out without a second thought. It was time for the brothers to fight side by side again. Even though the opponents were incomparably terrifying, they showed no sign of retreating. It wasn’t their first time experiencing such a scene.
“Jiang Chen, what are you all doing? Why are you blocking the gateway? Quickly step aside, kill the dead spirits and break into the inheritance’s site.”

Someone yelled reproachfully when he saw Jiang Chen and the others blocking the gateway. It had to be a joke that some people would try to stop others from entering the inheritance of the Golden Clan as that was equal to courting death, because everyone had waited for this for far too long.

chapters.title: Chapter 1664 - The Frenzied Big Yellow
paragraphs: 4th of the week!

“The inheritance of the Golden Clan isn’t fully opened yet. The clan will close its doors once again soon. You all will only die by entering it now. I’m trying to save you all. Thus, I think that we should all give up in venturing behind the gateway and just wait for the expedition to end.” Jiang Chen spoke loudly.

This was all he could say to stop these people as he couldn’t find a better excuse. He knew very well that the appeal of the Golden clan’s inheritance was too great. Even though what he said was a definite truth, it still wasn’t enough stop these geniuses. As all of them had waited for this for too long, it was impossible to stop them from going in. They would do whatever it took to enter the territory of this ancient clan.

Currently, Jiang Chen, Big Yellow, Han Yan, Tyrant and Yang Bufan looked bleak, they all knew that the current situation was much more troublesome compared to the time when the Xiao Yao Qin emerged. Back then, only a small portion of people had tried to stop Wu Ningzhu from getting the inheritance, most of them were only watching the show. But now, there were approximately 20 000 people who had the same purpose - to enter the territory of the Golden Clan. If Jiang Chen and the rest were to stop them, it would be equivalent to making these 20 000 geniuses their enemy. No matter how confident Jiang Chen was, it hadn’t reached the extent where he was confident enough to resist 20 000 enemies at the same time.
“Jiang Chen, are you kidding me? You think too highly of yourself for blocking our way. Look at the number of geniuses here. Each spit of saliva can even drown all of you.”

Zhang Yulang scoffed. He had never thought that Jiang Chen would make such a brainless act at this crucial moment. Base on Jiang Chen’s intelligence, Jiang Chen would surely never do anything to jeopardize his own life. But now, Jiang Chen was standing in front of those golden warriors, blocking the path into the gateway.
“Jiang Chen, don’t be deluded. Do you have any idea what you are doing? You are making the whole world your enemy. So stop wasting our time!”
“Jiang Chen, I urge you to step aside at once. We don’t have any grudges, and I don’t want to fight you.”

“Jiang Chen, I really don’t know what you are thinking. Entering the territory of the Golden Clan will be beneficial to all of us. With your immense luck, you will probably get incredible benefits, allowing you to progress by leaps and bounds once more. You should know very well that there are too many people who wants to kill you. Your current action is truly courting death.”
“Don’t waste time speaking nonsense with him. Attack now. Kill anyone who tries to stop us. Kill Jiang Chen, his comrades and those golden warriors.”

The masses were agitated. Some of them who didn’t have enmity against Jiang Chen began to grit their teeth and reveal killing intent. Nobody thought that someone would do such a thing at such a crucial moment. Stopping 20 000 people at once was truly a heaven-defying act, but it didn’t mean that Jiang Chen and his comrades were capable of stopping all of them.

Jiang Chen’s facial expression turned extremely unpleasant. The present situation was the last thing he wanted to see, but he must support Big Yellow no matter what. He was almost certain that Big Yellow knew what really happened back then.

This dog cherished his life more than anyone else, but now, he was more desperate than anyone to stop this mass of people and protect the bloodline of the Golden Clan. Since Big Yellow felt that this was worth doing, Jiang Chen would definitely follow it.
If the Golden Clan could really appear once again some day, Jiang Chen believed that the clan would remember the kindness of today.

At first, Jiang Chen had the same thought as the others—entering the territory of the Golden Clan and seek for treasures or even the legendary Gold Feather Fan— however, after knowing that these golden warriors weren’t dead spirits and that there was a possibility that the bloodline of this clan would appear in this world once again, just like Big Yellow, his attitude changed, hoping that this ancient and horrifying clan would appear again one day.
“Don’t talk nonsense with me. I’ll kill whoever tries to enter the gateway.”

Jiang Chen’s eyes turned blood-red. The Heavenly Saint Sword was bouncing in his hand and buzzed continuously. He always had this stubborn temper. Since everyone said that this was just like defying the heavens, then he would certainly do what they wanted. He didn’t fear even if this meant making the whole world his enemy.
“Haha! What a mad kid! You really don’t know how to write the word ‘death’. In that case, I’ll kill you now to cut the time short.”
Lu Sheng from the Immortal Court of Ethereal Immortal Domain let out two laughs then unleashed his half-step Immortal Venerable qi, ready to fight Jiang Chen.
“Junior Brother Lu, let me do this.”

Zhang Yulang stopped Lu Sheng with an outstretched hand, took a step forward and said coldly to Jiang Chen, “Jiang Chen, aren’t you very good at dodging attacks? I would like to see if you dare to dodge anymore because if you do, my attack will surely destroy those dead spirits and shatter the doors of the Golden Clan.”
After finishing his words, he immediately launched an attack at Jiang Chen.
Dammit!

Jiang Chen couldn’t help but scold himself. He hated himself for having such a weak cultivation base. He was no match for Zhang Yulang, otherwise, he wouldn’t be so anxious. Moreover, just as Zhang Yulang said, the Great Void Technique was useless at this time as it was a technique mostly used for escaping. If he chose to escape, it would be no different than not defending the gateway. Given Zhang Yulang’s powerful means, he was afraid that the golden warriors would die instantly, none of them would be left alive.
*Roar...*

Big Yellow was infuriated and roared furiously towards the sky. Terrifying qi waves began to roll. His body began to transform greatly. Golden dragon scales grew on his face. A dragon horn protruded on top of his head. He had transformed into a divine-looking Dragon-Horse.
After the transformation, he charged at the palm attack of Zhang Yulang.
*Hong Long...*

A part of the void had been shattered. Big Yellow had unleashed his most powerful form. Although he was merely a late Immortal Emperor, no ordinary half-step Immortal Venerable was a match for him. Even if his opponent was a rare genius like Zhang Yulang, he wouldn’t display the slightest bit of weakness.

Under the impact of Big Yellow’s head, the giant palm condensed by Zhang Yulang was directly destroyed. Big Yellow’s divinity was unfathomable. Although he was also thrown back to his original spot, the attack of Zhang Yulang didn’t leave any injuries on his body.
“Oh?”

Zhang Yulang was taken aback. He had never put Jiang Chen and this dog in his heart. Now, it seemed like was a huge mistake. It turned out that this dog was an abnormal Dragon-Horse with a complete divine beast bloodline who could also compete with him once all his power was unleashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1665 - We are only destined to be brothers in this life!
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
“What a powerful dog! He can actually fight against Zhang Yulang.”

“Look again. Who said that he’s just a dog? He’s a Dragon-Horse with extraordinary pedigree. He also has a super strong bloodline. Not only could he fight opponents stronger than him, he could even kill them. I can’t believe that the dog beside Jiang Chen is also heaven-defying. It seems like we must take this opportunity to eliminate them today, otherwise, the whole Immortal World would be in chaos.”

“You are right. Its either you befriend such a monstrous figure or be his enemy. Once you become his enemy, you have to get rid of him as soon as possible. You should never give him any opportunity to grow. If he really grew to such a terrifying extent, then it will be the end of the world for you.”

Countless people were surprised, but the divinity and strength of Jiang Chen and Big Yellow had given most of them the determination to kill the dou. Now that Jiang Chen and his comrades were stopping them from entering the territory of the Golden Clan, both parties were bound to be enemies.
“Tyrant, Ah Yan, King Fan, today is bound to be a life-or-death battle. You all can choose not to take part in it,” said Jiang Chen to the three in a dignified manner.
“Little Chen, what are you saying? Do you still regard us as your brothers?”
“What situations haven’t we faced before? The worse that will happen is just death.”
“We are only destined to be brothers in this life; if we could fight the world together, we’ll die without regret.”

The three of them looked at Jiang Chen with discomfort. Jiang Chen’s words made them slightly unhappy. Although they knew that Jiang Chen was worried about their safety, their brotherhood was even more important than their lives. Otherwise, why did they call themselves life-and-death brothers? If they couldn’t fight a life-and-death battle side by side with their brothers, they shouldn’t call themselves brothers and should be ashamed for the rest of their lives.
“Alright, we’ll fight to our deaths today.”
Jiang Chen seemed slightly moved, exchanged a glance with Big Yellow and saw relief and happiness in each other’s eyes. They weren’t alone in this life.
“You bunch of bastards! How can Brother Shisan be missed out from this?”
Just as Jiang Chen’s voice faded, another voice was suddenly heard from one of the golden passageways. Countless eyes looked over and saw a yellow-robed youth stepping out into the void.

The overbearing qi of an Immemorial Battle Spirit was emanating from the newcomer. It was an incredible representation. Tremendous changes could be seen from Dragon Shisan. His hair had turned salt and pepper as though conforming to the Heavenly Dao.

Not just that, the current cultivation base of Dragon Shisan was tremendously stronger than before. He’s now at the late Immortal Emperor realm. When Jiang Chen and the others sensed it, they all smiled.
That’s right. How could Dragon Shisan be missed out from such a crucial moment? Moreover, they knew that this monkey would be the main pillar of strength in their group.

“Monkey seems to have gotten tremendous benefits, allowing him to advance to late Immortal Emperor realm, and his qi has also changed tremendously. This is great. Given the abilities of a Battle Saint Ape and his current cultivation base, he can dominate all of them. Not even Zhang Yulang will be a match for him,” said Big Yellow. He couldn’t help but display his delight upon seeing Dragon Shisan’s progress.
“Brother Shisan!”

Lan Lingji flew towards Dragon Shisan. Her worries vanished at the sight of Dragon Shisan. She couldn’t help being captivated by Dragon Shisan’s fluttering salt-and-pepper hair, masculine aura, and angular face.
“Lingji, you have to step down. Don’t make any moves later.”

Dragon Shisan spoke in a dignified tone. He knew everything that happened here. He also knew what Jiang Chen and the others had decided to do, and he was going to support them without hesitation, however, he couldn’t allow Lan Lingji to join them. What would happen next would definitely be a life-and-death battle. Even with her late Immortal Emperor cultivation base, her death was almost certain in the face of 20 000 enemies. Moreover, one Lan Lingji couldn’t help much in such a battle as she wasn’t considered powerful compared to geniuses like Han Yan and Tyrant.
“En, you have to be careful.”

Lan Lingji nodded, then returned to where she stood. She was an intelligent person, she could naturally understand the current situation. She didn’t know why Jiang Chen and the others made such a move, but she knew that there must be a great reason for doing so. She wanted very much to fight side by side with them, but she was crystal clear that there was no point in doing so. Not just her, even all the geniuses of Exquisite Paradise and Great Qian Empire couldn’t help in the slightest even if they join such a fight. They would only increase their casualties.
“Humph!” Zhang Yulang snorted coldly and struck once more at Jiang Chen.
At this moment, an iron staff rushed out of nowhere and hit the attack of Zhang Yulang, instantly shattering it.
*Swish!*

Dragon Shisan’s silhouette appeared in front of Zhang Yulang, his hand holding the iron staff, his Fiery Golden Eyes sparkling. He then spoke overbearingly, “Do you think that Master Monkey doesn’t exist?”

“Dragon Shisan, I advise you to not meddle in this matter. It won’t do you any good. Even if you have the strength to fight me, you should know that there are five more half-step Immortal Venerables here. How could you fight the six of us?” Zhang Yulang said with a frown.

He felt somewhat afraid of Dragon Shisan. He still remembered the scene of Dragon Shisan fighting Nanbei Chao. He knew Nanbei Chao’s strength very well. If Nanbei Chao also advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm, he was certain that he was no match for him. Now that Dragon Shisan had reached the late Immortal Emperor realm, Dragon Shisan might not have difficulty fighting him. Before entering the territory of the Golden Clan, he didn’t want to get entangled with this bastard.
“So what if there are six half-step Immortal Venerables? I dare you all to come and fight me.”
Dragon Shisan didn’t fear any of them. His entire body was packed with the majestic Immemorial Battle Spirit qi. He would never put someone like Zhang Yulang in his eyes.
“Why waste time conversing with a puny late Immortal Emperor? Get rid of him immediately.”

Lu Sheng was the first to lost his temper. He was an extremely arrogant person, he just couldn’t stand someone more arrogant than him, especially when the person had a cultivation base weaker than him.
