chapters.title: Chapter 1666 - The Unavoidable Pinnacle Battle
paragraphs: 5th of the week!

Lu Sheng wasn’t present on the scene when the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao emerged. So he didn’t know who Dragon Shisan was. In his opinion, Dragon Shisan was at best, just an Immortal Emperor whereas he was a half-step Immortal Venerable. The difference between them was definitely not small. Furthermore, he was such a dignified figure, how could he allow a puny Immortal Emperor to show off in front of him?
Dragon Shisan darted Lu Sheng a glance. This had undoubtedly hurt the pride of Lu Sheng even more as he saw the contempt and disrespect in Dragon Shisan’s eyes.
“Courting death!”

A strong wave of fury and killing intent burst out from Lu Sheng’s head. He then lunged at Dragon Shisan. Being disrespected by a puny Immortal Emperor was truly a huge disgrace to him. He must exterminate this opponent to defend his dignity.

Upon seeing Lu Sheng charging at him, Dragon Shisan’s strands of hair rippled. The iron staff in his hand emitted boundless radiance. His Fiery Golden Eyes let out two rays of dazzling brilliance. His body was filled with combat intent. That was the incredible fighting spirit of the Battle Clan. The members of this clan were warlike by nature and never knew what fear was.
*Hong Long...*

Dragon Shisan’s iron staff smashed ahead. The void was instantly split into two. Under the gaze of countless people, the iron staff violently collided with the attack of Lu Sheng, setting off thousands of layers of waves. Those were the waves of the void. Destructive qi filled the place.
*Deng...* *Deng...*

The body of Dragon Shisan was full of boundless chaotic force. Aside from Lu Sheng, not even Ye Qingtian, the one with the ancient Giant Bloodline could match Dragon Shisan’s strength. Under the strike of the iron staff, Lu Sheng was sent a dozen steps away before regaining his balance.
“How dare you boast shamelessly in front of Master Monkey?” Dragon Shisan’s iron staff let out a buzzing sound. He just stood there in the sky, disdaining the world below him.
“What?”

Lu Sheng was truly shocked this time, and cast a transfixed look at Dragon Shisan, he couldn’t believe that this was true. Having advanced to half-step Immortal Venerable not long ago, he should have been all-powerful right now, but today he had just been defeated by a late Immortal Emperor genius. This was a total disgrace.

At this moment, not only was Lu Sheng shocked, even Zhang Yulang and Xia Xiaotian as well. Although they had already been mentally prepared, it was still incomparably surprising for them to see that not even a half-step Immortal Venerable was a match for Dragon Shishan.

“Incredible. I wonder what kind of benefits this bastard has gotten that allowed him to advance to another level once more. What’s more terrifying is that not even a half-step Immortal Venerable is a match for him. Isn’t he a little too heaven-defying?”

“I’m not really too surprised about it. He was able to fight Nanbei Chao when he was still an intermediate Immortal Emperor. Now that he has advanced to late Immortal Emperor, it’s not a strange thing that he can defeat a half-step Immortal Venerable.”

“Humph! So what if he’s this powerful? Whoever blocks the path to the entrance of the Golden Clan will die. Dragon Shisan is not an exception. Although he’s powerful, there are six half-step Immortal Venerables here. If the six of them joined forces, I’m afraid that he won’t be able to resist it even if he has three heads and six arms.”

“That’s right. Dragon Shisan is indeed strong, but it’s impossible for him to deal with such a massive force no matter how strong he is. No one will be able to block the entrance to the Golden Clan. Those six half-step Immortal Venerables are enough to exterminate him. Also, the 20 000 of us will drown Jiang Chen and his comrades in an instant. By making the world as their enemy, they will only have one outcome - death.”

Excitement filled the atmosphere. Even though Dragon Shisan had demonstrated extraordinary combat strength, he wouldn’t be able to stop 20 000 people from entering the territory of the Golden Clan. In their hearts, Dragon Shisan was certainly powerful, but to deal with the current scenario, not even two Dragon Shisans were enough.

“Gentlemen, Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan want to stop us from entering the Golden Clan and search for treasures. That is equivalent to making all of us their enemies and cut off our future. I urge all half-step Immortal Venerables to join forces and eliminate Dragon Shisan. The rest will cooperate to kill Jiang Chen, Big Yellow and those dead spirits and break into the gateway of the Golden Clan!” Zhang Yulang shouted aloud.

As the remark came out, those who had been overwhelmed by the benefits in the Golden Clan naturally couldn’t hold it any longer. Each of them began to release their killing intent, especially those from major powers that had deep grudges against Jiang Chen. Each of their faces displayed a ferocious smile. To them, this was the best chance of eliminating Jiang Chen. They really wanted to kill Jiang Chen, but couldn’t find the chance. After all, Jiang Chen had already reached an extent where killing him had become extremely difficult, but now that he was looking for death, they certainly wouldn’t miss such a great opportunity go. The alliance of 20 000 people could instantly crush him and his comrades to powder.
“Alright, let’s do it together. For the sake of our own interests, we must not let a tiny Jiang Chen ruin our future.”
“Attack now. Attack together. We will kill them easily and effortlessly.”

“Don’t be afraid everyone. The half-step Immortal Venerables will deal with Dragon Shisan. The strongest one amongst them is only Big Yellow, and he won’t be able to stop so many attacks at once. Exterminate them and we will rush into the Golden Clan and find the Gold Feather Fan.”
Most of them yelled. Some were already holding their immortal weapon. A large group of people began to approach the gateway.

The people of Great Qian Empire, Exquisite Paradise, Celestial Flower Valley, and Profound Yin Cult remained motionless. They were, after all, the allies of Jiang Chen. It was already embarrassing enough that they couldn’t give Jiang Chen a hand, let alone turn their backs on him.

To them, it wasn’t because they didn’t want to help Jiang Chen. It was because they knew the situation very well. Even if several hundred of them joined the fight, it would still be pointless. There were countless geniuses from hundreds of different major powers. All of whom were determined to attack. They didn’t possess the heroic qualities and heaven-defying abilities of Jiang Chen so they couldn’t confront these enemies.

Jiang Chen didn’t belong to any sect or school, so he feared nothing, however, they, on the other hand, had to consider their sects. Besides, many of the enemies included the figures from Immortal Court. Not only would the great battle cause immense casualties, it would also bring unnecessary troubles to their own sect after they offended the Immortal Court.
Therefore, Yang Lang and Lan Lingji could only watch and had become the most reluctant spectator of all.
“I’m afraid that this scenario is very unfavorable to Jiang Chen.” Hua Xiaoqian spoke concernedly.
“If 20 000 people were to run amok at the same time, the consequences will be unimaginable. Even if they have heaven-defying abilities, they won’t be able to ensure their own safety.”
Yang Lang’s expression was incomparably solemn, however this battle seemed inevitable judging by Jiang Chen’s resoluteness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1667 - One versus Six
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

Innumerable waves rolled. Countless qi merged together and intertwined into a great net of energy. Such power was enough to destroy everything. Jiang Chen and the rest still stood in front of the doors. Although their facial expression had already turned dark, their resoluteness didn’t falter. The pressure of 20 000 people didn’t deal too much of an impact on them. As Jiang Chen had said before, as long as anyone tried to step into the doors, he would kill without a second word.
“Be careful everyone. Today is going to be a life-or-death battle; we have to do all that we can,” said Jiang Chen.

“Don’t worry, brothers. I have a hunch that it won’t be that easy for them to trample us over. We’re going to buy the Golden Clan some time, until something happens. I believe that this will be a big turn for us. So, let’s do our best; also none of you is allowed to die.” Big Yellow spoke in a solemn tone.

Although he wanted to protect the bloodline of the Golden Clan, he also couldn’t let his brothers die in vain. His intuition told him that it wouldn’t take long before something unusual happened and this would be beneficial to them.

“I have already deployed the Five Elemental Grand Formation. Each of us will guard one of the positions. Tyrant, you summon the God Trembling Monument and hold the grand formation. We will fight this great battle with dignity. Even if we can only experience such a battle once in our lifetime, it’s already enough.”

Jiang Chen was full of fighting spirit and combat intent, however he wasn’t a rash person. Immediately, he cast out the Five Elemental Grand Formation. He knew that working together was the most important element in fighting such a large-scale battle. Otherwise, their lives would be in danger in no time.
“Alright.”

Tyrant summoned the God Trembling Monument without the slightest hesitation, fully integrating it with the Five Elemental Grand Formation. This wasn’t his first time integrating the monument with Jiang Chen’s formation. This explained why he could perform it so smoothly.
“Kill them!”

One of the geniuses clamored, both of his eyes had already turned red as he lunge at Jiang Chen’s group with his immortal weapon. More than a hundred people attacked at the same time, their energy was terrifying as an ocean. Jiang Chen and the others were completely submerged in this ocean of energy.
“Eternal Immortal Wind!”
Jiang Chen shouted, not forgetting to cast out the Eternal Immortal Wind to attack while controlling the Five Elemental Grand Formation. Wild gale swirled forth, sweeping across those people crazily.
Some of them who were too close to the wind were sucked into it. Naturally, their fate after that would be incomparably tragic.

This was bound to be a bloody war. Although the enemy forces was massive, they also wouldn’t be able to cooperate well with each other. Geniuses from different major powers lacked the tacit understanding between one another. Jiang Chen’s group, on the other hand, understood each other very well. Plus, each of them was a monstrous genius. Apart from Jiang Chen, all of them were late Immortal Emperor supreme geniuses.

On the other side, Zhang Yulang and the others couldn’t help but reveal a hint of a sneer when they saw what’s happening. Jiang Chen and his comrades might seem pretty aggressive, but compared to the army of 20 000 people, it was only a matter of time before Jiang Chen and his comrades were destroyed. What they needed to do now was to deal with Dragon Shisan.
The six half-step Immortal Venerables approached Dragon Shisan simultaneously from different directions, besieging him.

In dealing with Dragon Shisan, they seemed to have a very tacit understanding. Judging from the scene when Dragon Shisan and Lu Sheng fought, they knew that he was an absolute genius. If such a being blocked their path, all they needed to do was to join forces and eradicate this powerful threat.

“Dragon Shisan, as you can see, you are only trying to do the impossible. Although you want to defy the heavens, you must first have the capability to do so. I would like to advise you not to take part in this. It’s none of your business if Jiang Chen and the others wanted to die. It won’t be worth it if you get yourself killed in the process,” Xia Xiaotian spoke. As he hadn’t shown up during the Sovereign’s inheritance, now was his first time dealing with Dragon Shisan.
“Get myself killed in the process? You have thought too highly of yourself. You all want to take Master Monkey’s life with just the six of you? Young man, don’t you think that’s very funny?”

Dragon Shisan sneered. He wouldn’t just stand idly by when his brothers were in danger. Besides, he had just advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm and comprehended the Life Symbol Art. It was the right time for him to show off his power. Fighting against six half-step Immortal Venerables was certainly a very pleasant thing for him.
“Dragon Shisan, I have already advised you kindly, but you still refused to listen. Could it be that you really want to fight the six of us by yourself?” Xia Xiaotian was infuriated.

A man like Xia Xiaotian had always been proud, acted high and mighty and disdained all sentient beings. He seldom wasted his time conversing with other people. Normally, he would kill whoever he hated straightaway. He wanted to save Dragon Shisan, but Dragon Shisan didn’t appreciate it. In that case, Dragon Shisan shouldn’t blame him for being impolite.

“Don’t waste time talking nonsense with him. Exterminate him now. Anyone who blocks our way towards the gateway will have to die. No one can stop me, Fengyun Zi, from obtaining the benefits of the Golden Clan.”
Fengyun Zi’s hair fluttered. After he finished talking, he launched a strike at Dragon Shisan abruptly. It was an earth-shattering palm seal that rendered everyone panic-stricken.
However, Dragon Shisan had no fear. He kept the iron staff and launched out a palm strike as well - the Battling Symbol Art—at Fengyun Zi.
*Hong Long...*

The void was immediately shattered to pieces. The arrogant Fengyun Zi was forced back by Dragon Shisan’s strike. The Battle Saint Technique was inherited from the ancestor of the Battle Clan. It’s a battle weapon. The strength of Fengyun Zi was nearly the same as Lu Sheng, so how could he defeat Dragon Shisan in a fight?
“What?

Fengyun Zi’s expression changed. He initially thought that Lu Sheng was sent flying mainly because of carelessness, refusing to join forces with them just to deal with someone who had cultivation base lower than his. But now, it seemed like the might of the opponent had exceeded his imagination.
“Haha! So this is just how powerful the genius of Immortal Court is. The six of you, come and attack me at once. I, Dragon Shisan, don’t fear the lot of you.”

Dragon Shisan smiled frenziedly. His salt-and-pepper hair fluttered in the wind. Both of his hands cast out incredible dharma seals continuously. The Battle Saint Technique swept across the six opponents. He had actually taken the initiative to attack.
“This man is overly arrogant, but also incredibly powerful. Don’t be lenient to him. Let’s eradicate him all together.”

Zhang Yulang shouted aloud. Both of his hands formed a seal that condensed into a huge mountain, smashing towards Dragon Shisan. The others launched their attacks as well. Everyone including Xia Xiaotian could already see the threat of Dragon Shisan. It was the best choice to get rid of such a tremendous threat, otherwise, it would only be a matter of time before Dragon Shisan threatened their lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 1668 - The Life-and-Death Battle Ar
paragraphs: The Life-and-Death Battle Art
6th of the week!

Zhang Yulang, Xia Xiaotian, Lu Sheng, Fengyun Zi, Ye Qingtian, and Young Master Yulong—these six half-step Immortal Venerable supreme geniuses belonged to three different Immortal Domains. But now, they had joined forces just to deal with someone whose cultivation base was lower than theirs. It surely wouldn’t be a glorious thing if this was spread out.

However, they couldn’t care about that much anymore. Face was no longer important. Their top priority was to eliminate Dragon Shisan, the potentially massive threat, then break into the territory of the Golden Clan.

Dragon Shisan stood in the middle of the encirclement of the six experts. Even though he was facing the pressure of six great experts, he showed no sign of panic and fear. That was the confidence that came from his bones. He would never display the slightest bit of weakness even if he was fighting six enemies at the same time.

Such bearing filled people’s heart with admiration. The more confident Dragon Shisan acted, the more determined the six geniuses wanted to kill him, because he was too terrifying. The six were certain that if they were in Dragon Shisan’s shoes, being besieged by six half-step Immortal Venerables, they wouldn’t be able to show such calmness.

This showed that not only were they not as good as Dragon Shisan, his power also made them feel inferior even though they looked high and mighty on the surface. This kind of inferiority aroused envy in their hearts, making them want to eliminate him at all costs in order to establish their prestige.
“I would like to test how strong he actually is.”
Ye Qingtian acted, unleashing the power of his Ancient Giant Bloodline. His body grew by twofold. His hill-like fist, that had the power to shatter a mountain, smashed at Dragon Shisan.

In the face of Ye Qingtian’s ferocious attack, the corners of Dragon Shisan’s mouth revealed a plain smile. The Ancient Giant Bloodline was naturally powerful, but the bloodline of the Battle Clan was even nobler. Hence, in terms of physical strength, he never feared anyone.
He sent out a fist without casting the Battle Saint Technique. Both fists collided with each other at lightning speed.
*Bang!*

The area of the void upon which the collision took place was immediately torn apart. A huge crater was created. Icy cold air current flowed out from it, lowering the temperature of the area. This was the most primitive collision. It was produced just by the force of their physical bodies.
*Deng!* *Deng!* *Deng!*

Ye Qingtian had received a huge backlash. His sturdy body retreated three steps. His arm was shaking. Traces of blood appeared on his fist. At this moment, he was truly dumbfounded. He simply couldn’t believe this reality. He might find it easier to accept if the enemy used some incredible immortal technique to defeat him, but he could clearly feel just now that the opponent was also just using pure physique to collide with his.
Being the carrier of the Giant Bloodline, physical strength was the thing he was most proud of. He had never tasted defeat in a battle of strength until today.
“The Giant Bloodline is inferior compared to my Battle Clan,” Dragon Shisan spoke arrogantly.

Their expressions changed simultaneously. This Dragon Shisan was too terrifying. Most of them, including Zhang Yulang, Lu Sheng, Fengyun Zi and Ye Qingtian, had already lost to Dragon Shisan in a one-versus-one battle. No one had expected that even Ye Qingtian couldn’t gain the upper hand in the battle he was best at. This raised their view of Dragon Shisan to another level once more.
They now understood that it was impossible for them to fight Dragon Shisan one on one. They must unite in order to eliminate this threat.
“Don’t hold back everyone. Let’s kill him together!”
Zhang Yulang yelled loudly. Qi waves rolled skyward. He stretched out both of his hands to produce complex seals. He was going to cast out all of his skills to exterminate Dragon Shisan.

At the same time, a virtual image of an ancient barbaric beast emerged on top of Xia Xiaotian’s head. The image seemed incomparably ferocious. Terrifying qi was emanated from it. It was an ancient living spirit that looked like a totem.
Sure enough, the blood that flowed in Xia Xiaotian’s body belonged to an ancient living spirit.
Fengyun Zi, also acted. The thunder above his head sounded like lightning tribulation, a dragon-like lighting spiraling overhead.
Young Master Yulong, Lu Sheng, and Ye Qingtian had also launched their most powerful attack. All of them had locked on the qi of Dragon Shisan, not giving him the slightest chance of escaping.

Below, Jiang Chen saw what was happening, however he didn’t seem concerned because he knew better than anyone how terrifying the monkey was. Even though it was a one-versus-six match, he had a lot of confidence in Dragon Shisan. Even if the monkey couldn’t defeat all of them, he would never be killed by his opponents.

Lan Lingji was incomparably anxious. She couldn’t help it because all of Dragon Shisan’s opponents were unparalleled geniuses of Immortal Court, with cultivation bases greater than Dragon Shisan. It was bound to be a difficult battle to Dragon Shisan when the six of them joined forces.
Although she had the urge to help Dragon Shisan, she knew pretty well that it would only be futile. She would only become a burden.
“I must cultivate well so that I won’t become a nuisance in the future,” Lan Lingji vowed secretly.

She was already in love with Dragon Shisan. In her opinion, someone like Dragon Shisan, and Jiang Chen, carried great fortune. It was only a matter of time before he became a great figure. Naturally, in order to be his woman, she couldn’t allow herself to become his burden. She understood how Wu Ningzhu felt right now. Even if a woman couldn’t be useful to her man, she should never be a nuisance.

On the battlefield, Dragon Shisan’s strands of hair fluttered. The Battle Saint Technique was cast out with all the power that he had. Two vortexes appeared at the heart of his palms. One was black, while the other was jade-white, representing the Exterminating Symbol Art, and Life Symbol Art, respectively. By combining these two symbol arts, it could transcend life and death, and erupt with the original force of life.
The Exterminating Symbol Art was used to attack while the Life Symbol Art was used to protect.
“Kill him!” Fengyun Zi yelled.

The six of them lunged at Dragon Shisan simultaneously. Layers of horrifying energy interwove into a giant energy net, charging at Dragon Shisan. Such a level of energy was beyond the imagination of ordinary people.

Dragon Shisan moved. He didn’t choose to dodge, but chose the opposite instead. The Battle Saint Technique was circulated to the extreme. The Life-and-Death Secret Art was used to deal with six great experts at the same time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1669 - Blood Stirring
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
*Hong Long...*

The Heaven and Earth were shaken. The Battle Saint Technique was displayed to the maximum. It might seem like Dragon Shisan had lost the upper hand while fighting against the six, but if one looked closely, one could see how relaxed and confident he was while performing hand-seals.

In Jiang Chen and Big Yellow’s opinion, the monkey was enjoying the battle. Dragon Shisan was perfecting his Battle Saint Technique under such a great pressure. This was more important than anything else. Furthermore, he knew the situation of the battle very well. Even if he couldn’t defeat all six of them, it was impossible for them to take his life.
“What a powerful combat technique!” Jiang Chen said in a surprised tone.

“This monkey has great luck. He found the true essence of the Battle Saint Technique. He’s now exploiting the pressure from his enemies to refine his combat technique, improving himself continuously. I’m afraid that amongst all late Immortal Emperors, only he can fight six half-step Immortal Venerables.” Big Yellow sighed. Even with his pride, he couldn’t help but praise Dragon Shisan’s talent.
“There’s one more person who can achieve this, Nanbei Chao,” said Jiang Chen.

The war had already begun, but Nanbei Chao had yet to appear. This showed that he had gotten some great treasures that not even the eighteen golden passageways had attracted his attention. Jiang Chen was almost sure that once Nanbei Chao appears, he would be as terrifying as Dragon Shisan.
“That son of a b*tch better not show himself up at this time,” spoke Big Yellow.

He expected that the inheritance of the Golden Clan would vanish soon. That was to say, they only had to defend against these geniuses until the gateway disappeared. Although Dragon Shisan had reduced most of their burden by handling the six half-step Immortal Venerables, if Nanbei Chao appeared at this time, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Even if Nanbei Chao didn’t appear, the current scenario was still very unfavourable to Jiang Chen and the rest. Almost everyone here had regarded them as enemies, and when these enemies learned to work together, Jiang Chen’s forces wouldn’t be able to resist them.
“Kill them, kill Jiang Chen!”

Someone shouted. The speaker was Nanbei Yitu. Being the first genius of Nanbei Family to fight Jiang Chen, he was incomparably aggrieved as he still remembered that Jiang Chen was merely a little shrimp when they first met. He could easily crush Jiang Chen at that time if Yang Bufan didn’t interfere.

How long has it only been since they first met, Jiang Chen had already grown to the point where he, Nanbei Yitu, could only look up to? Although he had already advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm, he didn’t even have the courage to stand out when Nanbei Jing and Nanbei Zhong were murdered by Jiang Chen. Now that thousands of people were advancing to kill Jiang Chen, he would surely unleash all of his anger at once.
*Hong Long...*

Countless people had launched their attacks from all directions. Multi-colored energy rays continued to bombard the Five Elemental Grand Formation. Jiang Chen and the rest were completely trapped in the ocean of energy. Even the domain created by the Eternal Immortal Wind was ripped apart. Their faces including Big Yellow had already became ugly. No one could tell how long the formation could hold. At this rate, it seemed virtually impossible for the formation to last until the golden gateway fade away.
“Get stuffed! Master Monk has come.”
At this moment, a loud voice was heard. Grandmaster Haoran dashed into Jiang Chen’s grand formation in a flash.
“I have come to fight side by side with you all.”

Grandmaster Haoran was a man of righteousness. His blood had long been stirred by Jiang Chen and the others’ heaven-defying act. First, Tyrant, a brother whom he liked very much, was amongst them. Secondly, when he fought Jiang Chen previously, he had been deeply impressed by Jiang Chen and decided to befriend him. Now that his brother and junior brother were in danger, he felt extremely uncomfortable being a spectator. Therefore, he rushed into the battlefield desperately. Confronting all the geniuses of the world was truly a passionate, heroic and satisfying act. No matter what the outcome was, one’s life wouldn’t be in vain if one could join in this fight.
“Senior Brother, why have you come?” Tyrant showed a look of surprise.
“Grandmaster Haoran, you shouldn’t have involved yourself today. What would I do if you lost your life in the process?”

Jiang Chen cried out. He had never thought that Grandmaster Haoran would jump into the formation at this moment. The battle had already developed into a sure-death situation. Given Haoran’s intelligence, it was impossible for him not to see their current situation, however the fact that he joined them slightly touched Jiang Chen’s heart.
“And me, Mo Wuqing.”
“Me, Yang Lang.”
“Me, Shan Chong.”

For an instant, Mo Wuqing, Yang Lang, and Shan Chong rushed into the Five Elemental Grand Formation to help support the formation. All of them were late Immortal Emperors. Each having a huge increase in strength. Being the genius of devil cult, Mo Wuqing was brutal by nature. Even their chosen one had joined the battle, he naturally shouldn’t be just an idle spectator.

Yang Lang and Shan Chong had come for the sake of Yang Bufan. At the same time, they were startled by Jiang Chen’s heroic qualities and boldness. Sometimes, it’s easy for people to be affected by emotion. Once the emotion was stimulated, one would no longer pay attention to the repercussion. Just like now, Yang Lang and the other’s emotion had been stirred, feeling that it would make their life in vain if they didn’t join the fight.
“Haha! We’ll fight together today!”
Jiang Chen laughed aloud. His dominance was overwhelming. As more people joined their forces, the grand formation became even more stable.
*Hong Long...*

Another wave of fierce attack hit the grand formation. More and more geniuses took part in the war. Although the situation looked the same when the Xiao Yao Qin emerged, the disparity was too great. Today’s scene was incomparable to the previous.
The good thing was that the one who supported the formation right now had much higher cultivation bases than before.
*Dong!*
At this moment, the golden warriors who had been guarding the gateway moved, radiating a sliver of will, their empty eye sockets looked at Jiang Chen and the others.
“Let them in. These golden warriors can feel what we are doing and want to give us a hand,” said Big Yellow.
Upon hearing this, Jiang Chen immediately tore a hole on the formation, letting the golden warriors in to help support the grand formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1670 - Killing Nanbei Yitu
paragraphs: 7th of the week!

Jiang Chen finally believed that these golden warriors weren’t dead, because those that were already dead wouldn’t have will except the order to kill. Although these golden warriors were sealed in a certain way, they still possessed some kind of will and could sense what he was doing and the Fire of Sun inside of him. That was the fire of origin of their clan. That was why they were willing to help. They felt that they were helping their own clan if they do so.

Each of those golden warriors had the strength of a late Immortal Emperor. With their support, the Five Elemental Grand Formation became even more stable. Jiang Chen was even allowed to leave the encampment to kill some enemies.

“Tyrant, just like before, support the grand formation with the God Trembling Monument. I will rush out to kill them, seizing the chance to break their encampment, disrupting their effort to pool all their energy together.” Jiang Chen said to Tyrant and Big Yellow.
“Alright. Be careful.” Tyrant nodded.
“Don’t worry, I have the Great Void Technique. Not even thousands of experts can harm me.”

Jiang Chen smiled. The Great Void Technique was undoubtedly a technique that could protect his life. The enemy’s encampment ahead was incredibly huge, however he had no fear as the Great Void Technique could allow him to appear at any place, and dodge the attack of the enemies.
*Swoosh!*
A pair of dragon wings emerged on his back as he rushed out in a ray of light. With the Great Void Technique and Nine Phantom Wolves combined together, his speed was simply too fast.
*Keng!*

The Heavenly Saint Sword appeared in his hand and he materialized in front of Nanbei Yitu. Currently, his cultivation base has already reached the pinnacle of the half-step Immortal Emperor, leaving him only a step away from the true Immortal Emperor realm. As a matter of fact, during the ten months of seclusion, he should have already broken through to the Immortal Emperor realm, but because of the dragon transformation skill having yet to evolve, it caused his cultivation base to stay stagnant. Although his cultivation base stagnated, his combat strength had improved tremendously. He might not be able to fight opponents like Nanbei Yitu before, but now, with his current strength, it was effortless for him to kill Nanbei Yitu. And with the coordination of the Great Void Technique and Nine Phantom Wolves, he’s allowed to appear at any place, at any time. He could either choose to attack from the front or from the back, it would surely confuse the opponent.
“Nanbei Yitu, go and die now.”
Jiang Chen’s qi was unparalleled. After locking on Nanbei Yitu, the terrifying Heavenly Saint Sword slashed downwards from above.

Nanbei Yitu was terrified. It was an all-out attack of Jiang Chen. A sense of extreme danger blossomed in his innermost soul. It also made him feel isolated and helpless. There were clearly many people around him, but he felt that none of them could provide him any help in the face of Jiang Chen.
Such a feeling was unpleasant. He didn’t dare believe that Jiang Chen’s strength had become so powerful that it could threaten his life.
In fact, Nanbei Yitu had just advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm, hence his cultivation base was still very unstable.
As Jiang Chen had gone into his combat mode, he would never show mercy in his attack. This slash encompassed his most ferocious attack and power. How could Nanbei Yitu be a match for Jiang Chen?
Out of helplessness, Nanbei Yitu could only lift his sword to block Jiang Chen’s Heavenly Saint Sword.
*Hong Long...*
The void around was torn apart. The slash of Jiang Chen carried the force of four supreme flames. Nanbei Yitu was directly sent flying away by the slash.
He let out a wail, spurted out blood and quickly hid in the crowd.
“Nanbei Yitu, I’m going to kill you. It’s no use hiding in the crowd, no matter how many people there are, I will still kill you.”

Jiang Chen’s voice sounded like the king of hell, cold and emotionless. As soon as his voice faded, he appeared behind Nanbei Yitu like a ghost. There were five late Immortal Emperors who had joined forces to deal with Jiang Chen, however they instantly lost sight of Jiang Chen.
“What?”

Nanbei Yitu exclaimed once more. He could feel the threat of death from Jiang Chen. He knew that Jiang Chen had already made up his mind to kill him, also Jiang Chen’s speed was just too fast, so fast that he couldn’t even react.
Jiang Chen gave Nanbei Yitu no chance. He stabbed with his sword.
Nanbei Yitu tried to dodge, but even so, he was still stabbed by the Heavenly Saint Sword. One of his arms was severed. Blood gushed out crazily.
“Save me, save me...!”
Nanbei Yitu was utterly shocked. He shrieked and ran. It made him felt isolated. Even though there were over ten thousand people on the scene, he felt that he was the only one facing Jiang Chen.

A dozen late Immortal Emperors immediately besieged Jiang Chen when they heard Nanbei Yitu’s call for help. They had already locked the void, making it like a death cell. Jiang Chen wouldn’t be able to escape from it even if he had three heads and six arms.
Unfortunately, Jiang Chen still vanished with just a sway of his body. This type of death cell had no effect on him at all. The place where he appeared was precisely in front of Nanbei Yitu.

This time, Nanbei Yitu was stupefied. He began to despair, feeling that he couldn’t escape from Jiang Chen’s grip even with his late Immortal Emperor cultivation base. The opponent’s speed was too fast. He didn’t know how Jiang Chen did it. The siege attack of a dozen late Immortal Emperors was useless to Jiang Chen.

Without another word, Jiang Chen raised the Heavenly Saint Sword and slashed at the injured opponent. Terrifying sword qi interwove into a huge net, entirely enveloping Nanbei Yitu. Along with a miserable wail, he was beheaded, dying on the spot.
Jiang Chen would never be lenient to any member of Nanbei Family. Without delay, he lunged towards the ten-thousand-experts.
“Surround Jiang Chen, we must kill him. He’s too terrifying.”

Someone yelled. A large number of late Immortal Emperors began to notice Jiang Chen. Each of them unleashed their killing intent and charged at Jiang Chen. All of them saw the death of Nanbei Yitu clearly and deeply felt the scariness of Jiang Chen. Such a man was overly heaven defying. He would surely be a huge threat if he was kept alive.
*Hong Long...*
The scene was thrown into chaos. The spatial zone of the Golden Clan had straightaway turned into a vast battlefield. Blood and flesh never stopped spilling.

The enemy’s encampment ahead was incredibly huge, however he had no fear as the Great Void Technique could allow him to appear at any place, and dodge the attack of the enemies.
*Swoosh!*
A pair of dragon wings emerged on his back as he rushed out in a ray of light.
With the Great Void Technique and Nine Phantom Wolves combined together, his speed was simply too fast.
*Keng!*
The Heavenly Saint Sword appeared in his hand and he materialized in front of Nanbei Yitu.
Currently, his cultivation base has already reached the pinnacle of the half-step Immortal Emperor, leaving him only a step away from the true Immortal Emperor realm.

As a matter of fact, during the ten months of seclusion, he should have already broken through to the Immortal Emperor realm, but because of the dragon transformation skill having yet to evolve, it caused his cultivation base to stay stagnant.
Although his cultivation base stagnated, his combat strength had improved tremendously.
He might not be able to fight opponents like Nanbei Yitu before, but now, with his current strength, it was effortless for him to kill Nanbei Yitu.
And with the coordination of the Great Void Technique and Nine Phantom Wolves, he’s allowed to appear at any place, at any time.
He could either choose to attack from the front or from the back, it would surely confuse the opponent.
“Nanbei Yitu, go and die now.”
Jiang Chen’s qi was unparalleled.
After locking on Nanbei Yitu, the terrifying Heavenly Saint Sword slashed downwards from above.
Nanbei Yitu was terrified.
It was an all-out attack of Jiang Chen.
A sense of extreme danger blossomed in his innermost soul.
It also made him feel isolated and helpless.
There were clearly many people around him, but he felt that none of them could provide him any help in the face of Jiang Chen.
Such a feeling was unpleasant.
He didn’t dare believe that Jiang Chen’s strength had become so powerful that it could threaten his life.
In fact, Nanbei Yitu had just advanced to the late Immortal Emperor realm, hence his cultivation base was still very unstable.
As Jiang Chen had gone into his combat mode, he would never show mercy in his attack.
This slash encompassed his most ferocious attack and power.
How could Nanbei Yitu be a match for Jiang Chen?
Out of helplessness, Nanbei Yitu could only lift his sword to block Jiang Chen’s Heavenly Saint Sword.
*Hong Long...*
The void around was torn apart.
The slash of Jiang Chen carried the force of four supreme flames.
Nanbei Yitu was directly sent flying away by the slash.
He let out a wail, spurted out blood and quickly hid in the crowd.
“Nanbei Yitu, I’m going to kill you.
It’s no use hiding in the crowd, no matter how many people there are, I will still kill you.”
Jiang Chen’s voice sounded like the king of hell, cold and emotionless.
As soon as his voice faded, he appeared behind Nanbei Yitu like a ghost.
There were five late Immortal Emperors who had joined forces to deal with Jiang Chen, however they instantly lost sight of Jiang Chen.
“What?”
Nanbei Yitu exclaimed once more.
He could feel the threat of death from Jiang Chen.
He knew that Jiang Chen had already made up his mind to kill him, also Jiang Chen’s speed was just too fast, so fast that he couldn’t even react.
Jiang Chen gave Nanbei Yitu no chance.
He stabbed with his sword.
Nanbei Yitu tried to dodge, but even so, he was still stabbed by the Heavenly Saint Sword.
One of his arms was severed.
Blood gushed out crazily.
“Save me, save me...!”
Nanbei Yitu was utterly shocked.
He shrieked and ran.
It made him felt isolated.
Even though there were over ten thousand people on the scene, he felt that he was the only one facing Jiang Chen.
A dozen late Immortal Emperors immediately besieged Jiang Chen when they heard Nanbei Yitu’s call for help.
They had already locked the void, making it like a death cell.
Jiang Chen wouldn’t be able to escape from it even if he had three heads and six arms.
Unfortunately, Jiang Chen still vanished with just a sway of his body.
This type of death cell had no effect on him at all.
The place where he appeared was precisely in front of Nanbei Yitu.
This time, Nanbei Yitu was stupefied.
He began to despair, feeling that he couldn’t escape from Jiang Chen’s grip even with his late Immortal Emperor cultivation base.
The opponent’s speed was too fast.
He didn’t know how Jiang Chen did it.
The siege attack of a dozen late Immortal Emperors was useless to Jiang Chen.
Without another word, Jiang Chen raised the Heavenly Saint Sword and slashed at the injured opponent.
Terrifying sword qi interwove into a huge net, entirely enveloping Nanbei Yitu.
Along with a miserable wail, he was beheaded, dying on the spot.
Jiang Chen would never be lenient to any member of Nanbei Family.
Without delay, he lunged towards the ten-thousand-experts.
“Surround Jiang Chen, we must kill him.
He’s too terrifying.”
Someone yelled.
A large number of late Immortal Emperors began to notice Jiang Chen.
Each of them unleashed their killing intent and charged at Jiang Chen.
All of them saw the death of Nanbei Yitu clearly and deeply felt the scariness of Jiang Chen.
Such a man was overly heaven defying.
He would surely be a huge threat if he was kept alive.
*Hong Long...*
The scene was thrown into chaos.
The spatial zone of the Golden Clan had straightaway turned into a vast battlefield.
Blood and flesh never stopped spilling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1671 - Great Thousand Mirror
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

The Heaven and Earth shook. Layers of the void were broken. Jiang Chen charged into the crowd like a frenzied killer. Even though he was alone, it was a disaster to the enemy camp. The originally united camp had been broken apart by Jiang Chen. Screeches continued to be heard. Every time Jiang Chen attacked, someone would die.

The Great Void Technique surely is powerful. No wonder the Void Sovereign was able to walk through the Heavens and Earth unhindered and was as powerful as the Immortal Execution King. Just by using the Great Void Technique, I’m able to pass through the enemy camp like an autumn wind, unstoppable.

Jiang Chen was overjoyed. The terror of the Great Void Technique made him even more confident. Around 50 late Immortal Emperors had besieged him at the same time, but none of them could catch a trace of him.
“Jiang Chen, you have killed the people of my family. Yue Family won’t let this matter rest.”
“Goddammit! You have killed my brother. You’re dead Jiang Chen!”
“From now on, Paragon Sect will certainly hunt you down and kill you.”

Innumerable angry voices were heard. Geniuses from various major powers had died in Jiang Chen’s hands. The experts of the ancient families and huge sects were gnashing their teeth in anger. In this battle, Jiang Chen had formed an irreconcilable enmity with numerous sects in the Immortal World.
“Haha...”

Jiang Chen gave a wild laugh, turning a deaf ear to any of their threats. There was a saying that said ‘when you are covered in lice, you will no longer itch; when you are up to ears in debt, you stop worrying’. He had already offended too many major powers. So he wasn’t concerned about which major power he had offended. And since he had already chosen to attack, all those geniuses were doomed to face death.

However, the situation ahead was still extremely unfavourable to him. Although he was destroying the camp, disrupting the cooperation between them, there were just too many of them. His sole strength was simply not enough. Although many experts had joined in the grand formation, Tyrant and the others found it hard to cooperate with the golden warriors as they possessed no spiritual intelligence. Even though they were useful in helping to support the grand formation, their function certainly wasn’t as great as Tyrant and the others had imagined.

Currently, thousands of people were bombarding the grand formation crazily. Cracks continued to emerge on the formation. Although Big Yellow and Tyrant were repairing the damages non-stop, their speed was clearly not as fast as the speed of destruction.

On the other side, Dragon Shisan was still engaged in an intense fight with the six experts. It was already considered remarkable enough that he could entangle the six half-step Immortal Venerables at the same time. This gave him no time to provide aid to Big Yellow and the others.

Jiang Chen understood that Dragon Shisan played the most important and useful role in this battlefield. Imagine if Dragon Shisan wasn’t present, these six half-step Immortal Venerables were already enough to overpower them.
I wonder when the Golden Clan will disappear. If this goes on like this, I’m afraid we won’t be able to hold on much longer.
Jiang Chen shook his head helplessly, but no matter what the outcome was, the most important thing was that they had tried their best.
There was another saying that said ‘do your best and leave the rest to God’s will’. Sometimes, the outcome was truly beyond our control.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*
Just as the war was reaching its peak, an enormous roar suddenly sounded from the interior of the Golden Clan. Countless brilliance shone from inside, virtually filling every corner of the space.

The movement in the Golden Clan stirred people’s heart. At this moment, all of them had stopped their actions and looked up at the sky above. Even the fiercest battle between Dragon Shisan and the six half-step Immortal Venerables had temporarily halted; all of them raised their head to look at the unusual change above.
The chaotic scene instantly became extremely quiet. It was afraid that only the change in the Golden Clan could achieve such an effect.
*Hong Long...*

The sound of the vibration was unparalleled. A big rip appeared in the sky over the Golden Clan. After that, an ancient mirror emerged. That mirror was 30 meters large. Its surface was engraved with complicated dragon marks, noble and dignified, no word seemed to be able to properly describe the qi emitted from the mirror.
Lines of cracks could be seen on the mirror. The plane of the mirror was golden and radiated primitive brilliance. Undeniably, the mirror was old. No one could determine how long had it existed.
“What a magical mirror! I wonder why it emerged in the Golden Clan,” said someone in surprise.
“It’s the Great Thousand Mirror. The mirror isn’t broken and had been kept in good condition all this while.” Big Yellow exclaimed, calling out the name of the mirror.

“What? It’s the legendary Great Thousand Mirror? It’s said that the Great Thousand Mirror was created by dozens of Great Sovereigns during the ancient times. It could project the virtual image of the universe.”
“It’s also said that it can illuminate the Heavens and thousands of worlds. It could purify people’s soul. Its interior contained a massive world.”
“There are a lot of legends about the Great Thousand Mirror, but there’s no question about the divinity of this mirror. I never thought that this ancient mirror will emerge here.”

“Sure enough, there are treasures everywhere in the Golden Horizon. First was the Xiao Yao Qin, and now, it’s the Great Thousand Mirror! I believe that the Gold Feather Fan is also in this place, but Jiang Chen and his comrades are hindering us from entering, thinking as though a mantis can stop a chariot. They are simply looking for death!”
Everyone was shocked. Stories related to the mirror began to spread. This was a divine mirror that could illuminate everything.
“Look, there seems to be an image in the mirror!” someone shouted aloud.
Countless eyes looked over and saw extremely blurry images in the mirror, but as Immortal Emperors, they had pretty sharp eyesight. They were able to see what the images were despite the vagueness.

The images on the Great Thousand Mirror flickered constantly. They could clearly feel the unparalleled and earth-shattering war taking place inside the mirror. The world was being destroyed. Shadows of cultivators continued to appear at various places. Each of those images was powerful to the extreme - they could move mountains, fill up the ocean and annihilate the world, absolutely all-powerful. The interior of the mirror had been turned into an immense battlefield.
“This is a projection from tens of thousands of years ago.”
“That’s right. This is the great war that took place that year. It was recorded by the Great Thousand Mirror and was left behind.”

“What has actually happened in that war? I saw the shadows of Great Sovereigns. They were the unparalleled Great Sovereigns that could cross the world with a single step. Each of them was full of the demeanor of a Great Sovereign.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1672 - The Secret of Big Yellow
paragraphs: 1st of the week!

The projection of the ancient mirror caught everyone’s breath. Many people had guessed that those images belonged to the ancient great war that took place tens of thousands of years ago, but what had actually happened during that time? Why was such a huge clan wiped out? Would the secret behind everything be revealed to them by the Great Thousand Mirror?

Jiang Chen’s expression turned dignified as he looked unblinkingly at the mirror. The images in the mirror flickered continuously, sometimes clear, sometimes blurry, however it was already considered not bad based on the fact that the images were kept for tens of thousands of years.

On top of a 30 000-meter-tall mountain stood a middle-aged man with a strong built body, his hand holding a huge golden fan. As he waved ferociously forward, the whole world seemed to moved. Large batches of cultivators in his path were blown to death by the fan. This move had killed at least ten thousand enemies.
It was a pity that only see the shadows of the enemies could be seen and not their faces, nor the truth about how the war began.
“The Gold Feather Fan! That’s the Golden Great Sovereign. My God! He’s so domineering. The legendary Gold Feather Fan is said to be able to move anything, absolutely unimaginable.”
“That’s the projection of the Golden Great Sovereign, the leader of the Golden Clan, the ancient Great Sovereign that was on par with Immortal Execution King and Great Sovereign Zang Xian.”

“That’s an extremely fierce war. Even the Golden Great Sovereign himself took part in the war and displayed the Gold Feather Fan, however why can’t we see the faces of the enemies clearly? Could it be that the Great Thousand Mirror couldn’t display the true faces of those enemies?”
Even though the majestic gesture of the Golden Great Sovereign were tens of thousands of years ago, it had subdued all of them. The bearing he projected transcended everything.

The picture changed. A woman in a red dress held an ancient *qin. The surface of the qin was covered with a layer of raging flames. Her unparalleled beauty suffocated men. She was standing in the void, looking at the dark tunnel with incredible length above. It was a big hole in the void.
“It’s Empress Xiao Yao! Look, she’s holding the Xiao Yao Qin in her arms.”

Someone cried out. They hadn’t seen Empress Xiao Yao before, but they remembered the appearance of the musical instrument. Not long ago, Wu Ningzhu had acquired the Xiao Yao Qin when it emerged. That ancient qin matched perfectly with this image. The image was eons ago, anyone could guess that she was Empress Xiao Yao herself.
“Right enough, she had an unsurpassed beauty and elegance, and was the all-powerful empress that could display endless talent.”
“What had happened that year? Could it be that the powerful empress had really died?”

“Such a figure possess the same lifespan as the Heavens and Earth. It’s hard to believe that she had really died. Since, the Great Thousand Mirror emitted no sound and only recorded the images, we don’t have any idea what had happened during that year.”
Everybody was startled by the picture of Empress Xiao Yao, even though it was incomplete.
Finally, Empress Xiao Yao leaped into the dark tunnel, carrying the Xiao Yao Qin. No one had any idea where she was heading.

The picture changed once more. An old daoist holding a divine whip was yelling something across the void at the top of his lungs. Unfortunately, his voice couldn’t be transmitted out of the mirror, his tragic emotion, although it had been thousands of years ago, could still be clearly felt, however.
“What had happened? What’s going on? Why do those ancient Sovereigns, omnipotent Immortal Sovereigns, seemed so miserable?”

Jiang Chen couldn’t remain calm. Scenes of the tragedy were everywhere in the mirror. Mountains and rivers had been crushed. Blood and flesh were flying everywhere. Many silhouettes could be seen. The immemorial war was ongoing. The only deficiency about the projection was that they couldn’t see the true faces of the enemies.

Jiang Chen turned to Big Yellow who now seemed petrified, looking obsessively at the scenes in the mirror, as though he had recalled some old memory. Jiang Chen could clearly see the tears at the corners of the dog’s eyes. This dog was truly moved by scene.
“Big Yellow, tell me what happened. You should’ve known what had happened.”
Jiang Chen came to Big Yellow’s side and prompted through divine sense. He was afraid that he might go crazy if Big Yellow still refused to tell him even at this time.
Unexpectedly, Big Yellow only shook his head and didn’t say no.
But after a long time, he spoke, “Little Chen, you have seen it. The Great Sovereigns are falling. It hasn’t reached the time for you to know yet.”

Suddenly, the scenes changed again. A youth wearing a cloak was standing in the void. He seemed to be fifteen or sixteen years old, but his cultivation base had reached a heaven-defying extent - he was also a mighty ancient Sovereign. He was surrounded by countless enemies, trapped in the circle of death. A golden horn had appeared on top of his head. He roared frenziedly at the sky and his body began to transform. The only pity was that the pictures disappeared completely at this moment, making it impossible for them to see what had happened after that.
“That’s a youth who is also a Great Sovereign. No, he is a Demon Sovereign. It seemed like he had been besieged, unfortunately the scenes have vanished.
“It’s a tragedy that even those Great Sovereigns have to die. What a terrible war!”
“No one knew what really happened back then. The images left in the Great Thousand Mirror are just remnants of the scenes.”
Many of them sighed. Such a huge war was simply beyond their imagination and acceptance.

However, at the last moment of the young Sovereign’s disappearance, Big Yellow got irritated abruptly and roared frantically at the sky. He had seen something that the others couldn’t see from the mirror.

Jiang Chen and Han Yan were startled. The current sight of Big Yellow gave them heartache. Tears filled his face and his roars were full of endless melancholy. They had never seen him in such a way, however they could imagine that the pictures in the mirror must have stimulated Big Yellow’s heart.

The scenes in the mirror continued to change. After several minutes, the Great Thousand Mirror began to let out a buzzing noise and shook violently. They realised that the mirror was going to disappear. At this time, Big Yellow suddenly soared towards the mirror.
“Big Yellow!”
Jiang Chen and Han Yan yelled, but Big Yellow didn’t seem to hear them, as if he was totally immersed in his own objective.
“Big Yellow, what are you doing? That’s a mirror.”
“Not good, the Great Thousand Mirror has formed an independent spatial universe inside. Big Yellow wants to go into it.” Tyrant and Han Yan were astounded, their faces were full of worries.

In just a matter of a few blinks, Big Yellow rushed into the Great Thousand Mirror. Then, a ray of divine light shot out of the mirror, reaching its target impartially. The target was precisely Jiang Chen.

At the same time, Big Yellow’s voice was heard in Jiang Chen’s ears. “Little Chen, control the Sun Divine Feather, guard the bloodline of the Golden Clan and my natal talisman. When you become strong enough, come to the Desolate Ancient Land and save me.”
*Qin - A plucked seven-string Chinese musical instrument of the zither family.
Edited by: Lifer, Fingerfox

Jiang Chen turned to Big Yellow who now seemed petrified, looking obsessively at the scenes in the mirror, as though he had recalled some old memory.
Jiang Chen could clearly see the tears at the corners of the dog’s eyes.
This dog was truly moved by scene.
“Big Yellow, tell me what happened.
You should’ve known what had happened.”
Jiang Chen came to Big Yellow’s side and prompted through divine sense.
He was afraid that he might go crazy if Big Yellow still refused to tell him even at this time.
Unexpectedly, Big Yellow only shook his head and didn’t say no.
But after a long time, he spoke, “Little Chen, you have seen it.
The Great Sovereigns are falling.
It hasn’t reached the time for you to know yet.”
Suddenly, the scenes changed again.
A youth wearing a cloak was standing in the void.
He seemed to be fifteen or sixteen years old, but his cultivation base had reached a heaven-defying extent - he was also a mighty ancient Sovereign.
He was surrounded by countless enemies, trapped in the circle of death.
A golden horn had appeared on top of his head.
He roared frenziedly at the sky and his body began to transform.
The only pity was that the pictures disappeared completely at this moment, making it impossible for them to see what had happened after that.
“That’s a youth who is also a Great Sovereign.
No, he is a Demon Sovereign.
It seemed like he had been besieged, unfortunately the scenes have vanished.
“It’s a tragedy that even those Great Sovereigns have to die.
What a terrible war!”
“No one knew what really happened back then.
The images left in the Great Thousand Mirror are just remnants of the scenes.”
Many of them sighed.
Such a huge war was simply beyond their imagination and acceptance.
However, at the last moment of the young Sovereign’s disappearance, Big Yellow got irritated abruptly and roared frantically at the sky.
He had seen something that the others couldn’t see from the mirror.
Jiang Chen and Han Yan were startled.
The current sight of Big Yellow gave them heartache.
Tears filled his face and his roars were full of endless melancholy.
They had never seen him in such a way, however they could imagine that the pictures in the mirror must have stimulated Big Yellow’s heart.
The scenes in the mirror continued to change.
After several minutes, the Great Thousand Mirror began to let out a buzzing noise and shook violently.
They realised that the mirror was going to disappear.
At this time, Big Yellow suddenly soared towards the mirror.
“Big Yellow!”
Jiang Chen and Han Yan yelled, but Big Yellow didn’t seem to hear them, as if he was totally immersed in his own objective.
“Big Yellow, what are you doing?
That’s a mirror.”
“Not good, the Great Thousand Mirror has formed an independent spatial universe inside.
Big Yellow wants to go into it.” Tyrant and Han Yan were astounded, their faces were full of worries.
In just a matter of a few blinks, Big Yellow rushed into the Great Thousand Mirror.
Then, a ray of divine light shot out of the mirror, reaching its target impartially.
The target was precisely Jiang Chen.
At the same time, Big Yellow’s voice was heard in Jiang Chen’s ears.
“Little Chen, control the Sun Divine Feather, guard the bloodline of the Golden Clan and my natal talisman.
When you become strong enough, come to the Desolate Ancient Land and save me.”
*Qin - A plucked seven-string Chinese musical instrument of the zither family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1673 - Sun Divine Feather
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
This was Big Yellow’s last words before disappearing along with the mirror, as though they were never there.
“Big Yellow!”

Jiang Chen bellowed hoarsely. At this moment, tears trickled down his face. His heart was about to stop beating. He could feel the sadness buried in the depths of Big Yellow’s heart. All the memory he had with Big Yellow were appearing in his head non-stop.
You would never know how important something or someone was until you lost it. Right now, Jiang Chen was heartbroken and upset.
He suddenly felt that he had really lost Big Yellow. Only now did he understood that Big Yellow had been an indispensable part of his life. His remaining life was going to be dim without him.

He lowered his head. Apart from the mystical feather in his hand, there was also a spiritual talisman. He knew that this was the last thing Big Yellow gave him. It was the only clue he had in finding Big Yellow in the future.
He then gingerly kept the talisman in the Ancestral Dragon Pagoda.
‘Desolate Ancient Land, Big Yellow, I will certainly come for you. You just have to wait for me,’ said Jiang Chen firmly.

What and where, the place wasn’t really important, because he would find out sooner or later. Big Yellow had kept too many secrets from him because he still had loads to catch up in terms of cultivation.

Until now, there was still no news of Yan Chenyu, while Wu Ningzhu had vanished along with the inheritance of Empress Xiao Yao, and now Big Yellow had also left him. All of these made Jiang Chen depressed.
“Little Chen, where has Big Yellow gone to?”

Han Yan and Tyrant came to Jiang Chen’s side and asked. They had also been through life-and-death experience with Big Yellow. Now that Big Yellow left, they naturally felt that their heart was sinking.
“He has gone to a very distant place. Don’t worry. We are going to meet again.” Jiang Chen smiled, then shifted his gaze to the feather.

The feather was golden in colour. There was a wisp of flame on its surface. The flame is the Fire of Sun and the feather is the Sun Divine Feather, a feather stripped from the Gold Feather Fan. It was 3 meters long and weighed thousands of kilograms in Jiang Chen’s hand.
“It’s the Sun Divine Feather. The treasure in Jiang Chen’s hand is the Sun Divine Feather which came from the Great Thousand Mirror.”
“That’s right. It has to be the Sun Divine Feather, peeled off from the Gold Feather Fan. One feather is worth a city. This trip is going to be so fruitful if I can get it.”
“Kill, kill Jiang Chen and seize the Sun Divine Feather! He’s just a half-step Immortal Emperor, he isn’t qualified to get it.”
“The Sun Divine Feather is a divine item and a part of a peerless Sovereign Weapon. Only the strongest have the right to possess it. What gave Jiang Chen the right to obtain it?”

The quiet scene suddenly turned chaotic. No one knew what method Big Yellow used to throw out a divine feather from the mirror. This had immediately set off thousands of waves. That’s a sacred item of the Golden Clan. Everyone would surely be shaken by it. Whoever could control the Sun Divine Feather would be able to conquer the world instantly.

Jiang Chen ignored all the threats. The Sun Divine Feather was bouncing continuously in his hand, seemingly about to break free from his grip. Hastily he circulated the Fire of Sun and enveloped it with the flame. As though feeling the qi of its origin, the divine feather stopped moving and established a subtle connection with Jiang Chen.

However, he felt that even though he could obtain the recognition of the Sun Divine Feather, it would be very difficult to exert its true power that weighed more than a ton. But then again, at this moment, the Immortal Mark that had been hiding silently inside his Qi Sea was activated once more.
He was taken aback that the divine feather had triggered the Immortal Mark. One should know that it had remained silent ever since he ascended to the Immortal World.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

The Immortal Mark bounced aggressively. He didn’t know the origin of it, but with the help of the Immortal Mark, the Sun Divine Feather seemed to have become closer to him. He could clearly sense that the feather was going to become part of his body. Integration was more important compared to recognition. Although recognition indicated that Jiang Chen could wield the Sun Divine Feather, with the help of the Immortal Mark, he could exert the greatest force of the divine feather.
This was a feather taken from an unparalleled Sovereign Weapon. The damage that it could do was beyond imagination.
“Jiang Chen, hand the Sun Divine Feather over and I can spare your life today.”
Xia Xiaotian shouted at Jiang Chen. His eyes were full of greed as he stared at the divine feather in Jiang Chen’s hand.

“Jiang Chen, even the Great Thousand Mirror and the Sun Divine Feather have emerged. There must be an even greater treasure in the Golden Clan. Many Great Sovereigns have fallen in there eons ago. Now that the clan has shown up again, the inside must be full of treasures. Do you really think that you can stop us?” Zhang Yulang yelled.

At this moment, most of their eyes had already become red. The greed and desire inside of them were eroding their consciousness. Just like what Zhang Yulang said, the scenes in the Great Thousand Mirror had shown them clearly that numerous Great Sovereigns had died in there. Anyone who tried to stop them from entering the territory would become public enemy.
“Jiang Chen, I will give you ten breaths of time to move away. Otherwise, you will die.”

Fengyun Zi’s qi was domineering. At this time, they were no longer concerned about Dragon Shisan. The Sun Divine Feather had drawn all of their attention. They would never be foolish enough to fight Dragon Shisan again.

Upon seeing this, Dragon Shisan began to worry. The situation was undoubtedly very unfavourable to Jiang Chen. Earlier, he had kept the six great experts busy as the six of them had placed their focus on him, regarding him as the greatest threat.

But now, their focus had been shifted. They were no longer interested in engaging a life-or-death battle with him. Even with his ability, he could only stop two experts at most, the remaining four would be left unguarded, which would jeopardize Jiang Chen’s life.
Facing the pressure of thousands of people, Jiang Chen’s hair fluttered frenziedly. His qi soared up to the sky. The Sun Divine Feather held in his hand seemed to disdain all beings in the world.
“Before Big Yellow left, he has entrusted me to guard the bloodline of the Golden Clan at all costs. As long as I’m here, anyone who dares to approach the gateway will DIE.”
Jiang Chen’s tone was cold and heavy. At this point, he seemed to have become a god of slaughter. The Sun Divine Feather in his hand was blazing with fire.
Many of them frowned, feeling slightly frightened by the sight of the divine feather.
“This man can’t control the Sun Divine Feather, can he?” someone said.
“Impossible. The Sun Divine Feather is a Great Sovereign Weapon. He’s just a puny half-step Immortal Emperor. How could he control it?” The crowd of people shook their heads.

chapters.title: Chapter 1674 - Killing two people at once
paragraphs: 2nd of the week!

The scene was getting out of control. The temptation of the Sun Divine Feather was just too great to the people on the scene. It wasn’t the same as the Xiao Yao Qin, a Sovereign Weapon that chose its own master, in which they could do nothing about.

The Sun Divine Feather was after all gotten from the Gold Feather Fan, and came out of the Great Thousand Mirror on its own, without choosing any successor. In other words, the divine feather had no master. Jiang Chen was lucky to have gotten it while everyone had yet to regain their senses.

There were too many cultivators and geniuses here. Most of them thought that they carried great luck. Even if they couldn’t obtain the Sun Divine Feather, they wouldn’t let a puny half-step Immortal Emperor have it.

More importantly, Jiang Chen was now guarding the doors of the Golden Clan, not letting anyone of them enter. The situation was obvious. There were treasures all over the territory of the Golden Clan, but Jiang Chen was preventing them from getting those treasures. This kind of enmity was even greater than vengeance created from murdering their wives and seizing their kids.

There was one more important fact. For the sake of guarding the doors of the Golden Clan, numerous enmity and grudges had been formed. If they didn’t take this opportunity to kill Jiang Chen now, it would become extremely difficult for them to do so after Jiang Chen left Golden Horizon.
“Don’t waste time conversing with him, kill him straight away!”

Zhang Yulang was the first to attack. He believed that Jiang Chen wouldn’t dare to dodge, because if Jiang Chen really did, he would be able to break the Five Elemental Grand Formation and enter the territory of the Golden Clan.
Upon seeing that Zhang Yulang was ready to attack Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan responded, intending to block the attack with the Battle Saint Technique.
“Let him come!”

Jiang Chen shouted at Dragon Shisan, signaling the monkey to not interfere. With the help of Fire of Sun and Immortal Mark, Jiang Chen had fully controlled the Sun Divine Feather. Now that Zhang Yulang was rushing over, it was the right time to test the power of the divine feather.
*Swoosh!*
Jiang Chen attacked. The Sun Divine Feather was swept at Zhang Yulang.
*Hong Long...*

This strike trembled even the Heavens and Earth. The void was straightaway ripped into halves. The Sun Divine Feather turned into the most terrifying weapon in the world. The Fire of Sun around it seemed to be burning the void.
“Not good!”

Zhang Yulang was alarmed. A strong chilling intent rose from the depths of his heart. That was the taste of death. He had never thought that Jiang Chen really could display the power of the Sun Divine Feather. Given his current strength, he had no chance of surviving the attack from the divine feather.

Losing the urge to kill Jiang Chen, what he wanted to do now was to flee from the Sun Divine Feather. This was the most critical juncture. He cast out all of his techniques, intending to escape into the interior of the void, but to his surprise, the entire void had been sealed by the divine feather. The whole place had become a cage, a cage of death.
Finally, the Sun Divine Feather turned into a towering sharp sword coated with intense flames and cut downwards, splitting the body of Zhang Yulang in half with a ‘Chi La’ sound.
Zhang Yulang let out a shrill cry. The severed body began to burn, and in just a matter of a few blinks, the parts were completely incinerated, no remains were left behind.
Zhang Yulang had died. A monstrous genius, an unparalleled figure of Immortal Court had disappeared from the world just like that, as though he had never existed.

Everyone exclaimed with shock. Countless eyes fell upon the burning Sun Divine Feather in Jiang Chen’s hand. Even Dragon Shisan, Han Yan and the rest were lost for words. Many of them felt as if they were dreaming, thinking that all of these couldn’t be real.
“My God! What have I just seen? The mighty Zhang Yulang is eliminated just like that? Jiang Chen truly is able to control the Sun Divine Feather!”
“How-how is that possible? Even if he has earned the recognition of the Sun Divine Feather, given his cultivation base, how could he display the true power of the divine feather?”

“This is going to be troublesome. With the Sun Divine Feather in his hand, who else can be his match? Even the half-step Immortal Venerable is killed with just a single strike. I’m afraid our death is certain if we go fight him now.”

No one had thought that such a scene would occur. Originally, everyone was determined to exterminate Jiang Chen and his comrades then rush into the Golden Clan to obtain numerous treasures. Perhaps they might be able to acquire more than one divine feather in there, which would bring them unimaginable advantages.
But now, Jiang Chen was standing in front of the gateway of the Golden Clan like an invincible war god. No outsider could take a step near it.
“Jiang Chen, how dare you kill a genius of Immortal Court?! No one else in this world will be able to save you anymore.”

Although feeling panic-stricken, Lu Sheng shouted at Jiang Chen with gritted teeth. Using the Immortal Court as his background, he always feel high and mighty, and that no one would dare to touch him, and the truth was also the same - no one in the entire Ethereal Immortal Domain dared to kill the people of Immortal Court.

Jiang Chen raised his head to Lu Sheng. Without a word, he thrust forward with the Sun Divine Feather. Since he had killed one, it made no difference if he killed another one. Once one made such a powerful enemy, the best way to deal with it was to eliminate it to save any future troubles.

Lu Sheng was utterly startled. He had never thought that Jiang Chen’s insanity had reached such an extent. Killing Zhang Yulang wasn’t enough for Jiang Chen, and now he was going to kill him too. Lu Sheng finally understood that it was impossible to use the name of the Immortal Court to oppress Jiang Chen as Jiang Chen would never be scared of it.
“Jiang Chen, you dare...?! Ah...”

Lu Sheng tried his best to resist, but he was absolutely no match for the Sun Divine Feather. The instant the wave of the divine feather hit him, he was turned into a ball of fire and burned until nothing was left behind.

Two had died in a matter of blinks. Both of them were half-step Immortal Venerables, both were also figures of Immortal Court from Ethereal Immortal Domain. Jiang Chen had utterly offended the Immortal Court.
“Dammit! Isn’t that too fing good?!” Grandmaster Haoran couldn’t help but swear. His eyes were full of astonishment.

“I had never thought that the legendary Sun Divine Feather was this powerful. What is even more surprising is that Jiang Chen can actually control it. Not only that, it’s almost unbelievable that he’s able to exert the power of the divine feather. However wielding the Sun Divine Feather requires tremendous energy. I wonder how many times Jiang Chen can display its power.”

Yang Lang had lost his composure. He had never expected that not only could Jiang Chen wield the Sun Divine Feather, but also integrate it with his body. In other words, the Sun Divine Feather had become a part of his body and could be used at any time without worrying about energy depletion, which was the truly heaven-defying part.

The instant the wave of the divine feather hit him, he was turned into a ball of fire and burned until nothing was left behind.
Two had died in a matter of blinks.
Both of them were half-step Immortal Venerables, both were also figures of Immortal Court from Ethereal Immortal Domain.
Jiang Chen had utterly offended the Immortal Court.
“Dammit!
Isn’t that too fing good?!” Grandmaster Haoran couldn’t help but swear.
His eyes were full of astonishment.
“I had never thought that the legendary Sun Divine Feather was this powerful.
What is even more surprising is that Jiang Chen can actually control it.
Not only that, it’s almost unbelievable that he’s able to exert the power of the divine feather.
However wielding the Sun Divine Feather requires tremendous energy.
I wonder how many times Jiang Chen can display its power.”
Yang Lang had lost his composure.
He had never expected that not only could Jiang Chen wield the Sun Divine Feather, but also integrate it with his body.
In other words, the Sun Divine Feather had become a part of his body and could be used at any time without worrying about energy depletion, which was the truly heaven-defying part.
