chapters.title: Chapter 1675 - The Dao of Slaughter
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

In Yang Lang and Mo Wuqing’s point of view, the reason that Jiang Chen could wield the Sun Divine Feather was because of the Fire of Sun in his body, which was also why he had earned the recognition of the divine feather. However, they couldn’t understand why he was able to exert such immense power from the divine feather. Even if he could display the divine feather’s power, the energy consumption each use was enormous. Given his current cultivation base, he could display its power once at most. This was akin to the time when Big Yellow exerted the power of the Immortal Execution Sword.
As a matter of fact, the thing that truly helped Jiang Chen wasn’t just the Fire of Sun, but also the Immortal Mark in his body.
With the Immortal Mark, he was able to exert the power of the Sun Divine Feather for innumerable times.

Zhang Yulang and Lu Sheng were killed. Two great geniuses of Ethereal Immortal Domain had fallen just like that. The scene had become silent all of a sudden. The remaining four half-step Immortal Venerables looked fearfully at Jiang Chen and at the Sun Divine Feather in his grip.

Jiang Chen stood in the void, his body was full of golden flames, seemingly like a peerless god of slaughter disdaining all sentient beings of the world. He looked around and spoke loudly, “I, Jiang Chen, don’t want to kill the innocent. I will give you all a chance to retreat now, go back to your respective sects until the inheritance of the Golden Clan disappears. Anyone who has the intention of breaking into the territory of the Golden Clan will be killed without question.”

Waves of Jiang Chen’s thunderous voice reached the ears of the crowd. He wanted everybody to know that he was absolutely not joking around. He hoped that the death of Zhang Yulang and Lu Sheng had rung the warning bell. If these people refused to stop, this place was bound to be washed by streams of blood.

The atmosphere turned dead silent, everyone’s eyes were on the Sun Divine Feather in Jiang Chen’s hands and the Golden Clan. Their eyes were brimming with fear. They saw how Jiang Chen killed Zhang Yulang and Lu Sheng clearly. It was impossible for them to be not afraid of him.
Nevertheless, the greed and desire in their eyes couldn’t be concealed. This was an opportunity that none of them wanted to miss.

“Even the Great Thousand Mirror and Sun Divine Feather have appeared. There should be unimaginable treasures inside the Golden Clan. Besides, the Golden Horizon only opened once every five years. Many of us won’t be eligible anymore to join the next expedition. The inheritance of the Golden Clan has been hidden for tens of thousands of years; today was its first apearing, and probably the only time it will emerge. If we don’t cherish this opportunity, we surely won’t have a second chance. Jiang Chen has already used the Sun Divine Feather twice. I don’t think he’s still able to use it for the third time. Given his ruthless behavior, if he’s still able to use the divine weapon, instead of standing there, he would have already launched a massacre. So I think that he could no longer exert the power of the Sun Divine Feather. Let’s attack together. We must break into the territory of the Golden Clan!” someone amongst the crowd shouted.

He was a late Immortal Emperor. When Jiang Chen looked over and sensed the gloomy cold qi from him. Judging from the uniform he wore, Jiang Chen instantly recognized that he was from Corpse Yin Sect, the sect which Jiang Chen hated the most.
As soon as these words were spoken, the crowd was stirred once more. Numerous people began to unleash their killing intent and qi. They all thought that the man’s words were right.

“He’s right. Jiang Chen is a ruthless man. After obtaining the Sun Divine Feather, how can he let go of the chance of killing his enemies? He must have known that he couldn’t continue using the divine feather anymore. So he’s trying to deter us with the death of Zhang Yulang and Lu Sheng. We almost fell for it.”

“He’s just a half-step Immortal Emperor. Even though he was able to kill two supreme experts with the help of the Sun Divine Feather, it’s impossible for him to continue using the power of the divine feather as not even an Immortal Venerable can do it.”
“He’s just trying to scare us. Don’t be afraid of him, everyone. It’s not easy for us to encounter the emergence of the Golden Clan. Once we miss it, we won’t have another chance.”
Most of their minds were clouded by their desire. Some of their eyes had already become as red as a wild beast.
Upon seeing this, Jiang Chen couldn’t help but shake his head. Once one’s mind was controlled by greed, one would no longer be different from a wild beast.

The corners of Jiang Chen’s mouth revealed a cold sneer. Icy cold light glinted his eyes. Cold killing intent poured out of his body. He would never forget the last words of Big Yellow - control the Sun Divine Feather and guard the bloodline of the Golden Clan. Now, it seemed like numerous people would have to die today.
Kill!
This had become the will of Jiang Chen. Apart from killing, he had no other way. The Sun Divine Feather was trembling violently. His killing intent was getting thicker and thicker.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

Suddenly, a buzzing sound was emitted from his innermost soul. His heart shook fiercely. He could feel a desolate killing intent coming from the depths of his soul. That’s right. That was a solid killing intent that came from nothingness and antiquity.
It’s the dragon transformation skill. This is a sign indicating its evolution.

Jiang Chen was overjoyed. The dragon transformation skill hadn’t evolved for a long time. This was precisely the obstacle that hindered him from advancing to the Immortal Emperor realm. Currently, the dragon transformation skill was showing signs of evolution once again. He was pretty familiar with the changes because this wasn’t his first time encountering it.

He knew that it was his intent to kill and firm belief that had triggered the metamorphosis of the technique once again. Presently, the ancient killing intent that came from the dragon transformation skill had merged with his body.
Kill! Kill! Kill!

The killing intent was majestic. He could almost see the ancient dragon of slaughter spiraling in his innermost soul. The eyes of the massive ancient dragon showed no signs of emotion. Its existence seemed to represent a will and realm that was akin to the Dao of Slaughter.

That was right. It was the Dao of Slaughter. The dragon transformation skill was unmatched and one of a kind. Whoever cultivated the dragon transformation skill was bound to walk the path of constant massacre. Today, Jiang Chen had triggered the Dao of Slaughter hidden in the dragon transformation skill due to an important matter in Golden Horizon, which he knew was the sign for the next transformation and the essence of a Great Dao.
*Roar...*

Jiang Chen’s eyes went blood-red as he suddenly roared towards the sky. The dragon transformation skill didn’t evolve and advance immediately. Jiang Chen needed to use massacre and determination to slowly stimulate the metamorphosis of the technique. Right now, his will was filled with killing.

Such type of killing wasn’t like killing the innocent. It was the killing intent of a Great Dao. There seemed to be a voice constantly telling Jiang Chen to kill his enemies or anyone who was detrimental to him. All of these people ahead wanted his life, in that case, he would have to kill all of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1676 - Slaughtering in all directions
paragraphs: 3rd of the week!
The dragon was the spirit of Heaven and Earth, and the noblest existence.
There were dragons of compassion, malevolence, valour, loyalty, tenacity and slaughter, and bloodthirsty dragon, devil-subduing dragon and unyielding dragon!

In order for the dragon transformation skill to evolve, Jiang Chen needed to integrate the will of all dragons—compassion, the good and the evil, loyalty, unyielding, tenacity, bloodthirsty and slaughter—into one unit; only then could it be called the ancestral dragon of Heaven and Earth and the strongest. For the sake of guarding the Golden Clan, Jiang Chen made the whole world his enemy. While being besieged by thousands of people, his churning blood had stimulated the dragon of slaughter which was the Dao of Slaughter in the dragon transformation skill.

What is slaughter? Those who adored evil, but put up the facade of kindness could be killed. Those of different Daos could be killed. Enemies could be killed. Those who opposed him could be killed. There were innumerable killings in the Heavens and Earth that weren’t subjected to the existence of justice and evil, but invariable conscience.

Jiang Chen had to slaughter because the others wanted to kill him. The nobility of the dragon couldn’t be blasphemed, despised, stigmatized and humiliated, otherwise, the person who did that would be killed!

He continued to comprehend the Dao of Slaughter. He knew that this was a major opportunity for the dragon transformation skill to evolve. A bloody storm and a ground-shaking massacre was destined to set off today.
“Bring it on, I will massacre you all!”

Jiang Chen’s murderous intent intensified. His voice echoed like thunder. There was a blood-red dragon that was fully condensed out of killing intent hovering above his head. He then lunged at Fengyun Zi, holding the Sun Divine Feather.

He was thirsty to kill but he wouldn’t kill indiscriminately, he knew very well that this was the Dao of Slaughter. Fengyun Zi and the other half-step Immortal Venerables had to die. There was no doubt about it. And since he had already decided to kill, he would naturally start from them.
“Not good. This man is insane.”

Fengyun Zi was utterly startled, but instead of dodging, he launched out the Nine Heavenly Thunder. Like the others, he didn’t believe that Jiang Chen could use the Sun Divine Feather. Even if Jiang Chen could use it, the power he could display wouldn’t be as powerful compared to before. Therefore, Fengyun Zi felt that his full-fledged attack would have no trouble stopping Jiang Chen. He might even have the chance to seize the divine feather from Jiang Chen.
But the fact proved that Fengyun Zi was simply too naive.
*Hong Long...*

His attack couldn’t even withstand the attack of the formidable Sun Divine Feather and was eliminated in a split second. Then, the divine feather slapped his body violently with mountainous force. With a miserable cry, he was reduced to pieces—dead.
*Swoosh!*

After getting rid of Fengyun Zi, Jiang Chen shifted his eyes to Xia Xiaotian. The murderous intent inside his body was surging fiercely. The roar of the ancestral dragon in the depths of his soul goaded him into killing more.
“Xia Xiaotian, die now.” Jiang Chen struck at his opponent like a war god.

Upon seeing this, Xia Xiaotian was completely startled. Everything happened too fast. He had never thought that such a scene would happen even in his dream. The tables were turned in an instant. With the Sun Divine Feather, Jiang Chen had killed three half-step Immortal Venerables. Now, it was his turn. He was more than willing to believe that Jiang Chen had no strength to wield the Sun Divine Feather anymore, but judging from Jiang Chen’s overwhelming killing intent, Jiang Chen seemed far from suffering energy depletion.
“Run!”

Xia Xiaotian didn’t have the courage to go against the Sun Divine Feather. Regardless of whether Jiang Chen could still exert its power or not, he was reluctant to gamble with his life. In the face of the threat of death, all treasures had become mundane.
*Ka Cha!*

However, when Xia Xiaotian attempted to tear into the void and escape, he was horrified to find that the space had already been sealed by scorching flames, which was the power of the Sun Divine Feather. He was unable to break it.
*Chi La!*
He had no chance of survival, and was cut in half by the ruthless divine feather and incinerated.

Four out of the six half-step Immortal Venerables had died in just a matter of a few blinks, leaving only Young Master Yulong and Ye Qingtian. Yulong didn’t choose to flee after seeing the tragic death of Xia Xiaotian as he longed very much for the treasures in the Golden Clan and didn’t believe that Jiang Chen, a mere half-step Immortal Emperor, could use the Sun Divine Feather for the fifth time.

“Ye Qingtian, go straight into the gateway of the Golden Clan. As long as we enter the clan’s territory, we won’t need to fear Jiang Chen anymore. After obtaining the incredible treasures inside, we will come out to eradicate him!”

Young Master Yulong clamoured at Ye Qingtian, and immediately flew towards the golden doors. At the same time, he shouted at the thousands of people, “Jiang Chen’s exhausted. Let’s work together and break the doors of the Golden Clan!”
*Hong...* *Hong...*

Yulong’s words triggered countless of people. All of them began to unleash their qi and charged at the golden doors. The appearance of the Sun Divine Feather drove many crazy. Even the death of the four half-step Immortal Venerables couldn’t awaken these people from their delusion. Once a person went mad, he would do whatever it takes to get what he wanted. Furthermore, they all thought that their camp was overpowering. They believed that Jiang Chen wouldn’t be able to continue using the divine feather. No matter how powerful the divine feather was, it wouldn’t be able to kill all of them. At least, they believed that they wouldn’t be the one to die as they were the lucky ones.
This type of thinking was undoubtedly scary.
*Buzz...* *Buzz...*

The will to kill in Jiang Chen’s soul got even stronger. The crazy behaviour of his enemies was driving him mad. He thrust at Young Master Yulong with the Sun Divine Feather, and at the same time, he shouted at Dragon Shisan, “Monkey, I’ll leave Ye Qingtian to you.”
“Rest assured, I will kill him.”

Dragon Shisan too, had regained his senses. He hadn’t pondered why Jiang Chen was able to use the Sun Divine Feather indefinitely because that was no longer important. What was more important was that Jiang Chen had become stronger and that Ye Qingtian was left for him, Dragon Shisan, to handle. He had sufficient confidence to eliminate this enemy. Five of the half-step Immortal Venerables had been killed by Jiang Chen. If he couldn’t even kill one, he would not feel good about it.
*Hong...*
Dragon Shisan launched the Battle Saint Technique at Ye Qingtian.
On the other side, Jiang Chen swept the Sun Divine Feather. Shrill wails were heard. At least a few dozen people had died under this strike.

Jiang Chen remained expressionless and showed no signs of compassion in the face of such an incident. He had become a god of slaughter. All of his actions were made from his conscience. He had already given these people the chance to leave, but due to their greed, they had chosen to let go of the opportunity to survive.
In that case, he would use these people to pay tribute to the Dao of Slaughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 1676 - A Terrible Disaster
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
“Argh...” “Argh...” “Argh...”
Shrill wails filled the sky. Blood spilled crazily across the void. This was bound to be a bloody massacre.
“Ah Yan, I want you all to retreat.”

Jiang Chen shouted at Han Yan and the others. They were too shocked to say anything now. Without any delay, Han Yan, Tyrant, Yang Lang and the rest left the battlefield. They didn’t know how Jiang Chen was able to control the Sun Divine Feather so masterfully, however they were certain that they were no longer required to guard the golden doors.
“Dear me! Is he still actually human?” Grandmaster Hao Ran swallowed a mouthful of saliva with difficulty, unable to believe what was happening before his eyes.

“It’s highly possible that Little Chen has already integrated with the Sun Divine Feather. Which explains why he’s able to use it for numerous times. This is just too terrifying. Now that Little Chen has gone into a frenzied mode, it will surely be the end of the world for these people.”

Han Yan sighed. He understood Jiang Chen all too well. There was nothing in this world that Jiang Chen wouldn’t dare to do. No matter how earth-shattering the situation would become, it would be nothing to Jiang Chen.

“Little Chen seems to be breaking through a certain kind of Great Dao. The qi of slaughter from his body is intensifying. His entire being is undergoing a tremendous change. These people are too unfortunate. All of them will become Little Chen’s stepping stones,” said Tyrant. Nothing could escape his sharp eyes.
“These people can only blame themselves for acting so impulsively and ignorantly, knowing that Jiang Chen has already controlled the Sun Divine Feather.” Yang Lang sighed.

“They aren’t the only ones to be blamed. The allure of the Golden Clan is just too great. This expedition is different from all the previous expeditions. Rare treasures keep on emerging - from the Xiao Yao Qin to the Great Thousand Mirror, and then the Sun Divine Feather. There has to be immense treasures in the Golden Clan, treasures that we can’t imagine. Under such a situation, few people could remain calm. They will fight for it even if there’s only a slim chance,” said Shan Chong. He even began to doubt that he would become as crazy as those people if he wasn’t standing on Jiang Chen’s side.
Temptation was fatal sometimes.

Lan Lingji, Hua Xiaoqian and the others were also stupefied. Despite being the saintess of their respective sects, they had never experienced such an intense battle. In their eyes, Jiang Chen had completely become a bloodthirsty god of slaughter, completely different from the previous good-looking white-robed youth.

They were startled even though they were merely onlookers. They had no idea how many people would die at the end of this battle, but they were sure about one thing, Jiang Chen would surely become famous. His name would shake the three great Immortal Domains. However, would there be any shelter left for him in the three Immortal Domains outside the Golden Horizon?

Jiang Chen was completely immersed in the killing. His will to kill was pretty basic, slaughter all the enemies. These people in front of him had the intention of breaking into the Golden Clan, making them his enemies.
*Swish!*
Jiang Chen cast out the Great Void Technique, creating a path in the crowd, blocking the front of Young Master Yulong. His cold dragon eyes sent chill down Young Master Yulong’s spine.
“You, how is it possible that you can keep on using the Sun Divine Feather?” Young Master Yulong finally felt scared at this point.

“You don’t need to know. A dead man doesn’t need to know anything.” After he finished speaking, Jiang Chen struck out a ruthless attack. The Sun Divine Feather turned into a huge fan, and was swept at Young Master Yulong.
“Ahhh...”
Young Master Yulong was unable to dodge the attack and died tragically.
Then, Jiang Chen locked on a party of people. They were cultivators of Corpse Yin Sect. He launched a deadly strike without saying a word. Shrieks instantly filled the air.

His eyes were as bright as a torch. Corpse Yin Sect, Divine Line Sect, Yellow Spring Sect, Nanbei Family, Limitless Immortal Sect, Great Cloud Empire, Heavenly Jade Dynasty, Paragon Sect and Huang Family of Radiance Immortal Domain, the hostile relationships between Jiang Chen and these major powers were confirmed. They had all become the target of Jiang Chen.

On the other side, Dragon Shisan was constantly launching the Battle Saint Technique at Ye Qingtian, putting Ye Qingtian in an unfavourable situation. As a matter of fact, Ye Qingtian wasn’t that incapable, but because his mind was severely affected by Jiang Chen’s Sun Divine Feather, he wasn’t able to put all of his focus on the fight.

Undoubtedly, this was incredibly dangerous to him. Originally, he wasn’t a match for Dragon Shisan. Now that his mind had become unstable, it became even more impossible for him to compete with Dragon Shisan. If the situation continued to develop at this rate, it would only be a matter of time before he was eliminated by Dragon Shisan.

After acquiring the Life Symbol Art, the Battle Saint Technique that Dragon Shisan launched out was as aggressive as the tide, full of momentum. He only got more excited the more he fought. He had been wanting to kill a half-step Immortal Venerable to establish the prestige of his clan, and Ye Qingtian was going to be his target.

The blood that spilled out had already been turned into a river. Those were the blood of Immortal Emperors. They were the geniuses of the geniuses, but right now, they were killed by Jiang Chen as easily as cutting through melons.

Ultimately, Jiang Chen became the only one who stood in front of the golden doors. The Sun Divine Feather was constantly being waved. Groups after groups of geniuses fell. This was just like the saying ‘one man holding against ten thousand’.
The facial expression of the onlookers changed. By now, at least 2000 people had died in Jiang Chen’s hands, and they consisted of the disciples of hundreds of major powers.
“Ferocious...this is too ferocious. Jiang Chen is going to cause a terrible disaster this time.” Yang Lang shook his head.

“It really is a terrifying disaster. The death of so many geniuses will surely shake the whole immortal world. The three great Immortal Domains will be tilted off balance. Countless major powers are surely going to hunt and kill him. The Immortal Court will also not let him go.” Shan Chong sighed.

“I have never seen such an unparalleled mad man. I, Mo Wuqing, am thoroughly subdued by him. If a man is able to witness such an earth-shaking event in his life, it would be worth it even if he dies after that.”

Mo Wuqing’s eyes glinted with demonic brilliance. He admired Jiang Chen so much that he would even prostrate in front of Jiang Chen. There were some things that couldn’t be done with just strength alone, but with absolute courage and daring. Jiang Chen’s audacity sent a tingle down on everyone’s spine.

However, there’s one thing all the onlookers were worried about, Jiang Chen had killed too many people. He had virtually offended almost all the major powers, including the three great Immortal Courts, which was enough to be recorded in the annals of the Immortal World. There had never been such a domineering maniac in the Heavens and Earth. Jiang Chen was definitely the first. Even the Immortal Execution King and Great Sovereign Zang Xian that ran across the nine great Immortal Domains unhindered never did something as world-shaking as Jiang Chen.

To Jiang Chen, so what if he had caused a disaster? As long as these people didn’t retreat, he would continue to kill. He must execute the task entrusted by Big Yellow. His will to kill would never fade if these people continued to stay stubborn.

chapters.title: Chapter 1678 - Wiping out 4000 people
paragraphs: 4th of the week!

Jiang Chen continued to wave the Sun Divine Feather. A massive number of geniuses died under the attack, streams of blood poured from above. A massacre was taking place on the ancient battlefield. Many of those who hadn’t fought yet began to awaken from their madness while watching the cruel scene in horror. They seemed lost for words.

The qi of massacre spread across the void. The will to kill in Jiang Chen’s body will only grow stronger if these geniuses didn’t give up. The image of the ancestral dragon of slaughter began to form in his innermost soul.
*Hua La...*

The geniuses kept on dying. Wails were incessant. This was destined to be a one-sided massacre. 20 000 people wanted to break open the doors to the inheritance, but none of them could even get close to 300 meters from the gateway, Jiang Chen was just too powerful. It was no use no matter how many people there were. Anyone who dared to approach him first would die instantly.

Gradually, the attackers began to reduce. Numerous geniuses finally chose to retreat to a safe distance after understanding the situation, although they still felt the coldness on their backs and their bodies were still drenched with sweat.
“My Goodness! What was I doing?”
“He’s a demon! He’s able to display the power of the Sun Divine Feather numerous times.”

“Although treasures are important, they are nothing compared to their lives. Jiang Chen is still holding the Sun Divine Feather. It’s delusional to think that you can enter the Golden Clan. Those geniuses are still advancing forward blindly. I wonder how many will die today.”

“He’s truly a peerless god of slaughter and an evil maniac that kills without blinking. He didn’t even put the Immortal Court in his eyes, let alone those major powers. He’s a fearless man that kills every being. Death is already certain for those who rushed forth.”

Those who had retreated from the scene still couldn’t shake off the palpitation. Apart from dread, they also felt lucky. As they had been driven by greed just like thousands of others, they had no idea how dangerous the situation they were in. Only seconds ago were they jolted back to reality and knew that they were risking their lives. As such, it was their luck that they were able to remain intact and stand alive.
The massacre went on. In just a minute, another thousand people died. At this point, approximately 3000 people had died in Jiang Chen’s hands. Such a scene of massacre was beyond imagination.

More and more people began to see the reality. The first thing they did after they awoke was to withdraw themselves from the battlefield. All of them seemed to be dumbfounded, and the current scene made their scalp numb.
“Stop, everyone stop! Don’t advance anymore. Jiang Chen can launch out attacks using the Sun Divine Feather for many more times. If this goes on, we will all die!”
Someone shouted urgently. His voice was amplified by his energy, shocking the minds of many geniuses.
*Swish!*
Someone’s expression changed. The bloody light in his eyes disappeared in an instant, and he was jolted back to reality.
“I’m not fighting anymore, argh...”
Someone in the front line had regained his senses, but it was already too late as the wave attack from the Sun Divine Feather had reached him.

The battle ranks instantly broke apart. Those who were advancing with blazing eyes quickly turned and fled. The nose-stinging stench of blood had awakened them. Each of their faces were brimming with tears. They only wanted to leave the battlefield as soon as possible to save their own lives. The treasures in the Golden Clan were no longer important to them.
*Hua La...*

Jiang Chen made another wave, killing another dozens of them. Over 10 000 people scattered like birds, fleeing in every direction. In just a matter of a few blinks, all of them had reached a far distance from the golden doors.

The originally bustling battlefield quieted down all of a sudden. Jiang Chen had returned to his original form, still standing in front of the gateway with a steely expression, holding the Sun Divine Feather in his hand, his cold eyes sweeping across the surrounding people. The killing intent around his body didn’t reduce in the slightest, however the will to kill in his innermost soul began to diminish.

On the other side, the battle between Dragon Shisan and Ye Qingtina still continued. Ye Qingtian had already unleashed his Giant Bloodline, transforming into a real giant, but he was still no match for Dragon Shisan. Countless marks were seen on his body, blood trickling down his wounds. He was reaching the limit of his power.
*Hong Long...*
Dragon Shisan seized the opportunity and attacked. The Battle Saint Technique encircled Ye Qingtian like countless sharp blades, blowing off one of his arms in a single strike.
“Argh...”

Ye Qingtian let out a shrill cry. His mind was in total disarray. Or else he wouldn’t have fallen into such a predicament. Currently, his face was full of dread. The death of the five half-step Immortal Venerables had aroused an uncontrollable feeling inside of him. After being beaten up so badly by Dragon Shisan, he had lost his hope.
“Don’t kill me...”
Ye Qingtian shouted pleadingly. He was begging for mercy. It was incredibly difficult for a powerful figure like him to beg for his life.
Unfortunately, Dragon Shisan wouldn’t accept his pleading. Instead, Dragon Shisan’s killing intent skyrocketed as he struck out the Life Symbol Art.
“Argh...”
It was the end of Ye Qingtian. There was no way he could endure such a destructive attack. He was drowned in the destructive sea of energy and died after letting out his last wail.

By now, all of the six half-step Immoral Venerables had died. The death of Zhang Yulang and the other five weren’t in vain because they died under the attack of the Sun Divine Feather. Similarly, the death of Ye Qingtian wasn’t a humiliation as he was killed by the dignified Battle Saint Technique.
The whole void was filled with a strong stench of blood. Jiang Chen silently stood there like a god of slaughter. No one dared to move forth.

Innumerable faces displayed grief because many of their fellow disciples had died tragically in the chaotic battle, under the Sun Divine Feather. There were at least four thousand geniuses that died in Jiang Chen’s hands. It was an unimaginable number and loss to the various major powers of the three great Immortal Domains.
“My brother has been killed by this frenzied demon! Dammit! I so badly want to eat his flesh now.”

“Say no more in case he hears you. We can only blame ourselves for this incident. Jiang Chen had warned us not to go near the Golden Clan when he got the Divine Sun Feather, but we were lost in our thoughts and emotions at that time.”

“So what if we have? This son of a b*tch has killed so many geniuses. Can he get away with it? He has offended all the major powers of the three great Immortal Domains. I would like to know how he can survive after walking out of the Golden Horizon.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1679 - The Miserable Nanbei Chao
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

At least 4000 people had been killed in the battle. Jiang Chen had utterly offended almost all of the major powers from the three great Immortal Domains and also even the three great Immortal Courts. Although no one present dared to make any move, their hatred towards Jiang Chen didn’t reduce in the slightest. There had never been such a frenzied man throughout the history of the Immortal World. Jiang Chen was definitely the first.
With these deaths, the world outside would be thrown into chaos after the expedition ended, and Jiang Chen would never find shelter in the three great Immortal Domains. There was no doubt about it.

Most of the disciples of Yin Corpse Sect had died in the battle. There were even some major powers which disciples were nearly wiped out, such as Nanbei Family, Divine Line Sect and Yellow Spring Sect—the major powers that had earned the enmity of Jiang Chen. Each of these sects had sent roughly 200 geniuses, but now only less than 30 were left. Those people either died in Jiang Chen’s hands or when they were searching for treasures. The moment the higher-ups of these major powers saw that so few people had returned, they would probably spurt out a few mouthfuls of blood.

It was useless to say anything at this moment. The geniuses huddled together in the crowd, not daring to breathe normally, let alone speak. They knew very well that if they rushed out at this moment, Jiang Chen would surely eradicate all of them. They also knew that Jiang Chen would never have a second thought every time he acted.

The atmosphere was silent. At the moment, they could only wait for the inheritance of the Golden Clan to disappear, and for the exit of the Golden Horizon to open. Only then could they leave this place. That would mark the end of the expedition.
*Hong Long...*

All of a sudden, one of the eighteen golden passageways let out a powerful rumble. Terrifying energy was spread from it. It seemed like another powerful expert was going to emerge. The golden passageways hadn’t closed since their opening. It should have alarmed all the people in the Golden Horizon. This cultivator must be pretty befuddled to arrive at this moment.

Numerous eyes turned to the direction and saw a blonde-haired man in golden robe appearing in the void. His qi was incredible, and his demeanor was full of arrogance. His eyes shone brightly, his face showing a look that disdained the whole world.
“Nanbei Chao has come.”

Han Yan couldn’t help but chuckle when he saw who the newcomer was. The current Nanbei Chao had gotten even stronger compared to the time when they fought him during the emergence of the Xiao Yao Qin. Just like Dragon Shisan, Nanbei Chao must have gotten some sort of treasures that pushed his cultivation base to the late Immortal Emperor realm. Given his current cultivation base, he could easily kill any half-step Immortal Venerable.
“This bastard showed up at such a bad time.”

Tyrant put his palms together and spoke ‘Amitabha’. It was tragic that Nanbei Chao encountered Jiang Chen at this time. If it was before, the emergence of such a powerful enemy would certainly give them tremendous pressure. After all, this bastard was too strong, and couldn’t find any worthy opponent amongst his peers.

But now, the people around weren’t feeling any relief. Even if Nanbei Chao went ballistic, the outcome was already imaginable. They understood the relationship between Jiang Chen and Nanbei Chao. Since they met each other again here, how could Jiang Chen miss the chance?

Nanbei Chao furrowed his brows after his appearance as he could smell the irritating stench of blood in the air, which indicated that an intense fight had taken place just now. After that, he cast his eyes onto Jiang Chen who was also looking at him. The corners of Jiang Chen’s mouth wore a plain smile, his eyes full of sneer.

However, Nanbei Chao, who was clueless about what had happened here, ignored Jiang Chen’s gaze. After all, he had never seen a warm expression on Jiang Chen’s face. Then, the Sun Divine Feather caught his eyes which suddenly sparkled brilliantly.
The Sun Divine Feather? Sure enough, the Golden Clan is a land of treasure. This bastard had even gotten the Sun Divine Feather.

Nanbei Chao was shocked. With the Eye of Heaven, he could see past everything. Additionally, he’s the reincarnation of a Great Sovereign. He was naturally able to recognize the divine feather that Jiang Chen was holding.
“Jiang Chen, surrender the Sun Divine Feather now.”

Nanbei Chao clamoured at Jiang Chen. The attraction of the Sun Divine Feather was just too great, making him forget to act cautiously like he usually does before making a move. He had failed to notice the frightened looks of the geniuses’ faces and figured where the stench of blood came from.

Moreover, he had always been self-centered. He would put no one in his eyes apart from himself. He was too arrogant to bother giving anyone a glance. He didn’t even care if figures like Zhang Yulang and Xia Xiaotian were present or not. There were only two things that caught his attention now, one was Jiang Chen and the other one was the Sun Divine Feather currently in Jiang Chen’s hand.

Now that he had reached the late Immortal Emperor realm, his desire to kill Jiang Chen surged. He would never forget the day when he was beaten up by them so badly that he had to run away with his tail between his legs. That had left a deep grudge in him. He must exterminate Jiang Chen and his friends. Only then could he regain his dignity.
“Nanbei Chao, come and get it yourself if you want the Sun Divine Feather,” said Jiang Chen in a plain tone filled with provocation.
Killing intent shot out of his eyes once more, condensing into a solid substance. He would never let go of the good chance of killing Nanbei Chao, just like what Nanbei Chao did to him.
“Humph! I’ll kill you today.”
With a cold humph, Nanbei Chao lunged at Jiang Chen. At this moment, a genius from Nanbei Family’s group rushed out, blocking in front of him.
“Don’t fight, Young Master Chao.”
That genius’ face was full of dread. He spoke via divine sense, telling Nanbei Chao everything that happened earlier.

After listening to this, Nanbei Chao’s facial expression changed greatly. The way he looked at Jiang Chen had also changed. If this wasn’t coming from the genius of his family, he would never believe it for he knew that the geniuses of his family would never dare to deceive him.
“Haha! Go ahead and fight, Nanbei Chao. Didn’t you call yourself a Monarch? Could it be that even the majestic Monarch has fears?”
Han Yan gave out a loud laugh. How could he miss the chance to mock Nanbei Chao?
“Humph!”

Nanbei Chao harrumphed coldly. Without saying another word, he turned and left. It was definitely the first time that someone made the proud Nanbei Chao leave voluntarily. Nanbei Chao was no fool. Although he was very confident in his strength, it hadn’t reached the extent where he could compete with the Sun Divine Feather. Even Zhang Yulang’s group had been killed in an instant. He would also probably die as well if he confronted it head-on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1680 - Severed into Two
paragraphs: 5th of the week!

As a matter of fact, Nanbei Chao was feeling pretty aggrieved right now. There was nothing in this world that could make him feel afraid and shrink back. Due to him breaking through to the late Immortal Emperor realm, he had arrived here late. He had already planned to conquer the territory of the Golden Clan and obtain all of the clan’s treasures, however, faced with reality right now, his plan seemed very far-fetched.

The one Nanbei Chao hated the most was undoubtedly Jiang Chen. As a dignified reincarnation of a Great Sovereign, he was gifted with extraordinary abilities and was an unrivaled genius of the world who put no one in his eyes, but Jiang Chen seemed to be the biggest rival in his life. He would be in trouble every time he encountered Jiang Chen. No matter how strong or how great his status was, nothing good happens every time he met Jiang Chen.

Putting aside the clone that he sent to Saint Origin World, he was already powerful enough that he almost killed the mighty Mo Wuqing when he first met Jiang Chen on the Broken Edge Cliff. After pursuing Jiang Chen for a few dozen miles and successfully cornering him, a monkey named Dragon Shisan emerged out of nowhere and injured his Eye of Heaven with the Fiery Golden Eyes.

In their second encounter, during the time when the Xiao Yao Qin emerged, he wanted to stop Wu Ningzhu and tried to exploit the others to kill Jiang Chen, but to no avail. In the end, he was besieged by Jiang Chen and his comrades, and was beaten up pretty badly.

Lastly, in their third encounter, as soon as he arrived at the scene with high spirits and confidence, he was shocked to find out that Jiang Chen had gotten the Sun Divine Feather, and had killed five half-step Immortal Venerables. That took away all of his courage to fight. It was like he had only come here to show his face, and had to leave before he had the time to even see how the golden doors look like.
Really, was there anything that was more aggrieving than this?
Nanbei Chao cursed inwardly, he felt like crying but had no tears.
“Nanbei Chao, why are you in such a hurry to leave when you’ve just arrived?”

Jiang Chen shouted, casting the Great Void Technique, appearing in front of Nanbei Chao in a blink. He had sealed the route of Nanbei Chao with the Sun Divine Feather. Both of them were fated enemies and wanted so badly to get rid of each other. So it was impossible for either of them to let go of any chance to kill their opponent.

Now that Jiang Chen was controlling the Sun Divine Feather, when would he have the chance in the future if he didn’t kill Nanbei Chao now? He initially felt slightly disappointed that Nanbei Chao wasn’t present. Now that Nanbei Chao had delivered himself to him, how could Jiang Chen let him go away?
“Jiang Chen, you really think that you can kill me?” Nanbei Chao spoke coldly.
“I’ll just try and see.” Jiang Chen shrugged. His killing intent had completely locked on Nanbei Chao.
“Jiang Chen, don’t you get all over yourself. Without the Sun Divine Feather, you are nothing, I can even crush you with only a finger.”

Nanbei Chao was infuriated. He seldom got angry, but now he was furious as the situation was incredibly stifling. The opponent’s cultivation base was clearly much weaker than him, but this opponent had become his biggest threat, waving the divine feather casually and looking at him as though he was the prey. This gave him the urge to spurt out blood.
“Too bad that I have the Sun Divine Feather. That’s why I can be all over myself. If you aren’t satisfied with it, then come and kill me,” said Jiang Chen in a strange tone.
After hearing this, numerous people rolled their eyes crazily. These words were just too brazen!
“Damn! I had never thought that this Jiang Chen is this shameless! If I were Nanbei Chao, I would have been extremely pissed off!” Grandmaster Hao Ran blurted.
One would really be put in a quandary if he encountered Jiang Chen.
“Senior Brother, only now did you know that he’s that shameless? It seems like the time you spent with him is far too short.”

Tyrant chuckled. He understood Jiang Chen much more than Grandmaster Hao Ran, and the one standing in front of Jiang Chen right now wasn’t a stranger, but Nanbei Chao. Even if Jiang Chen couldn’t kill Nanbei Chao, he would definitely infuriate Nanbei Chao totally.
“You are courting death!”
Nanbei Chao was utterly angered, and struck out a palm at Jiang Chen. He could no longer stand it. Even if Jiang Chen had the Sun Divine Feather, he would still attack.
“Humph!”

Jiang Chen harrumphed coldly. The Sun Divine Feather in his hand trembled and cast out a ray of flaming light, destroying Nanbei Chao’s attack in an instant. Then, the Sun Divine Feather turned into a very sharp golden blade and was slashed at Nanbei Chao with lightning speed.
“What?”

Sensing the danger of the divine feather, Nanbei Chao’s facial expression changed dramatically. Even if he was mentally prepared, he had never expected the power of the Sun Divine Feather to be this great. Its power had reached the extent where he couldn’t bear it. At this point, he finally understood how Zhang Yulang, Xia Xiaotian, and the others were killed.
The Immortal Armour instantly coated his body. He cast the Monarch Heaven Art to its fullest power, and unexpectedly broke away from the seal of the Sun Divine Feather and escaped frantically.
*Bang!*
Unfortunately, he was still a little slow. The Sun Divine Feather had cut his body. The Immortal Armour crumbled and was burned.
“Jiang Chen, you have destroyed my Immortal Amour!” Nanbei Chao spurted out a mouthful of blood. His tone was full of fury.
As a matter of fact, this wasn’t Jiang Chen’s first time destroying his Immortal Armour. Back in Saint Origin World, Jiang Chen had once damaged the Immortal Armour of his clone.

After that, he continued to flee without delay. Everyone had to admit that they were surprised by the scene. Countless people raised their thumbs up secretly for Nanbei Chao because he had resisted a blow from the Sun Divine Feather. This fact alone indicated that he was a lot stronger compared to Zhang Yulang and the others.

Unfortunately, the fall of this peerless genius was inevitable today. Those who understood Jiang Chen’s means and the relationship between him and Nanbei Chao were certain that he would never let Nanbei Chao go.
“You have nowhere to go.”

Right enough, Jiang Chen circulated the Great Void Technique and caught up with Nanbei Chao in a blink of an eye, and then slashed the divine feather again, which acted like an unparalleled divine light, slashing the void in half before hitting Nanbei Chao.
“Argh...”

At last, Nanbei Chao let out a bitter cry. His entire person was slashed in half by the Sun Divine Feather. The scene was horrifying. Grief was plastered on the faces of every genius of Nanbei Family. The death of Nanbei Chao was equivalent to the loss of a pillar in Nanbei Family. The loss of this was just too great.

Seeing Nanbei Chao being cut into two by the Sun Divine Feather, almost everyone thought that he was dead, except for Jiang Chen who was frowning at where Nanbei Chao died. Instead of his body being incinerated by the Fire of Sun like Zhang Yulang and the rest of the geniuses, Nanbei Chao’s body vanished out of sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1681 - The End
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!

The scene was filled with silence. The atmosphere was too heavy for anyone to speak. They even felt their breathing became heavier. Too many people had died today. Countless geniuses had fallen. If these geniuses were still alive, they would surely become famous figures in the future and wouldn’t have trouble reaching the Immortal Venerable realm. They might even have the chance to break through to the legendary Sovereign realm.

Unfortunately, most of these outstanding geniuses had lost their lives. Nothing as such had ever happened in the past expeditions. Speaking of benefits, the geniuses had undoubtedly obtained many treasures this time, however, they also suffered heavy losses which outweighed all the benefits they had obtained. So what if they had achieved rapid progress? So what if some of them had reached the half-step Immortal Venerable realm? They still died in the end.
“Dead! He’s dead! That’s too savage!”
“Even Nanbei Chao, the reincarnation of a Great Sovereign, a rare genius of our generation, the pride and future of Nanbei Family, is killed by Jiang Chen so easily!”

“Too many people have died. Nanbei Chao is the one who is likely to become a Sovereign. Too bad, he encountered Jiang Chen today. Zhang Yulang, Xia Xiaotian, and a few others are also outstanding geniuses with immeasurable future, however, they’re all dead. There’s no future to speak about anymore.”
“There are many of them who shouldn’t have died as they are bound to attain unordinary achievements in the future. Unfortunately, they aren’t that lucky.”

Everyone was chatting with astonishment. An unprecedentedly successful expedition had been turned into an Asura Hell. Innumerable eyes fell upon Jiang Chen, who was now wearing spotlessly white clothes, with a good looking face and a pair of cold and ruthless eyes. Who would have thought that this youth was actually the demon that had eradicated 4000 people?
Dragon Shisan, Han Yan and the rest flew towards Jiang Chen’s side.
“Little Chen, you have finally gotten rid of a mortal malady,” Han Yan spoke with great excitement.

He was crystal clear about the hostile relationship between his brother and Nanbei Chao. The two had been clashing with one another back in Qi Province in Saint Origin World. At long last, the conflict was concluded. So, naturally, he felt quite relieved about it.
“He isn’t dead.” Jiang Chen shook his head.
“What? He has already been slashed in two but is not dead yet?” Yang Bufan was startled.

“This is what made him so horrifying. He’s still able to run away even though his body has been cut in half by the Sun Divine Feather, and he managed to run away without leaving a trace, not even my Great Void Technique was able to lock on his qi. Nevertheless, he has suffered immense injuries from today’s battle. Even if he doesn’t die, he won’t be able to create any waves for a period of time. And even though he’s a Great Sovereign’s reincarnation, it’s fundamentally impossible for him to recover within a short period of time,” said Jiang Chen.

He rarely put an enemy in his heart, but Nanbei Chao had been an obstacle in his heart that couldn’t be gotten rid of, as if the man was a cockroach that couldn’t be killed. Even with the attack of the Sun Divine Feather, it still wasn’t able to take his life.

Although the Sun Divine Feather gave Nanbei Chao a serious injury, Jiang Chen wasn’t feeling very comfortable about it for he knew that someone like Nanbei Chao would surely make an even greater comeback if he was still alive.
“That bastard is really like a cockroach.” Tyrant seemed speechless.
“But this is also fine. If Nanbei Chao died just like that, my future path will become much less exciting.” Jiang Chen smiled.
“Little Chen, what is your plan after the expedition is over?” Yang Bufan asked suddenly.
“I’ll take one step at a time. Don’t have to worry about me.”

Jiang Chen patted Yang Bufan’s shoulder. He knew what Yang Bufan was worried about him. After all, he had killed too many geniuses. The moment this expedition ends, the world outside would certainly be thrown into chaos. Countless major powers would definitely hunt him down. He was afraid that he could no longer find any shelter in the three great Immortal Domains. He definitely couldn’t return to Great Qian Empire as that would bring absolute annihilation to the empire.
*Hong Long...*

At this time, the Golden Clan began to shake. The golden warriors vanished into the golden brilliance in a blink. Under the shine of the golden light, the Golden Clan gradually faded just like an illusion.

“The inheritance is going to disappear. The expedition is coming to an end. The passageway leading to the outside world will be opened once again,” said Jiang Chen as he lifted his head and looked at the fading Golden Clan, the corners of his mouth revealed a trace of a smile. In any case, the bloodline of the Golden Clan was successfully guarded, fulfilling the mandate that was given by Big Yellow and not letting down the Sun Divine Feather in his hand.
“Look, the inheritance is going to vanish soon. I wonder when it will appear again, or if it will ever appear...”
“The journey in the Golden Horizon is finally over. The passageway will be opened soon. Everyone, remember to use the identity brocade pouch to sense your pathway so that you don’t go the wrong way.”
“We’ve suffered a major loss this time. The higher ups of our sect will surely be enraged when we return.”

“Not just your sect, all three great Immortal Domain will no longer be peaceful. After what Jiang Chen has done, there will be no more place for him to stay in the three Immortal Domains. His death is certain because even the Immortal Court will hunt him down. And that monkey, he too will be sentenced to death for killing Ye Qingtian.”

Everyone gnashed their teeth at the mention of Jiang Chen, however, they were almost certain that as long as they walked out of the Golden Horizon, both Jiang Chen and Dragon Shisan would die for sure. There was zero chance of survival in the face of all the enraged higher-ups.
*Hong Long...*

Soon, the Golden Clan faded completely. New spatial passageways appeared in the sky. These passageways lead to different Immortal Domains, regions or even sects. The appearance of these passageways indicated the end of the expedition in the Golden Horizon. Most of them flew back into the passageway that they used to arrive here.
“Little Chen, what about you?” Yang Bufan asked with concern.
With a wave of the Sun Divine Feather, Jiang Chen tore open a huge gap in the void and went into it with a flash. The gap then disappeared along with Jiang Chen.

“Could it be that he has gone into the turbulent air current? That is too dangerous. Even an Immortal Venerable won’t dare to do this as this is no different than seeking death. Once one is lost in the space, one will never get out of it for the rest of his life,” Shan Chong spoke with surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 1682 - Shocking the two Prefecture Masters
paragraphs: 6th of the week!

“Don’t worry. Little Chen has already mastered the Great Void Technique. With the spatial barrier between the Golden Horizon and the outer world now open, even if he has gone into the crevice of the space, he will still be able to find his way out. That’s the Great Void Technique that we are talking about, the legacy left by the Void Sovereign,” Yang Lang spoke with a smile, his tone was full of admiration.

Everyone knew very well that Jiang Chen was undoubtedly the biggest winner in this journey. Putting other things aside, the Sun Divine Feather and the Great Void Technique that he acquired were sufficient to drive people crazy. In addition, he had gotten the Fire of Sun which could only be possessed by individuals with heaven-defying luck and abilities.
Lan Lingji came to Dragon Shisan’s front and lightly pulled his hand, and said, “Brother Shisan, what’s your next plan?”

Lan Lingji was extremely worried about Dragon Shisan. After all, he had killed quite a lot of people along the way, including Ye Qingtian. If those he killed were all from the other two Immortal Domains, it would be difficult for them to cross a great Immortal Domain to seek revenge, but Ye Qingtian, being a genius of the Immortal court, was no ordinary figure. The moment the Immortal Court started to pursue the case, there was nowhere Dragon Shisan could escape to. He wouldn’t find a safe place to hide even in all the Immortal Domains.
“Not to worry. It will not be that easy for them to take my life. Return to Exquisite Paradise first. I’ll find you later,” Dragon Shisan said with full confidence.
He didn’t know what would happen next, but just like Jiang Chen, he would take one step at a time. It wouldn’t be easy for anyone or any major power to kill him.
“Okay, I’ll wait for you at Exquisite Paradise.”
Lan Lingji nodded energetically. Having fallen head over heels for him, she believed that he would do what he promised.
Then, Lan Lingji departed with her fellow disciples and vanished into one of the spatial passageways.

Numerous geniuses had already left, and now, only Yang Bufan and a few others remained. Han Yan and Tyrant weren’t planning to return to their respective sects as Jiang Chen had told them to travel together with Yang Bufan back to Great Qian Empire and help him. Mo Wuqing and Grandmaster Hao Ran would also go with them. After witnessing the war earlier, Mo Wuqing felt that his life would be more interesting and rewarding following this group of people.
“Let’s go. The spatial passageways will soon close. Let’s leave this place.” Yang Bufan said and was the first to fly towards the passageway.

Dragon Shisan also followed them into the passageway, however he had already intended to leave at the end of the passageway. Although the killings he committed wasn’t as serious as Jiang Chen, he was still considered one of the major culprits. He was almost sure that if those big-shots he offended couldn’t find Jiang Chen, they would definitely focus their attention on him. Hence, in order to not cause Great Qian Empire unnecessary trouble, he needed to isolate himself from them.

Back in Genius Prefecture, Yang Zanqing, Dongfang Yu and a bunch of higher-ups were standing on a spacious square. Their faces were full of anticipation and delight. They knew that those geniuses that went to the Golden Horizon were on their way back. This was a tense moment. They had no idea what those geniuses gained from the expedition, and how many of them would return this time around.
“Brother Yu, how many of them do you think will return?” Yang Zanqing looked over at Dongfang Yu.
“Based on the past records, it’s already considered not bad if half of them can return. My concern now is to what extent they had improved,” Dongfang Yu replied.
“We’ll see, but I’m still rather excited.”

Although Yang Zanqing is the master of Genius Prefecture, he seldom appeared in normal situations. There were many disciples who didn’t even know what he looked like. He was as mysterious as the Emperor, but right now, he had come to the square personally, waiting for the triumphant return of the gifted disciples.

To an empire, the young generation was the foundation, the future, and the pillar. The empire would only get stronger if they got stronger. Otherwise, the empire wouldn’t have taken such a risk of sending more than 200 geniuses to the dangerous and life-threatening Golden Horizon.
“In your estimate, to what extent has Jiang Chen improved?”

Dongfang Yu looked over at Yang Zanqing this time. His eyes couldn’t help but sparkle at the mention of Jiang Chen’s name. Being the master of the Dan Prefecture for so long, Jiang Chen was the most powerful disciple he had ever seen, prompting him to attach great importance to the young man. He really looked forward to Jiang Chen’s return and the surprise that this unparalleled genius would bring him.
“I too have a high opinion of him. I hope that he can surprise us.”
Yang Zanqing smiled. Both of them expected Jiang Chen to surprise them, however they had no idea that the surprise they were expecting might exceed their imagination.

The spatial passageway continued to devour the spatial energy in the sky. Then, with a bang, silhouettes were being thrown out of it. As Yang Zanqing had already deployed a gentle force of net in the surroundings beforehand, everyone was able to find a steady landing.

Soon, all of the geniuses had exited the spatial passageway. There were a total of 150 of them. That was to say, less than half of them were killed in the expedition. This number was far greater than what Yan Zanqing and Dongfang Yu had expected.
“There are so many of them.”

The number of geniuses who survived the expedition was unprecedented, and had surprised the higher-ups of the empire. After all of the geniuses were out, the spatial passageway closed once again. That was to say, all of the geniuses had already returned from the Golden Horizon, but clearly, the group seemed lacking of a few important figures.
“Where’s Jiang Chen, King Ping, and the Crown Prince?”
Yang Zanqing spat out these names at once. These were the three whom he attached great importance to, however they were nowhere to be seen, except for King Fan.

As a matter of fact, the gains of the Great Qian Empire were absolutely tremendous. Yang Lang, Shan Chong and Yang Bufan had succeeded in advancing to the late Immortal Emperor realm, which was beyond their expectation, but Jiang Chen and the two princes weren’t in the group. One should know that those who didn’t walk out of the Golden Horizon indicated that they had already died inside.
“Impossible. Jiang Chen will not die.”
Dongfang Yu’s facial expression changed slightly. He was the first to deny that Jiang Chen was already dead.
“Bufan, tell me quickly. Where are the three of them?” Yang Zanqing focused on Yang Bufan. The atmosphere on the square had become slightly heavier.
“Master, the Crown Prince and King Ping weren’t able to walk out of the Golden Horizon because they are already dead,” replied Yang Bufan. This was a fact that he couldn’t hide.

chapters.title: Chapter 1683 - The Great Chaos under the Heavens
paragraphs: Extra dose of the week!
“What? Dead?”

Yang Zanqing’s expression changed dramatically. Both the Crown Prince and King Ping were unparalleled geniuses of Great Qian Empire, and with high status. Their death was an incredible loss to the empire. Yang Zanqing naturally would find it unacceptable at first.
“What about Jiang Chen?” Dongfang Yu asked hastily.

As the Master of Dan Prefecture, the death of the Crown Prince and King Ping didn’t concern him that much. What he only cared about right now was Jiang Chen. Jiang Chen was the most heaven-defying genius he had ever seen who had safeguarded the dignity of Dan Prefecture and helped him advance to half-step Immortal Venerable realm. Dongfang Yu would never believe that Jiang Chen was dead.
“Jiang Chen isn’t dead. Allow me tell you what happened in the Golden Horizon,” said Yang Bufan.
“Please do so.”

Yang Zanqing and Dongfang Yu spoke simultaneously. Although they felt slightly relieved after knowing that Jiang Chen wasn’t dead, they were extremely confused why the young man didn’t return with the others if he was still alive?
“The Prefecture Masters must be mentally prepared for this information.”
Yang Bufan warned them in advance so that they wouldn’t faint after hearing the news.

Subsequently, Yang Bufan, Yang Lang and Shan Chong took turns to speak, telling the two Prefecture Masters everything that had taken place in Golden Horizon as fast as they possibly could. Naturally, the important incidents were the emergence of the Golden Clan, Great Thousand Mirror and Sun Divine Feather.
*Hong...*
Despite being mentally prepared, they still felt as though their heads were going to burst. Many of the higher-ups felt light-headed.
Killing thousands of people...they couldn’t imagine what it was like.
“Quickly inform the Emperor, and Genius Prefecture must be on red alert.”

Yang Zanqing immediately gave the order. He was no longer in the mood to be astonished by the emergence of the Golden Clan or the appearance of the Great Thousand Mirror. What he needed to do now was to inform the Emperor and summon all the experts in Great Qian Empire because something big was certainly going to happen. He was almost sure that it would take less than an hour for those major powers to come knocking on their doors.

According to what Yang Bufan said, major powers like Nanbei Family and Corpse Yin Sect had suffered disastrous losses. Each major power only had less than thirty people that had returned. Even Nanbei Chao had been killed in the battle. It was already imaginable how furious these major powers would become. Also, geniuses of the three great Immortal Courts were also killed and Yang Zanqing almost yielded to the urge to faint when he thought about this.
“Motherfer! This son of a b*tch has brought us a miracle, but this is too much for your Father to take.”

Yang Zanqing almost sprang from where he stood. He and Dongfang Yu had been expecting Jiang Chen to bring them a miracle. Sure enough, Jiang Chen didn’t let him down, and the miracle the young man brought them was overly great that they were having a hard time to accept it.

“Haha! Right enough, I’m right in my judgment. That young man is surely a person with great luck. He has even obtained the inheritance of the Void Sovereign and the Sun Divine Feather. But there’s one thing I don’t understand - why did he prevent all the geniuses from entering the territory of the Golden Clan at all costs?”

Dongfang Yu laughed heartily. His reaction was different from Yang Zanqing. The more earth-shattering the incident, the more he admired Jiang Chen. He didn’t understand why Jiang Chen wanted to guard the gateway of the Golden Clan, however, he believed that Jiang Chen must have his own reasons for doing so.

“Never thought that such a big incident would happen in Golden Horizon. Jiang Chen has really created a terrible disaster! I’m afraid he can no longer find any shelter in the three great Immortal Domains! Ai! This is full of excitement!”

“I admire him very much. He even dared to kill the people of Immortal Court. There’s nothing in this world that can stop him. Plus, he’s a person who cherishes relationship and loyalty. He decided not to return as he didn’t want to put the whole Great Qian Empire in trouble.”

“That’s true. 150 geniuses have returned to our empire, safe and intact. And most of them have progressed greatly, including Jiang Chen himself. It’s a pity that our empire can’t protect him, he has offended too many major powers. If he isn’t dead this time, he will be a Sovereign of the generation.”
The people in Genius Prefecture were discussing about this matter, impressed by the things that Jiang Chen had done, they couldn’t help it.
Yang Zanqing recovered from the momentary shock. After all, he was a half-step Immortal Venerable and had strong psychological endurance.
Only after recovering from his shock did he notice Han Yan and the other few, and asked, “These are?”
Given his eyesight, he could naturally discern that they were powerful cultivators, especially Han Yan and Tyrant who were full of startling vigor and luck.

“This is the chosen one of Profound Yin Cult of Northern Profound Domain, named Han Yan. This is Mo Wuqing, also a genius of Profound Yin Cult. These two grandmasters are eminent monks of White Dragon Temple, Grandmaster Tyrant and Grandmaster Hao Ran. All of them are friends of Jiang Chen.” Yang Bufan hurriedly introduced the group to Yang Zanqing.
“Greet Master Yang.”
Han Yan and Mo Wuqing held their fists at Yang Zanqing, Tyrant and Grandmaster Hao Ran also put their palms together.
“Since you are the friends of Jiang Chen and King Fan, then you are the guests of honor of our empire,” said Yang Zanqing without the slightest neglect.

It wasn’t just because of the identities of these people, but also their strength, particularly Han Yan and Tyrant whose Qis were exceedingly strong even though they were only late Immortal Emperors. Yang Zanqing felt that even he wouldn’t be able to subdue these two men.
On a black altar in Corpse Yin Sect, the originally high-spirited seniors were blazing with fury when they saw that only around 20 disciples had returned to the sect, all looking extremely flustered.
“Jiang Chen, Dragon Shisan, how dare you kill so many of my geniuses! Our sect has never suffered such a huge loss since our establishment! We will absolutely not let this matter rest!”

The Sect Master of Corpse Yin Sect bellowed ferociously, eyes spurting out flames. He was Old Man Corpse Yin who had moved across the whole world unhindered. No one had ever dared to offend him. Today, the news of his geniuses almost being wiped out in Golden Horizon had utterly ignited his fury and killing intent.
“Sect Master, what should we do now?” An elder of the sect asked.
“Go to Great Qian Empire and seize those two.”
Old Man Corpse Yin brought a few powerful experts along and vanished in the blink of an eye, heading towards the direction of Great Qian Empire.

sentences.text: Extra dose of the week!
“What?
Dead?”
Yang Zanqing’s expression changed dramatically.
Both the Crown Prince and King Ping were unparalleled geniuses of Great Qian Empire, and with high status.
Their death was an incredible loss to the empire.
Yang Zanqing naturally would find it unacceptable at first.
“What about Jiang Chen?” Dongfang Yu asked hastily.
As the Master of Dan Prefecture, the death of the Crown Prince and King Ping didn’t concern him that much.
What he only cared about right now was Jiang Chen.
Jiang Chen was the most heaven-defying genius he had ever seen who had safeguarded the dignity of Dan Prefecture and helped him advance to half-step Immortal Venerable realm.
Dongfang Yu would never believe that Jiang Chen was dead.
“Jiang Chen isn’t dead.
Allow me tell you what happened in the Golden Horizon,” said Yang Bufan.
“Please do so.”
Yang Zanqing and Dongfang Yu spoke simultaneously.
Although they felt slightly relieved after knowing that Jiang Chen wasn’t dead, they were extremely confused why the young man didn’t return with the others if he was still alive?
“The Prefecture Masters must be mentally prepared for this information.”
Yang Bufan warned them in advance so that they wouldn’t faint after hearing the news.
Subsequently, Yang Bufan, Yang Lang and Shan Chong took turns to speak, telling the two Prefecture Masters everything that had taken place in Golden Horizon as fast as they possibly could.
Naturally, the important incidents were the emergence of the Golden Clan, Great Thousand Mirror and Sun Divine Feather.
*Hong...*
Despite being mentally prepared, they still felt as though their heads were going to burst.
Many of the higher-ups felt light-headed.
Killing thousands of people...they couldn’t imagine what it was like.
“Quickly inform the Emperor, and Genius Prefecture must be on red alert.”
Yang Zanqing immediately gave the order.
He was no longer in the mood to be astonished by the emergence of the Golden Clan or the appearance of the Great Thousand Mirror.
What he needed to do now was to inform the Emperor and summon all the experts in Great Qian Empire because something big was certainly going to happen.
He was almost sure that it would take less than an hour for those major powers to come knocking on their doors.
According to what Yang Bufan said, major powers like Nanbei Family and Corpse Yin Sect had suffered disastrous losses.
Each major power only had less than thirty people that had returned.
Even Nanbei Chao had been killed in the battle.
It was already imaginable how furious these major powers would become.
Also, geniuses of the three great Immortal Courts were also killed and Yang Zanqing almost yielded to the urge to faint when he thought about this.
“Motherfer!
This son of a b*tch has brought us a miracle, but this is too much for your Father to take.”
Yang Zanqing almost sprang from where he stood.
He and Dongfang Yu had been expecting Jiang Chen to bring them a miracle.
Sure enough, Jiang Chen didn’t let him down, and the miracle the young man brought them was overly great that they were having a hard time to accept it.
“Haha!
Right enough, I’m right in my judgment.
That young man is surely a person with great luck.
He has even obtained the inheritance of the Void Sovereign and the Sun Divine Feather.
But there’s one thing I don’t understand - why did he prevent all the geniuses from entering the territory of the Golden Clan at all costs?”
Dongfang Yu laughed heartily.
His reaction was different from Yang Zanqing.
The more earth-shattering the incident, the more he admired Jiang Chen.
He didn’t understand why Jiang Chen wanted to guard the gateway of the Golden Clan, however, he believed that Jiang Chen must have his own reasons for doing so.
“Never thought that such a big incident would happen in Golden Horizon.
Jiang Chen has really created a terrible disaster!
I’m afraid he can no longer find any shelter in the three great Immortal Domains!
Ai!
This is full of excitement!”
“I admire him very much.
He even dared to kill the people of Immortal Court.
There’s nothing in this world that can stop him.
Plus, he’s a person who cherishes relationship and loyalty.
He decided not to return as he didn’t want to put the whole Great Qian Empire in trouble.”
“That’s true.
150 geniuses have returned to our empire, safe and intact.
And most of them have progressed greatly, including Jiang Chen himself.
It’s a pity that our empire can’t protect him, he has offended too many major powers.
If he isn’t dead this time, he will be a Sovereign of the generation.”
The people in Genius Prefecture were discussing about this matter, impressed by the things that Jiang Chen had done, they couldn’t help it.
Yang Zanqing recovered from the momentary shock.
After all, he was a half-step Immortal Venerable and had strong psychological endurance.

Given his eyesight, he could naturally discern that they were powerful cultivators, especially Han Yan and Tyrant who were full of startling vigor and luck.

This is Mo Wuqing, also a genius of Profound Yin Cult.
These two grandmasters are eminent monks of White Dragon Temple, Grandmaster Tyrant and Grandmaster Hao Ran.
All of them are friends of Jiang Chen.” Yang Bufan hurriedly introduced the group to Yang Zanqing.
“Greet Master Yang.”
Han Yan and Mo Wuqing held their fists at Yang Zanqing, Tyrant and Grandmaster Hao Ran also put their palms together.

Yang Zanqing felt that even he wouldn’t be able to subdue these two men.

chapters.title: Chapter 1684 - Getting rid of the Relationship
paragraphs: 7th of the week!

Meanwhile, all the noble and highly respected higher-ups of Nanbei Family, the oldest clan in Eastern Profound Domain, were also waiting on an empty platform. As Nanbei Chao was leading this expedition, the top officials of Nanbei Family were incomparably confident in their group of geniuses. The Patriarch of this ancient family is Nanbei Taisheng. He wore a brocade robe, with a sturdy physique, unordinary demeanour and seemed to be in his forties.

However his facial expression changed dramatically when he saw that there were only twenty people coming back from the spatial passageway, each looking extremely flurried. When they found out that Nanbei Chao wasn’t with them, clamorous uproar filled the air.
“Tell me, what had happened? Where’s Young Master Chao?”
Nanbei Taisheng’s voice became almost shrill. He hadn’t thought of such a situation happening even in his dream. How could a dignified family fall into such a state?
“Patriarch, it was all because of Jiang Chen.”
One of the disciples spoke, his eyes sparkling, gnashing his teeth as if he was going to eat someone at the mention of Jiang Chen.
“What Jiang Chen? Who is he?” Nanbei Taisheng asked darkly.
Subsequently, the disciple told everything that happened in Golden Horizon which caused Nanbei Taisheng and all the higher-ups of the family to stamp with rage.
“Did you all see that Young Master Chao was cut in half by Jiang Chen using the Sun Divine Feather?” One of the higher ups asked.
“Yes, we have seen it with our own eyes,” one of them answered.

“The soul fire of Young Master Chao hasn’t been extinguished yet. Which means the young master isn’t dead yet. He’s the reincarnation of a Great Sovereign. A mere Jiang Chen won’t be able to kill him. Even though he was cut into two, he can still recover from it, however, we certainly can’t let this matter rest.”

Nanbei Taisheng was a mighty cultivator whose cultivation base had already stepped into the intermediate Immortal Venerable realm. A figure like him had an extremely calm temperament, but now he was losing control over his emotion. He had forgotten when was the last time he had ever felt so angry.
“The brat that came out from nowhere has cost us so many casualties. We must hold him accountable for this.”
“We must find and kill him even if he’s at the most remote corner of the world.”
“He’s a genius of Great Qian Empire. He will definitely seek protection from the empire. Now we just have to go there and find him.”’

A few Immortal Venerable Elders of Nanbei Family were having a hard time coping with their anger. One should know that many of those that Jiang Chen killed were their direct descendants who rarely showed up in public. They were the hopes and future of their family. The higher-ups simply couldn’t accept that all of them had been killed. This ancient family had never suffered such a huge loss.
A large group of cultivators vanished into the sky, just like Corpse Yin Sect, heading towards Great Qian Empire.
For a moment, turbulence seemed to be taking place under the Heavens. All of them were heading towards the same destination - the Genius Prefecture of Great Qian Empire.
“What’s going on? That’s a very powerful pressure. Could it be that the weather is changing?”
“That’s the pressure from an Immortal Venerable. Many Immortal Venerables have emerged at the same time. We rarely see such supreme beings under normal situation. I wonder what has happened.”
“They seem to be flying towards the same direction. Could this be the start of a revolution in Eastern Profound Domain?”

The whole Eastern Profound Domain was shaken. Many faces changed greatly as they had never experienced this kind of thing. Immortal Venerables would never appear during ordinary times, but now so many of them had emerged at once. In the face of such an event, even an idiot would know that something big was about to happen in Eastern Profound Domain.

At the present moment, all the higher-ups of Great Qian Empire had gathered at Genius Prefecture. The Emperor, Yang Yu, came with haste along with his subordinates after receiving the news. The matter was so great that even the Emperor had lost his composure.
“Father.” Seeing Yang Yu’s arrival, Yang Bufan hastily walked forth.
“You don’t have to explain anymore. I’m already informed.”

Yang Yu was an intermediate Immortal Venerable wore a dragon robe; his bearing was extraordinary. Superior dignity radiated from his simple gestures. He was the Imperial Emperor whom people were in awe.
He raised his head and looked at the incredible pressure spreading towards their direction and frowned. Given his cultivation base, he could already feel that the real chaos was about to come.
“Jiang Chen, I have really underestimated you.”

He couldn’t help shaking his head. Not just him, everyone had underestimated Jiang Chen. None of them expected that Jiang Chen would create such an earth-shattering incident in Golden Horizon. Not long after that, the world would be plunged into chaos because of him. Yang Yu was quite impressed by the young man who was able to stir the entire domain.
“Emperor, it seems like those experts are heading our way,” Yang Zanqing said.
“Yes, it’s only a matter of time. I now declare that Jiang Chen is officially expelled from Genius Prefecture. He has nothing to do with us anymore from now on,” Yang Yu announced.

Everyone nodded in secret after hearing such a decision. They didn’t feel that Yang Yu was excessive. Even Yang Bufan, Han Yan and the rest understood the decision well. Great Qian Empire was now facing the pressure from eight major powers. It was the best option to cut off their relationship with Jiang Chen now. This was Jiang Chen’s intention when he chose not to follow them back from the Golden Horizon for he didn’t want to bring disaster to Great Qian Empire.

Not long after Yang Yu made the announcement, the experts of the eight major powers arrived from eight different directions, full of momentum, encircling Genius Prefecture almost simultaneously. Rolling waves of qi were everywhere. Numerous Immortal Venerables had also appeared. Boundless pressure lingered in the sky above the prefecture. Great Qian Empire had never been under so much pressure before.
